items.name: 3d-card
items.title: 3D Card
items.blurb: Card tips in 3D toward the pointer and its layers pull apart.
items.use: A showcase card should feel physical and reward hovering, as on portfolios, product pages or feature grids.
items.text: A dark product card whose body rotates toward the cursor while the title, paragraph, photo and buttons sit at separate depths. Move away and it eases back flat. A rounded near-black card on a black stage, outlined by a faint border. Inside sit a bold white title, a short grey paragraph, a wide forest photo in a rounded frame, and a footer row with a plain text link at left and a white pill button at right. Moving the pointer over the card tips it toward the cursor; the heading, text, image and buttons each hold a different depth, so they fan apart as it turns. Leaving the card smoothly resets it to flat. card body, title, description text, forest image, text link, sign up button
phrases: card that tilts toward your mouse
image card that follows the cursor

items.name: 3d-globe
items.title: 3D Globe
items.blurb: A textured 3D Earth spins slowly while avatar pins stand off its surface.
items.use: Show global presence or a distributed team as an explorable rotating globe with people pins.
items.text: A rotating photorealistic globe with a soft blue atmospheric glow. Small round photo markers rise from points on its surface, and the planet can be dragged to turn it. A blue-and-green Earth sphere floats on black, wrapped in a soft blue halo. Continents show relief and cloud tones, and small circular avatar markers on short pale stems stand off the surface at scattered points, with the planet lit from one side. The globe turns slowly on its own and drag orbits it, with damping carrying the motion after release. Markers facing away hide behind the sphere, and hovering one enlarges it against the surface. globe sphere, atmosphere glow, marker stems, avatar markers
phrases: three js earth with city pins
globe showing people around the world

items.name: 3d-marquee
items.title: 3D Image Marquee
items.blurb: Photos tile a tilted wall and drift up and down in columns.
items.use: A landing section wants a rich image wall behind or beside copy without inventing a layout.
items.text: A gallery of many photos arranged in four columns on a rotated 3D plane, so the grid runs diagonally while neighbouring columns slide slowly in opposite directions. Dozens of small landscape photos fill the frame as tilted diamonds, separated by thin dotted lines, showing tulips, a white ship, waves, a face and grass. The whole wall leans in perspective, larger toward one corner. Alternating columns creep vertically in opposite directions on long ten- and fifteen-second loops, so the wall drifts continuously. Hovering one photo lifts it a few pixels and adds a shadow. photo tile, tilted grid, dotted grid line, column, hover shadow

items.name: 3d-perspective-text
items.title: 3D Perspective Text
items.blurb: Oversized orange text lies back in perspective and rolls upright as you scroll.
items.use: A manifesto or intro should feel cinematic, with a paragraph that pulls the reader in as they scroll.
items.text: A large block of bold orange copy is tilted back in strong 3D perspective on a dark stage. As the page scrolls the text lifts and flattens toward the reader, with a small hint above telling you to scroll. A dark full-width stage holding a wide paragraph of heavy orange text set in a deep backward tilt, the top lines larger and the lower ones compressed. A tiny two-line hint sits above centre with a thin vertical rule hanging from it. The block is pinned while the page scrolls, its backward tilt easing from steep toward nearly flat as progress advances. A gradient fades the bottom edge into the dark as the lines rise into view. text block, scroll hint, vertical rule, bottom fade
phrases: orange headline that lifts as you scroll

items.name: 3d-pin
items.title: 3D Pin Card
items.blurb: A dark card tips back in 3D, sprouting a site label and cyan beam on hover.
items.use: A project or profile card should feel interactive and reveal a destination link on hover.
items.text: A dark link card holding an avatar, a name, a short paragraph and tag pills. Hovering tips it into perspective, fades in a site-name pill above and pulses blue rings behind a thin cyan stem. A small near-black rounded card with a barely visible border, holding a violet-to-sky gradient circle, the bold name Aceternity UI, a grey paragraph and three thin outlined tags in a row along the bottom. Hovered, it tilts away under a small dark pill reading aceternity.com, joined by a fine cyan line. At rest the card faces the viewer. On hover it tips back in perspective, shrinks slightly and darkens toward its top edge, a site-name pill fades in above, a cyan pin line and dot appear, and soft blue rings pulse out behind it on a six-second loop. Leaving restores the flat card. card, gradient circle, name label, paragraph, tag pills, site pill, pin line
phrases: card that tilts back when hovered
link card that reveals a site label
floating card with pulsing blue circles
hover effect for a product card
card that leans away from the cursor
dark card with cyan beam on hover

items.name: ASCIIText-TS-TW
items.title: ASCII Text
items.blurb: Chunky pixel letters shimmer with red and green fringes.
items.use: A bold single word on a dark landing page needs motion and a retro screen feel.
items.text: A word is drawn as blocky pixel glyphs on a black field. It tilts in 3D toward the pointer, ripples in waves, and its tint slides through cream, green and purple as time passes. The word sits centred in cream white on a black stage, built from small square pixel blocks with fine red and green fringes along each edge. Some frames show it leaning in perspective, as if viewed slightly from one side. The word sways in perspective toward the pointer and ripples in soft waves. Its tint slides from cream through green and purple as time passes, easing when the pointer stops. pixel letters, colour fringes, dark stage

items.name: AnimatedContent-TS-TW
items.title: Animated Content
items.blurb: Cards slide and fade into place as the page scrolls past them.
items.use: Sections or cards should arrive as the visitor scrolls, giving a long page a sense of pace.
items.text: A wrapper that slides its child in from the side or from below, fading and optionally scaling, once the child scrolls into view. The demo applies it to a stack of changelog cards. A dark changelog page: a small outlined badge, a bold white heading and a line of grey copy at the top, then a narrow column of rounded dark cards. Each card carries a version tag, a white title and two lines of grey text. Each card begins shifted off its resting spot and invisible, then slides, fades and scales into place when it reaches a set point in the viewport. The move fires once per card and scrolling carries on normally. badge, heading, intro copy, changelog card, version tag
phrases: cards slide in as you scroll
content fades up on entering view
elements animate in from the side
reveal cards while scrolling a page
staggered slide in for a list

items.name: AnimatedList-TS-TW
items.title: AnimatedList
items.blurb: Rounded rows scroll by, one lit under the pointer.
items.use: A compact panel should show many short updates or options in a scrollable column.
items.text: A tall column of short status messages in rounded dark rows scrolls inside a fixed panel, with rows fading at the top and bottom. Hovering a row brightens it and arrow keys walk the selection. A narrow column of rounded charcoal rows, each holding one line of white text, sits centred on black. The first and last rows fade into the background and one row is a shade lighter than the rest. The list scrolls vertically inside a fixed height while its top and bottom rows soften out. Moving the pointer or pressing arrow keys walks a highlight down the rows, and clicking one selects it. list row, row text, fade edges, scroll track
phrases: list with fade at the edges

items.name: Antigravity-TS-TW
items.title: Antigravity Particle Field
items.blurb: Tiny pink capsules orbit a hollow ring, repelled by the pointer.
items.use: A product page wants a light particle halo that reacts to the pointer without a heavy scene.
items.text: Hundreds of small pink particles gather into a loose ring around the pointer and shove outward as it moves, drifting across a black field. A black field scattered with hundreds of short pink-white capsules, most gathered in a rough circle that leaves a dark hole in the middle. Outside the ring a few stray particles float. Particles near the pointer swing into a ring around it, pointing outward, and part as it moves; the ring breathes with a slow pulse. Left alone, the ring drifts along its own path. particle, ring, empty centre
phrases: particles that flee from the cursor
ring of dots around the mouse
floating specks in a dark field
pink specks pushed away by pointer
dark particle field for a hero

items.name: Aurora-TS-TW
items.title: Aurora
items.blurb: A glowing green and violet ribbon ripples across the top of the screen.
items.use: A dark hero or section wants a soft moving wash of colour without images, video or heavy artwork.
items.text: A wide strip of soft light blends violet, green and cyan and undulates like a slow aurora. It fills its container edge to edge in a loop, sitting behind whatever you place on top. A wide horizontal band hugs the top of a black stage, brightest near its upper edge and fading to black below. It runs from deep violet through acid green to pale cyan, with soft blurred crests and no hard edges. The band drifts continuously: its coloured crests swell, slide sideways and subside in a slow loop with no pause. Nothing responds to the pointer; the motion is driven by time. light band, violet edge, green crest, cyan edge, dark falloff

items.name: Balatro-TS-TW
items.title: Balatro Shader
items.blurb: Red and blue paint swirl into marbled eddies across the whole screen.
items.use: You want a bold animated backdrop that fills a hero or section and needs no images, just colour and motion.
items.text: A full-screen animated shader that churns deep blue and crimson into a marbled, liquid-like pattern with pale highlights, slowly rotating and drifting as it runs. The whole area fills with a swirling, marbled pattern of deep navy blue and blood red, shot through with thin pale-blue and white streaks and glossy highlights. Dark near-black pools sit between glossy colour bands, giving the look of oil paint or polished stone in motion. The pattern rotates and churns continuously, its eddies drifting and re-forming as it runs. Moving the pointer nudges the swirl slightly, and colours, speed and contrast can be changed. swirl, colour bands, highlights, dark pools
phrases: liquid paint background for a hero
oil slick pattern behind a headline

items.name: Ballpit-TS-TW
items.title: Ballpit
items.blurb: Grey and white spheres tumble, bounce and pile up like a ball pit.
items.use: You want a playful, physics-driven 3D backdrop for a hero or landing page that responds to the pointer.
items.text: A 3D physics toy of dozens of glossy spheres in white, grey and graphite that fall, collide and settle into a heap on a black stage. Moving the cursor pushes them around. A black stage holds a heap of glossy 3D spheres in white, light grey and dark graphite, of mixed sizes, piled along the bottom and drifting upward. A bright white glow forms in the middle of the pile, and a white 'Ballpit' heading with a small grey subtitle floats near the top. Gravity pulls the spheres down so they bounce off the floor and walls and shove each other, then settle into a loose heap. Moving the cursor drags an invisible control sphere that knocks them around before they calm again. sphere, pile, glow, heading, subtitle
phrases: white spheres that react to the mouse
balls pile up at the bottom of the screen

items.name: Beams-TS-TW
items.title: Beams
items.blurb: Upright ribbons of soft white light ripple and cross on black.
items.use: You want a restrained, atmospheric light backdrop behind a dark hero without loud colour or busy motion.
items.text: A dark scene of tall, soft white light beams standing in a loose cluster, their edges rippling and drifting as if made of silk, with a faint grain over everything. A black field with a cluster of upright, softly glowing white ribbons in the centre, of varying height and brightness, their edges blurred and slightly stepped. Some are bright bars, others faint halos, and light grain dusts the darker areas. The ribbons ripple and drift slowly upward and sideways, their bright bands sliding along each column like moving highlights. The motion loops continuously and never settles. ribbon, light band, halo, grain, dark field
phrases: subtle light effect for a hero

items.name: BlobCursor-TS-TW
items.title: Blob Cursor
items.blurb: A soft purple blob trails the pointer and stretches to catch up.
items.use: A playful portfolio or marketing page wants a custom pointer with personality.
items.text: A round violet shape chases the mouse across a dark panel, flexing into a teardrop as it moves, with fainter copies lagging behind it. A violet disc with a small white dot at its centre glides over a near-black panel, its edges blurred into a soft cloud. When it moves it stretches into an egg shape, and dimmer copies trail it. Each pointer move tweens three discs toward the cursor at different speeds, so the largest lags and the smallest leads. When the pointer stops they settle back into round blobs. blob, white centre dot, trailing blobs, heading, caption
phrases: purple blob that follows the mouse
custom pointer for a landing page
elastic shape that chases the cursor

items.name: BlurText-TS-TW
items.title: Blur Text
items.blurb: Words sharpen into focus one after another.
items.use: A hero headline should appear gently as the page loads or scrolls into view.
items.text: Two lines of type arrive out of a heavy blur, resolving word by word into crisp text with a short stagger. The reveal fires when the block scrolls into view. A bold white headline sits above a smaller grey subtitle, both left aligned on a black stage. Type is tight and plain, and a tiny bordered Replay control rests in the lower right. Each word fades up from a heavy blur with a short stagger, going from soft and faint to sharp. The smaller line follows with a quicker, opposite-direction drift and the whole thing restarts on replay. headline, subheading, animated words
phrases: text that fades in from blur
unblur text when scrolled into view

items.name: BorderGlow-TS-TW
items.title: Border Glow
items.blurb: Violet light creeps along the border toward the cursor.
items.use: You want a dark card to feel alive on pointer hover without adding heavy motion or an obvious gimmick.
items.text: A dark, softly shadowed card whose border and a small outer halo brighten with a violet mesh gradient toward whichever edge the pointer approaches, then fade when it leaves. A rounded dark card floating on a near-black stage, holding a small outlined 'Pro plan' pill, a bold white heading, a short grey paragraph, a large $24 price and a full-width white button. The card edge is a thin line that can light up violet and blue with a soft halo outside. As the pointer moves toward an edge, a cone of gradient light grows along that part of the border and a soft glow blooms outside it; moving away fades both out. In the demo an automatic sweep also runs the light once around the card. card, plan pill, heading, paragraph, price, button, border light
phrases: card border that glows near the cursor
purple light around a pricing card
mesh gradient edge on a card
spotlight border that tracks the pointer
subtle halo around a dark panel

items.name: BounceCards-TS-TW
items.title: BounceCards
items.blurb: Rounded photo cards fan out and settle into a springy row.
items.use: A portfolio, gallery or team page wants a playful cluster of square photos.
items.text: Five square photos with thick white borders and rounded corners sit in a tilted fan over a black stage. They pop in with a bounce and drift apart when you hover over one. Five square photo cards with thick white frames and rounded corners are fanned across a black stage, each tilted a little and overlapping its neighbours. Soft shadows lift them off the background. On load the cards scale up from nothing one after another with a springy overshoot. Hovering a card straightens it and pushes the others aside, and leaving restores the original fan. photo card, white frame, card fan
phrases: fanned photo cards with white borders
photos pop in with a bounce
card fan that opens on hover

items.name: BubbleMenu-TS-TW
items.title: BubbleMenu
items.blurb: Menu of white pill buttons bursts open beneath a logo.
items.use: A playful site wants a bold full-screen navigation instead of a plain bar.
items.text: A white pill logo and a round menu button sit at the top of a pale page. Pressing the button blooms five oversized white pill links across the centre in a staggered fan, each with its own hover colour. On a pale grey canvas a white pill with a small logo sits top left and a round white button with two dark lines sits top right. Opened, five large white pill links with big dark labels fill the centre, each tilted a few degrees. Tapping the round button turns its two lines into an X and pops the pill links in one at a time with a slight rotation. Hovering a link tints it with its own colour and scales it up, and tapping the X collapses them. logo pill, menu button, pill links, link labels
phrases: round menu that expands into pills
big rounded links in a fan

items.name: CardNav-TS-TW
items.title: CardNav
items.blurb: The navbar unfolds into three link cards beneath it.
items.use: A premium studio site needs a compact header that reveals grouped links on demand.
items.text: A slim dark navbar holds a centred logo, a hamburger and a light Get Started button. Tapping the menu drops the bar open into three tinted cards, each listing nested links with small arrows. A narrow dark rounded bar sits at the top centre of a black page, with a white logo centred, a small light Get Started button on the right and a two-line hamburger on the left. Open, three deep violet cards fill the bar with tinted labels and arrowed links. Tapping the hamburger unfolds the bar downward while three cards fade and rise into place one after another. Tapping again folds the bar back to its slim resting height. nav bar, logo, menu toggle, cta button, link cards, card links
phrases: hamburger opens a panel of columns
compact nav that grows on click

items.name: CardSwap-TS-TW
items.title: CardSwap
items.blurb: A stack of dark cards cycles front to back on a timer.
items.use: A feature or testimonial area should cycle several cards without visible carousel controls.
items.text: Three near-black info cards sit in a fanned stack. Every few seconds the front card drops away and the one behind steps forward, so a new card and its copy reach the front. On a black stage a fanned stack of three near-black cards with thin borders tilts up and to the right, each offset from the last. Every card has a small icon and title bar above a paragraph and a few grey skeleton lines. Every few seconds the front card sinks down out of the stack while the cards behind slide forward one slot, then it returns at the back. Hovering the stack pauses the cycle. card stack, card header, body text, skeleton lines
phrases: cards rotate to the front on a timer

items.name: Carousel-TS-TW
items.title: Animated Card Carousel
items.blurb: Swipe a dark feature card sideways to page through five slides.
items.use: A small deck of feature or testimonial cards should be browsed by drag and dots rather than a full-width slider.
items.text: One rounded card at a time shows an icon, a bold title and a short blurb. Dragging it sideways, or tapping the dots, slides the next card in with a slight 3D turn. A dark rounded card sits inside a bordered frame, holding a small round icon badge, a bold white heading and two lines of pale copy. Five small dots run beneath it, the active one larger. Dragging the card sideways brings in the next or previous slide, each card turning slightly in 3D as it travels. A spring settles it into place and the dot row marks the current slide. slide card, icon badge, slide title, description text, dot indicators
phrases: drag to change slide card gallery
deck of cards you can swipe through
one card at a time feature showcase

items.name: ChromaGrid-TS-TW
items.title: ChromaGrid
items.blurb: A wall of grey portraits turns to colour under the cursor.
items.use: A team or people grid should feel alive without video, extra images or a click.
items.text: Six people cards sit in a neat grid, all greyscale at rest. Moving the pointer across them lifts the grey in a soft circular window, exposing each photo and its coloured card gradient. Two rows of three rounded cards, each holding a square portrait above a name, an @handle on the right and a job title below. At rest every photo is grey and the gaps between cards read as near-black. A circle of colour travels with the pointer, clearing the grey overlay only around the cursor. When the pointer leaves, the whole grid fades back to monochrome. portrait card, photo, name, handle, role, colour spotlight
phrases: greyscale team cards that colour on hover
photo grid reveals colour near cursor
black and white portraits turn colorful
team page grid with hover reveal
grey photos light up under the mouse

items.name: ClickSpark-TS-TW
items.title: Click Spark
items.blurb: Sparks shoot out from the pointer when you click.
items.use: A playful acknowledgement that a click landed on a hero or an interactive surface.
items.text: A full-panel click catcher. Each click sends a ring of short straight streaks outward from the pointer, which shrink and fade while the text underneath stays put. A near-black, full-bleed panel with a thin rounded border and two centred lines of white text, a bold heading over a smaller caption. Clicks add a burst of white line segments radiating from the pointer; there is no other chrome. Clicking anywhere on the panel spawns twelve short white streaks that fly outward from the pointer, shrinking and fading over about 700 milliseconds before they vanish. Nothing else reacts, and the panel is still between clicks. panel, heading, caption, spark burst
phrases: short lines shooting from the pointer
little white streaks at the cursor
sparkle burst on pressing a button

items.name: ColorBends-TS-TW
items.title: Color Bends
items.blurb: Blurred ribbons of blue, cyan and pink glow across black.
items.use: You want a colourful, soft-focus animated background behind a big headline or product shot on a dark page.
items.text: A dark animated background where soft, out-of-focus bands of blue, cyan, pink and white drift and bend across the black like light through frosted glass. A black field with a few large, very soft colour bands: a white-hot oval edged in pink or blue low on the right, and sometimes a blue oval up on the left. Everything is heavily blurred, so the shapes read as glowing light rather than lines. The bands drift, stretch and bend slowly across the frame, their edges shifting from pink to blue as they move. The motion is continuous and eased, and moving the pointer nudges the field. colour band, bright core, tinted edge, dark field
phrases: soft glowing color blobs on black
colorful abstract backdrop for a hero
flowing light streaks in the dark

items.name: Counter-TS-TW
items.title: Animated Number Counter
items.blurb: Big numbers roll like an odometer as they tick upward.
items.use: A dashboard statistic should feel live and draw the eye without the weight of a chart.
items.text: A large metric rolls its digits upward like slot reels, one place at a time, with the top and bottom of the row fading out. A smaller count beside plus and minus buttons steps by one when pressed. A small grey caption sits above a wide row of very large white numerals. Below it, a round outlined minus and plus button bracket a smaller two-digit number, and the big digits fade slightly at their top and bottom edges. Each digit spins vertically from the old value to the new one and settles. Pressing plus or minus steps the lower number by one, while the upper figure also climbs on its own in the demo. caption, large number, minus button, small number, plus button, edge fade
phrases: big number that increments on its own
plus minus buttons for a number

items.name: Crosshair-TS-TW
items.title: Crosshair Cursor
items.blurb: Fine white crosshair lines track the pointer across the page.
items.use: An editorial or portfolio page wants a precise aiming reticle instead of a normal pointer.
items.text: Two hairline white guides follow the mouse across a dark editorial panel, and they shudder with a noise glitch whenever the pointer touches a link. A near-black panel with a small letterspaced kicker, a heavy white headline, a line of grey copy and two underlined links. A one-pixel white horizontal and vertical line intersect where the pointer is, spanning the panel. The two guide lines trail the pointer with a slight lag and fade in once the mouse enters. Hovering either link shakes both lines with a turbulence filter for half a second, then lets them settle. horizontal guide, vertical guide, kicker, headline, copy, links
phrases: thin guide lines following the mouse pointer
horizontal and vertical lines tracking cursor
noise jitter when hovering a link

items.name: Cubes-TS-TW
items.title: 3D Cube Grid
items.blurb: Squares tip into small cubes as the pointer crosses the grid.
items.use: A tech product wants a decorative interactive backdrop that rewards hovering and clicking.
items.text: An eight-by-eight field of dashed purple squares sits flat until cells near the pointer rotate into 3D cubes; a click sends rings of pale lilac across the faces. A square grid of small dark cells with thin purple dashed borders, evenly spaced on black. Cells under the pointer lift into cube shapes with lit faces, and a click turns whole rings of cells pale lilac. Cells within a short radius of the pointer tilt on two axes, the nearest most, and ease back when it leaves. Left alone, a virtual pointer wanders the grid; a click washes expanding rings of colour outward. cell, dashed border, tilted cube, lit face, ripple ring
phrases: grid of squares that tip into cubes
pointer tilt on a square grid
animated grid for a hero background
wave of light across a grid

items.name: CurvedLoop-TS-TW
items.title: Curved Loop
items.blurb: A line of heavy uppercase words slides along a shallow arc.
items.use: A section needs a wide moving strip of keywords or a looping brand statement.
items.text: White uppercase words run continuously along a gently curved baseline and wrap around so the line never ends. The strip can be dragged to scrub the text, which then resumes in the direction you flick. One long line of heavy white uppercase words, separated by small bullets, crosses a black stage along a shallow downward dip. The letters are large and tightly set and the line runs past both edges. The line slides steadily to the left and loops seamlessly when it wraps. Dragging moves the text with the pointer and sets which way it carries on afterwards. arc of text, bullet separators, black stage

items.name: DarkVeil-TS-TW
items.title: Dark Veil
items.blurb: Deep blue light creeps in slow folds over a near-black field.
items.use: You need a dark, low-contrast animated backdrop that lets white text and product visuals stay the focus.
items.text: A very dark animated backdrop of deep blue light that slowly folds and drifts like a veil across black, with faint horizontal scanlines and a soft glow. An almost black field broken by wide, soft bands of deep blue that curve diagonally like folds in fabric, brightest along a glowing crest. Faint horizontal scanlines texture the lit areas, and the rest fades into darkness. The blue folds drift and breathe very slowly, so the surface seems to shift rather than move. Scanlines and a slight noise texture stay put, and the motion never stops. blue bands, glow crest, scanlines, dark field
phrases: subtle black gradient backdrop for a hero
blue glow that drifts like a veil
minimal animated background for a landing page

items.name: DecayCard-TS-TW
items.title: DecayCard
items.blurb: A photo card crumbles at the edges as the cursor moves fast.
items.use: A hero card or editorial feature needs a tactile, slightly unsettling image interaction.
items.text: A framed greyscale portrait tilts with the pointer while a noise filter tears away its edges when the cursor moves quickly. Large white words sit across the lower left of the image. A tall greyscale photo of a pug wrapped in a blanket, with heavy white display words reading 'Decay Card' across its lower left. A short caption sits on the dark stage below. The whole card drifts and tilts slightly with the pointer, and fast movement ramps up a noise distortion that gnaws the image edges into rough shapes. When the cursor slows, the edges settle back toward a rectangle. photo card, overlay words, caption, torn edges
phrases: photo card that tears apart on hover
card with big words over a photo
grayscale photo card with overlay text

items.name: DecryptedText-TS-TW
items.title: Decrypted Text
items.blurb: Words dissolve into random symbols, then snap back into reading order.
items.use: A tech or sci-fi page wants a heading to feel encoded and then resolve, without a full typewriter.
items.text: A line of text flickers through random letters and punctuation before resolving character by character into the real sentence. It can start on hover, when scrolled into view, or on a click. Three lines of bold text stack down a black stage: a large green heading, a medium blue monospaced line and a smaller purple line. Every character keeps its slot, so during the run each word shows some settled letters and some random glyphs. Hovering the first line makes it scrambles then resolve; the second decrypts once as it scrolls into view; the third toggles between plain text and a scramble on each click. While running, a timer swaps unrevealed characters for random glyphs until the true text is restored. green headline, blue line, purple line, scramble glyphs
phrases: random characters turning into a sentence
text decrypts when scrolled into view

items.name: Dither-TS-TW
items.title: Dither
items.blurb: Speckled grey clouds drift across black like an old one-bit screen.
items.use: You want a textured, retro-computer look behind a hero, with a living grain instead of a flat gradient.
items.text: A full-screen retro dithered background of soft grey clouds and wisps rendered in coarse pixel dots over black, with the whole field slowly flowing and the cursor dimming a spot. Black filled with soft grey cloud shapes broken into coarse, speckled pixel dots, as if printed in only a handful of grey levels. The forms are smoky and irregular, dense in some corners and thinning to scattered specks elsewhere. The cloud shapes drift and churn slowly across the whole frame, so the grey forms keep changing while the pixel grid stays fixed. Moving the cursor dims a soft area around the pointer. grey cloud, pixel dots, dark field, cursor dimple
phrases: black and white pixel noise backdrop
lo fi grey noise for a hero

items.name: Dock-TS-TW
items.title: Dock
items.blurb: Icons swell as the pointer passes and name tags float above.
items.use: An app or desktop-like screen wants a compact launcher bar that stays out of the content.
items.text: A dark rounded bar holds six round icon buttons. Sliding the pointer along it grows the nearest icons and lifts a small name tag above the one under the cursor. A long dark bar with a grey outline sits low on the stage, holding six evenly spaced circular buttons, each with a white line icon. When active, a tiny rounded name tag floats above the bar. Moving the pointer across the bar makes the closest icons swell and nudges their neighbours wider. The icon under the pointer shows a label overhead, and all return to even size when the pointer leaves. dock bar, icon buttons, icon glyphs, name tag
phrases: app launcher at the bottom of the screen
floating icons that zoom on approach

items.name: DomeGallery-TS-TW
items.title: DomeGallery
items.blurb: A hollow sphere of small photos you can spin around.
items.use: A portfolio or campaign wants an immersive, browsable wall of images instead of a flat grid.

items.text: A dark rounded dialog with a bold trip heading, a stack of tilted travel photos and a short details list. It opens from a tilted, shrunken pose over a dimmed blurred page. A dark rounded dialog over a blurred black backdrop, with a small close X in its top corner. A bold white heading sits above four overlapping tilted photos, with a two-column list of short trip details beneath. Clicking the white trigger button dims and blurs the page, then the panel springs in from a tilted, smaller pose. The close X or a click outside dismisses it, and the page unblurs. trigger button, dialog panel, close icon, heading, photo stack, detail list, footer buttons
phrases: modal that springs up from the page
popup with a stack of photos
center screen card over blurred background
modal with close x in the corner

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.blurb: A big number rolls and springs to each new value you pick.
items.use: A stat, balance or count changes and you want the eye to follow the move instead of a jump.
items.text: Displays a single large number that animates toward any new value with a spring and comma formatting, with a row of pill buttons in the demo to pick targets. One oversized white number sits centred on black, using tabular figures and comma separators. Under it, five grey rounded pill buttons show 0, 999, 1,234, 42,000 and 1,000,000. Choosing a pill makes the number spring from its old value to the new one, counting through intermediate values before it settles. number, comma separators, target buttons, dark stage
phrases: big number that counts up on change
animated counter for a dashboard stat
number that springs to a new value
count up to a million effect
price or stat that rolls when it updates

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.blurb: Inset dashboard with a grouped sidebar, stat cards and a queue list.
items.use: You need a ready app frame with sidebar navigation, header, stat cards and a content area for a SaaS dashboard.
items.text: An app shell with a dark grouped sidebar that collapses to icons, a sticky header with breadcrumb and user avatar, and a main area holding headline stats and a queue of conversations. A full dashboard on near-black: a dark sidebar with a product mark, a highlighted New Conversation button and labelled nav groups, beside a main panel. Four stat cards sit above a Needs a reply list, under a thin header with breadcrumb and avatar. The sidebar toggle collapses the rail to icons and widens the main panel, with a tooltip naming the shortcut. Nav groups expand their sub-items in place with a rotating chevron, and the header stays pinned while content scrolls. sidebar, logo, nav group, sub menu, new conversation button, header breadcrumb, stat card, queue row
phrases: inset sidebar that shrinks to icons

items.name: apple-activity-card
items.title: Apple Activity Card
items.blurb: Three nested activity rings that fill and count up, one highlighted on hover.
items.use: A wellness or fitness screen needs to show daily movement, exercise and stand goals at a glance.
items.text: Three concentric progress rings in pink, green and cyan under the title Activity Rings, with Move, Exercise and Stand values beside them. The rings draw and their counts rise on view, and pointing at one dims the others. Three nested rings on near-black: a thick pink outer arc, a lime green middle ring and a thin cyan inner ring, each over a faint circular track. To the right a three-row legend pairs a small label with a big coloured value like 479/800 CAL. On view the rings draw in one after another and their numbers count up, the over-goal ones lapping past the start behind a shadowed end cap. Hovering a ring or its legend row brightens it and fades the other two. title, outer ring, middle ring, inner ring, end cap, legend row, value, unit
phrases: apple watch activity rings for web
rings that count up on load

items.name: apple-card-carousel
items.title: Apple Card Carousel
items.blurb: Photo cards scroll sideways and grow into a full read when clicked.
items.use: Image-led items should be browsed sideways and open into a longer description in place.
items.text: A sideways scroller of tall image cards, each labelled with a category and a big title. Clicking one expands it into a large centred panel with the description and a small close button over a blurred dark backdrop. Tall portrait photo cards sit in a row on a dark page, softly rounded, with a small white category label and a large white title at the top left over a dark fade. Two round arrow buttons rest at the lower right; an open card becomes a wide light panel centred on a dimmed backdrop. Arrows and trackpad drag slide the row horizontally, and the arrows dim when there is nothing further to scroll. Clicking a card expands it into a large detail panel; the close button, Escape or a click outside folds it away. photo card, category label, card title, scroll arrows, detail panel, close button, description
phrases: cards that expand into a detail view
travel gallery you can swipe sideways
click a card to open full description

items.name: apple-invites
items.title: Apple Invites
items.blurb: Event cards fan in a tilted stack and rotate to the next one on a timer.
items.use: A landing or events page needs a lively preview of several upcoming events without a big grid.
items.text: A fanned stack of event invitation cards: one upright in the middle with a photo, crown badge, avatars, title, date and place, and two tilted neighbours peeking out. It advances to the next event on a timer. A carousel of rounded photo cards on a dark stage, one centred and two tilted behind it to left and right, each with a frosted pill badge top left, a row of round avatars, and centred white title, date and location over a blurred footer. Every couple of seconds the cards spring sideways to the next event: the centre card slides out, a neighbour swings in to centre and a new card appears at the side. Neighbours sit rotated twelve degrees, smaller and slightly faded. card stack, card photo, status badge, crown icon, avatar row, title, date, location
phrases: event invite cards that fan out

items.name: apple-pro-display-xdr
items.title: Studio Display Mockup
items.blurb: An aluminium monitor mockup whose dock icons magnify and show tooltips.
items.use: A portfolio or product page wants a realistic desktop screen to showcase an app or wallpaper in a hero.
items.text: A photorealistic studio display on a dark backdrop, with a camera dot, a slim stand and a macOS-style dock of app icons. The dock magnifies under the pointer with tooltips, and clicking the screen swaps the wallpaper for a dark app view. A silver aluminium monitor with a thin black bezel and a slim stand centred on near-black. Its screen shows a mountain wallpaper above a translucent dock of colourful round-square app icons; the frame carries a soft tinted glow when active. Pointing at the dock swells the icons and pops a small tooltip above them while a coloured glow rings the display. Clicking the screen advances to the next demo, swapping the wallpaper for a dark player window. display frame, screen, camera dot, stand, cable hole, dock, app icon, tooltip

items.name: arcade-pixel
items.title: Arcade Pixel
items.blurb: Pixel-art arcade text and sprites scroll, type and blink with CRT glow.
items.use: A game, event or playful landing page wants the look of an old arcade screen with animated pixel text.
items.text: A black arcade screen draws messages in a chunky 5x7 pixel font on canvas, with space-invader sprites, typing and marquee animations, phosphor glow, scanlines and a faint CRT flicker. A black rounded panel holding pixel art: three small glowing sprites along the top, a green alien, a pink cat and a yellow heart, then large pink blocky letters, a line of cyan scrolling text and white INSERT COIN beneath. The big message types itself out letter by letter with a white flash on each new glyph, the cyan score line slides sideways continuously, and INSERT COIN blinks on and off over scanlines and a soft flicker. sprites, big pixel text, score marquee, insert coin text, scanlines, phosphor glow
phrases: old arcade machine screen for web

items.name: ascii-art
items.title: ASCII Art Renderer
items.blurb: Photographs rebuilt from text characters, revealed by a green diagonal sweep.
items.use: A tech or portfolio page wants an image rendered as text that decodes itself on scroll.
items.text: Turns an image into a grid of text characters whose density follows brightness. A panel can animate in with a green matrix sweep, a fade or a typewriter, leaving a character-drawn picture. Two side-by-side ASCII panels on a near-black stage: on the left the outline of a dog built from dense grey characters, on the right palm trees drawn as pale block glyphs. Small grey captions sit below each panel. Each picture is redrawn from character density rather than pixels. On entering view a green diagonal band sweeps the left panel, showing glowing random glyphs ahead of the front until the whole image is legible, then it holds still. ascii panel, character grid, green reveal sweep, caption
phrases: recreate a photo with typed glyphs
matrix green reveal on a picture
ascii portrait effect for a hero
picture built from letters and symbols

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.blurb: File chips with image preview, upload progress and a remove button.
items.use: A chat or form composer needs to show several uploaded files with their progress, size and a quick remove.
items.text: A row of attached-file chips, each with a thumbnail or icon, a name, a status line like Uploading 64% and a small remove button. A second row shows tall image tiles plus a dashed Add file tile. A dark composer card holds a horizontal row of rounded chips, each a small image or file icon with a name, a grey status line and a tiny x button. Below sit three tall image tiles with names and sizes, and a dashed Add file tile. Uploading and processing chips spin a small spinner and shimmer their filenames; when the upload lands the status swaps to its size and the shimmer stops. Each chip can be removed with its x, and the tile row opens the file picker. attachment chip, thumbnail, file icon, filename, status line, remove button, image tile, add file tile
phrases: add file tile in a composer

items.name: attract-button
items.title: Attract Button
items.blurb: Iron filings around a call to action swing toward the cursor.
items.use: A hero or waitlist needs a memorable primary button that reacts to the pointer without a big animation.
items.text: A dark rounded call-to-action button with a magnet icon, ringed by a field of small iron filings drawn on a canvas. Moving the pointer nearby makes the filings rotate to point at it, and focussing the button pulls them inward. A white, slightly rounded rectangular button with a small magnet icon and the label Join the waitlist, floating on a dark stage. Short dark grey dashes radiate outward in a loose ring around it, with a grey caption below. At rest the filings hold a radial pattern with a slight jitter. When the pointer comes near they rotate on a spring to point toward it and brighten, and focussing the button pulls the whole field inward. button, magnet icon, label, filing field, caption

items.name: audio-meters
items.title: Audio Meters
items.blurb: Broadcast-style LED level meters that bounce with the beat and flag clipping.
items.use: An audio tool or player needs a realistic level display with channels, a decibel scale and clipping.
items.text: A two-channel master LED meter with a dB scale, a live readout and a clip light, above six vertical gradient meters for Kick, Snare, Bass, Keys, Vocal and FX that move with synthetic audio. A dark panel titled Master bus holds two stacked rows of tiny square LED segments shifting from green through yellow to red, with a dB scale underneath. Below, six thin vertical bars in matching colours rise from the floor, each with a tiny peak tick. Every bar jumps and settles with the beat, leaving a small peak-hold marker at its high point. The readout counts the level in decibels, and when a channel pushes past zero the segment row and a red clip light come on. master meter rows, led segments, db scale, db readout, clip light, vertical meter, peak tick, channel label
phrases: audio level meter with led segments
vertical channel meters in a mixer

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.blurb: Soft blurred light bands drift across a dark page behind your content.
items.use: A hero or landing section needs an ambient backdrop that moves slowly without stealing attention.
items.text: A full-bleed animated backdrop of out-of-focus white and blue streaks over a near-black field. It drifts slowly and continuously, wrapping whatever children you place on it. A near-black stage filled by a soft, out-of-focus vertical gradient: broad white and pale blue streaks blurring into indigo, with a faint warm brown edge. A small white caption sits in the middle. The blurred bands drift slowly sideways and shift in brightness, never settling, so the backdrop keeps moving behind its content. Nothing reacts to the pointer. gradient backdrop, light band, dark field, caption
phrases: soft blurred light bands behind content

items.name: aurora-text

items.use: One word in a headline should stand out with a moving colour highlight.
items.text: A span of text filled with a sliding pink-to-blue gradient that keeps drifting sideways, so a single word in a headline keeps catching the light. A bold sans-serif heading on black made of three words. The first and last words are plain white, while the middle word is filled edge to edge with a pink, purple and blue gradient. The gradient slides slowly along the word and wraps around, so the pink, purple and blue bands keep travelling across the letters. It repeats without stopping. heading text, gradient word, dark background

items.name: auto-height
items.title: Auto Height
items.blurb: Grows and shrinks its height smoothly as the content inside changes.
items.use: Text of unknown length must swap without the surrounding layout jumping or leaving a gap.
items.text: A bordered card holding a short release note. Clicking Show more swaps in a longer three-paragraph version while the card springs to the new height and the text crossfades. A dark rounded card with a thin border holding a paragraph of small grey text and a compact outlined Show more button below. Expanded, the same card grows taller to fit three paragraphs. Clicking the button swaps the paragraph for a three-paragraph version; the card's height springs to fit while the old text blurs out and the new text blurs in. Clicking again returns to the short version. card, paragraph text, show more button, height container

items.name: avatar-circles
items.title: Avatar Circles
items.blurb: A row of circular photos overlaps into a white +99 disc.
items.use: A compact group of users plus a count is needed as social proof or a member preview.
items.text: A compact avatar group where round photos overlap shoulder to shoulder and end in a light disc showing how many more people there are. Five round photos lined up on black, each cropped to a circle and ringed with a thin white border. They overlap by about a third, and a solid white circle holding +99 in black caps the row. Static: the row does not move or respond in the frames. The trailing count is a link whose background darkens on hover. avatar photo, avatar ring, count disc

items.text: User portraits shown as clipped circles, with a grey initials fallback when a picture is unavailable, plus an overlapping stack of smaller faces that ends in a plus-eight counter. Two rows on black. The top row has six large round portraits: four photos, a grey circle reading JL and a softened-square portrait. Below, five small round photos overlap and end in a grey circle reading +8. Static: nothing moves. Photos simply fill their circles, and a missing or failed image would swap to initials on a flat grey circle. round portrait, photo, initials fallback, square portrait, overlapping stack, overflow counter

A wide, very dark panel with a soft vertical gradient, a white headline and a pink-to-purple second line centred in the middle. Barely visible purple threads fall from the top, and tiny purple sparks gather along the bottom edge. Thin beams drop on separate looping timers; when one reaches the floor it bursts into a small shower of purple sparks and then starts again from the top. A deep navy stage covered by a faint, perspective-skewed grid of thin lines with small plus signs where some lines cross. A few cells fill with pale pink, blue, yellow or green, and white centred text sits above the grid. At rest the grid is barely visible. Moving the pointer over a cell instantly fills it with a random pastel colour; the fill fades back to navy over a couple of seconds as the pointer moves on. grid cell, grid line, plus mark, hovered box, overlay text

A dark full-bleed field of small rounded cubes in a receding perspective grid, catching warm orange light on raised crests while the rest stays near-black. A white heading and a small badge sit over it. Moving the cursor pushes a ripple through the cubes; a ring of raised, orange-lit blocks spreads out, passes on, and the surface settles flat. A full purple-to-indigo gradient field with a huge soft glowing orb in the middle that fades from warm yellow through pink. Everything is heavily blurred, and a faint blue light patch trails the cursor across the field. Five coloured blobs drift and rotate continuously over the purple base, so the central glow swells and changes hue without ever settling. A dark rounded card glowing with a soft multi-coloured halo in teal, blue, purple and gold. Inside sits a photo of streaking light trails at night, a bold title, a few lines of grey copy and a small white Buy now pill. The halo behind the card slowly slides its gradient around the edge, breathing between teal, blue, purple and gold. items.name: background-lights

items.text: A wide blurred conic gradient that sweeps blue into cyan and yellow near the bottom of the screen, giving a dark hero a soft coloured glow. It is a single non-interactive backdrop layer. A full-width, low band of soft colour along the bottom of a dark page: deep blue on the left shifting through teal to yellow on the right, blurred so no edges show. items.text: A full-screen dark backdrop scattered with thin coloured curves that draw themselves, drift outward and fade, looping continuously behind whatever content you place on top. A near-black panel holds a centred two-line white heading with a small grey paragraph beneath it. Around the text, dozens of fine curved strokes in blue, red, teal, purple and yellow sweep outward like orbits. items.text: A full-bleed dark backdrop of dozens of fine curves that draw themselves in left to right, then keep flowing. They run mostly side to side in a loose ribbon that arcs upward and fans out, brightest in the middle band and fading toward the top and bottom edges. items.name: background-ripple-effect

A near-black stage covered edge to edge by a faint grid of thin-bordered square cells. items.name: backlight

items.name: bell-button

Hovering nudges the bell, and clicking toggles it between a muted bell and a filled one, swapping the label to Following and rolling the count. Two rows of pill buttons on near-black: a dark outlined Notify me pill with a slashed bell and a grey 1,284 chip, then a white Following pill with a filled bell beside a round icon-only button. items.name: bending-gallery

items.text: A band of rounded photo cards with short captions, arranged on a shallow arc where outer cards dip and lean away.
