items.text: A rounded board filled with overlapping circular tiles in a hex grid. Dragging pans the field, and each bubble scales up as it nears the middle and down toward the frame. A dark rounded square with a soft inset shadow holds dozens of grey circles packed in an offset honeycomb. Bubbles vary in size, the largest near the middle and tiny ones clipping at the edges. Dragging anywhere on the board pans the whole field against the frame. Each circle grows as it moves toward the centre and shrinks away at the border, so the grid seems to bulge. board frame, bubble, shadow edge
phrases: pan a field of soft circles
circles that grow near the middle

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.blurb: Chat thread whose long message pops a party reaction when clicked.
items.use: A page needs to preview or mock a conversation with clear sender sides and message tones.
items.text: A small chat window with a contact header and message bubbles in several tones and alignments. Clicking the long reply adds a party-popper reaction badge with a count. A dark rounded card starts with a tiny avatar and contact header, then a stack of message bubbles: grey on the left, white on the right, a pale green tint and a red error bubble. Bubbles are rounded rectangles of varied widths. The long right-hand message is a button; clicking it toggles a small party-popper badge with a count that overlaps its lower edge. Bubble colour and side follow the chosen variant and alignment. chat card, contact header, avatar, message bubble, reaction badge

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.blurb: Rows of joined buttons, inputs and counters with shared borders.
items.use: Several small related actions or an input plus its button should read as a single control.
items.text: A set of horizontal controls where neighbouring buttons, text labels and inputs merge into one strip. The demo gathers message actions, text formatting, a URL field and a quantity stepper. On a black stage, four rows of compact dark controls sit centred. Each row joins buttons edge to edge with single hairlines, some with icons, some with short labels, plus a wide URL field and a white Add to cart button. Hovering brightens one segment inside its group, and clicking selectable icons such as Bold or centre alignment keeps that segment filled. The minus and plus ends of the counter change the number. action group, format group, alignment group, url field, quantity stepper, add to cart button
phrases: input with button on the side
quantity stepper with minus and plus
add to cart with share button

items.name: button-hover-right
items.title: Expanding Icon Button
items.blurb: A round arrow button stretches into a pill reading Visit on hover.
items.use: Space is tight and a single clear action can start as an icon and reveal its label on hover.
items.text: A circular blue button that shows only a white arrow. Hovering widens it into a pill that reveals the word Visit beside the arrow, and leaving shrinks it back. A small round button in a navy-to-indigo gradient with a pale blue outline and a white right arrow centred. Expanded, it becomes a wide pill holding white Visit text with the arrow at its right end. On hover the circle stretches sideways into a pill while Visit fades and slides into view; the arrow stays pinned to the right. Leaving shrinks it back to a circle and fades the label out. circle, arrow, label, pill
phrases: circle button expands to show text
arrow button that grows on hover

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.blurb: Six clickable action styles in a row, from solid white to bare link.
items.use: You need a small set of matching action styles that share one shape and sizing scale.
items.text: A matching set of action controls in six looks: a light filled primary, a dark secondary, an outlined one, a ghost with no fill, a red destructive and a plain text link, all sharing one rounded rectangle and small medium text. A single row of six short rounded controls on black. The first is filled light with dark text, the second dark grey, the third clear with a thin border, the fourth pure text, the fifth salmon red and the last a bare text link. Static: no press or hover effect is caught in the frames. In the code each variant darkens its fill on hover, the link one underlines, and keyboard focus draws a soft ring. primary action, secondary action, outline action, ghost action, destructive action, link action
phrases: clickable action with a filled background
primary and secondary actions in a row
text link styled as an action
ghost style action with no fill
rounded click target with a label
outlined action next to a solid one

items.name: buyme-acoffee
items.title: Buy Me Coffee Button
items.blurb: Coffee cup badge that turns into a yellow 'Buy me a coffee' card on hover.
items.use: A creator or indie page wants a playful, obvious link for visitors to leave a tip.
items.text: A tiled cream card covered in handwritten 'coffee' script with a yellow cup tile at centre; hovering clears the pattern to a yellow card reading 'Buy me a coffee' with a heart and bigger cup. A square cream card filled edge to edge with black handwritten 'coffee' script in a loose repeating pattern. At its centre sits a white rounded tile holding a yellow square, inside which a black-outlined takeaway coffee cup stands upright. Hovering wipes the script pattern away, shrinking it to reveal a yellow card with a small pink heart sticker, a larger coffee cup and hand-lettered 'Buy me a coffee' across the top. Moving away restores the patterned cover. coffee script pattern, white tile, yellow square, coffee cup, pink heart, buy me a coffee lettering

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.blurb: Month grid with arrows that step through dates to pick one.
items.use: A form needs one date chosen from a familiar month grid with quick month-by-month browsing.
items.text: A single-month date picker: the month and year sit between two chevrons above a grid of weekday headings and date numbers. Arrows move between months and a click chooses a day. A borderless dark grid about 300 pixels wide. A centred month and year in white sits between two grey chevrons, followed by a row of two-letter weekday headings and five or six rows of light grey date numbers, with days from adjacent months dimmed. Clicking a chevron moves the grid one month back or forward and a faint round highlight appears under the pointer. Clicking a day selects it with a filled circle, and today keeps a small dot beneath its number. month label, previous button, next button, weekday row, date grid
phrases: pick a date from a grid

items.name: call-chip
items.title: Call Chip
items.blurb: Compact tool-call chip with a live timer and a progress wash.
items.use: An agent interface should show which tool is running, what it is doing and how long it takes.
items.text: A small inline chip naming an agent's tool call, its argument and an elapsed time. A translucent wash fills across the bar while it runs, then it turns green with a tick when done or red with a retry on failure. A stack of narrow dark rounded bars, each holding a tiny monochrome icon, a short bold tool name, a monospace argument and a right-aligned timer. Faint lighter fills sit inside the bars, and the rows are tightly stacked. While a chip runs, a translucent wash creeps across its width toward the timer, which counts up in milliseconds. On completion the wash turns green and the icon rolls to a tick; on failure it turns red and the whole chip shakes. icon, tool name, argument, timer, progress wash
phrases: terminal command that shows elapsed time
loading pill for a function call
small status bar for ai tools
task row with success and error states

items.name: canvas-crowd
items.title: Canvas Crowd
items.blurb: Hand-drawn black-and-white characters stroll back and forth across the bottom.
items.use: A community or launch page wants a lively human crowd as decoration without photos.
items.text: A canvas strip of sketchy black-and-white people walking across the bottom of the screen. Characters enter from both sides at different depths and leave, so the crowd keeps cycling, with a small label centred above. A stark black background with a thick horizontal band of black-and-white line-drawn figures along the bottom edge. The people differ in hats, hair and posture, drawn at several depths so heads overlap, and a tiny grey label sits at the top centre. Each figure walks across the strip at its own pace with a slight bob, then leaves and respawns from the opposite side or another depth. The crowd keeps cycling so the band stays full. crowd figures, heads, label, rule
phrases: people walking across bottom of screen

items.name: canvas-fractal-grid
items.title: Fractal Dot Grid
items.blurb: A fine dot grid ripples and glows around the moving cursor.
items.use: You need a light, quiet page background with a little life that still leaves text readable.
items.text: A full-bleed grid of small blue dots over a soft pastel gradient, with a glowing halo and gentle wave that follow the pointer. A pale cream page is covered in tiny evenly spaced blue dots. Behind them a blurred pastel blob of pink, peach and lavender drifts, and a small bright blue halo marks the cursor. A soft glow trails the pointer, pushing nearby dots outward in a slow wave; the pastel gradient behind it also shifts colour over a long loop. dot grid, pastel gradient, cursor glow, noise overlay
phrases: dot grid that reacts to the mouse
subtle animated background for a landing page
blue dots over a pastel gradient
website background that follows the pointer

items.name: canvas-reveal-effect
items.title: Canvas Reveal Effect
items.blurb: Hovering fills a panel with a burst of tiny glowing dots.
items.use: A card or panel should reveal a rich particle texture only when the user points at it.
items.text: A shader effect that floods its container with a fine grid of dots spreading out from the middle. It appears on hover over a tinted wash and fades away when the pointer leaves. Invisible until revealed: then a square fills with a fine grid of tiny glowing dots that gather into a soft cloud near the centre and thin out toward the corners, tinted emerald, pink or blue over a dark wash. Pointing at the card makes the dots pop in from the middle outward in a quick burst, with a title fading in over them. Leaving the card fades the whole field back to an empty panel. dot grid, centre glow, tint wash, title text
phrases: dots that appear from the center
card that lights up with tiny dots

items.name: canvas-text
items.title: Canvas Text
items.blurb: A bold word filled with horizontal blue lines that ripple like a slow wave.
items.use: One phrase of a hero headline should feel alive and carry the eye without a full hero rebuild.
items.text: Fills part of a headline with a canvas pattern of thin horizontal lines in shifting blues. The lines bend in gentle sine waves and stay clipped inside the letters, animating on their own. The second half of a large bold headline, "living visuals", shown in blue and striped with closely spaced horizontal lines. The plain first line "Turn rough ideas into" sits above in white, and the striped bands bend in soft S-curves across the glyphs. The line bands slide and bow on a slow loop of several seconds, cycling between a few blue tones. Motion stays clipped to the letter shapes and runs on its own with no input or pause. headline, coloured word, wavy line bands
phrases: text with wavy lines inside letters
moving stripe fill on a word
liquid line text for a hero
striped accent word in a title

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.blurb: A dark node graph of an email workflow that pans as you scroll.
items.use: You need to show or edit a pipeline of steps as connected nodes on a pannable field.
items.text: A zoomable workflow canvas showing trigger, agent and tool steps connected by thin lines. Scrolling pans the field and clicking a node selects it. A near-black full-screen field holds five small bordered cards laid out left to right and branching. Each card has a tiny category, a title and a dim detail line, joined by faint curved connectors. The whole graph pans when the user scrolls, and dragging across empty space draws a selection box. Clicking a node adds a highlight ring around it. canvas, node card, node label, connector line, selection ring
phrases: visual pipeline with triggers and tools

items.name: card-field
items.title: Card Field
items.blurb: Card input where the number folds to its last four, opening room for expiry.
items.use: A checkout needs the card number, expiry and code in one compact row.
items.text: A single-row checkout field for card number, expiry and security code. The number groups as you type, then collapses to its last four so the other fields fit beside it. A dark rounded card holds a small Card heading, a Use test card link and one inset row with a brand badge, grouped digits, MM / YY and CVC, plus a hint line and a wide pay button below. Typing digits groups the number in fours, and a valid full number slides away to its last four while expiry and security code appear in the same row. The pay button shifts from a dim idle tone to white once the form is complete. card panel, brand badge, card number, expiry field, security code field, hint line, pay button
phrases: card number input with expiry and cvc
card number that shows last four digits
payment card form with brand logo
inline expiry and security code input

items.name: card-flip-physics
items.title: Card Flip (physics)
items.blurb: An event ticket you flick to spin, revealing a QR entry code on the back.
items.use: A ticket, pass or membership card should feel physical and reveal a code on its back.
items.text: A two-sided ticket card that turns over on a drag, a flick or the keyboard, with visible thickness and a moving band of light. The front lists event details; the back carries a QR code. A tall, dark ticket card with orange accents sits on black. The front shows Admit one, a GA badge, the event name in bold and small date, venue and holder details; the back shows a white QR code with gate, row and seat fields. Dragging the card spins it on its vertical axis and releasing lets a spring settle it flat on the nearer face. A highlight sweeps across the surface as it turns, and the floor shadow narrows edge-on. ticket face, orange badge, event title, detail grid, qr code, thick edge, floor shadow
phrases: flip card with front and back
card you drag to spin around

items.name: card-hover-effect
items.title: Card Hover Effect
items.blurb: Dark card grid where a soft grey backing fades in behind the card you hover.
items.use: Linking out to partners, projects or services where each needs a title and a line of copy.
items.text: A three-by-two grid of near-black cards, each with a short title, a few lines of grey copy and a link. Pointing at a card slides a rounded grey backing in behind it. A three-by-two grid of near-black rounded cards on a black stage, each holding a short bold title and a few lines of small grey text. Wide dark gaps separate the cards, which look flat until hovered. Pointing at a card fades a soft slate-grey rounded block in behind it, leaving a wider ring around the card edge while the others stay flat. Moving away fades the backing out. card, title, description, hover backdrop
phrases: grid of cards with glow on hover
card grid that lights up on hover
list of project links in cards
cards with title and short description

items.name: card-spotlight
items.title: Card Spotlight
items.blurb: Violet speckles and a soft spotlight bloom on a dark card under the cursor.
items.use: A feature or information card should feel interactive when explored with the pointer.
items.text: A rounded black information card whose surface lights up on hover. A soft radial light follows the pointer while a fine canvas of blue and purple dots spreads across the face. A rounded near-black card with a thin grey border, holding a bold white heading, a grey paragraph and three bullet lines marked by small indigo dots. On hover a field of tiny violet and blue speckles covers the surface. Moving the pointer lights the card with a soft spotlight that follows it, and a fine particle field appears across the face while hovered. Leaving fades the effect back to the plain dark card. card surface, border, heading, body copy, bullet list, spotlight, particle dots
phrases: card with a spotlight that follows the mouse
particle reveal on a content card
cursor spotlight over a black panel
card with a starry hover effect
mouse tracking light on a feature tile
blue dots appear when hovering a card

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.blurb: Quote cards fan into a pile and shuffle themselves every few seconds.
items.use: Customer quotes should rotate in a compact spot without arrows or dots taking space.
items.text: A small pile of dark quote cards with the front one at full size and the rest fanned behind, each slightly smaller and higher. On a timer the top card slips to the back so the deck keeps cycling. A stack of dark rounded cards on black with one in front and the edges of two or three fanned behind it. The front card holds a short quote with phrases picked out in emerald green, and a name and role at the bottom. Every two and a half seconds the front card drops to the back of the pile and the next rises to the front, growing back to full size, so the deck cycles through its quotes forever. There is no pause, drag or arrow. front card, stacked cards, quote text, highlighted phrase, name, role
phrases: deck of cards with hidden ones behind
cards that shuffle on a timer

items.name: card-swipe-deck
items.title: Card Swipe Deck
items.blurb: Tinder-style deck of travel cards that fly off with a SAVE stamp.
items.use: Users pick through items one at a time, liking or skipping, more playfully than a grid.
items.text: A stack of photo cards you drag left or right; past a threshold the top card tilts away with a coloured wash and a Save or Skip stamp, and the next slides forward. A portrait photo card with a place name and trip line sits atop a slightly offset stack on black. Three round buttons below offer a red X, a reset arrow and a green heart. Dragging the top card tilts it around a low pivot and blooms a green SAVE stamp or red Skip stamp with a matching colour wash. Releasing past the threshold throws it off and slides the stack forward; below it the card springs back. photo card, place name, trip line, stamp, card stack, action buttons
phrases: drag card to like or skip
deck of cards you can throw

items.name: cards-demo-1
items.title: Hover Overlay Card
items.blurb: A photo card whose background turns into a moving clip when hovered.
items.use: A feature tile should hint at motion only on hover while keeping its copy readable.
items.text: A tall photo card with a bold title and short paragraph pinned to the bottom. Hovering swaps the still fern backdrop for a muted moving clip and adds a dark scrim behind the words. A tall portrait card with rounded corners and a dark full-bleed photo, white bold heading "Background Overlays" and a small white paragraph pinned to the bottom left. At rest the photo is a close-up of fern fronds. Hovering replaces the still fern image with a looping clip of a person by a window and lays a dark scrim over it, while the text stays fixed. Leaving returns the fern photo and lifts the scrim. card, background media, heading, paragraph
phrases: card that plays a video on hover
hover reveals a gif behind text
background video card for a feature
dark card with caption at bottom

items.name: cards-demo-2
items.title: Author Blog Card
items.blurb: A blog card with an author row over a dim night-skyline photo.
items.use: A blog or editorial grid needs post cards that pair an author byline with a moody photo.
items.text: A tall editorial card with a night city skyline behind an avatar, author name and read time at the top, and a title with a short paragraph at the bottom. Hovering darkens the photo. A tall rounded card with a dark photo of a city waterfront at night behind a faint overlay. Top left holds a small round avatar beside "Manu Arora" and "2 min read", with the heading "Author Card" and a short paragraph at the bottom. Hovering deepens a black overlay across the photo so the skyline dims and the white text stands out. Nothing else moves, and leaving restores the lighter image. card, city photo, avatar, author name, read time, heading, paragraph
phrases: blog post card with author avatar
article card over a city photo
author byline card for a blog
dark image card with read time
editorial card with name and minutes

items.name: carousel-3d
items.title: Carousel 3D
items.blurb: A ring of photo cards rotates in 3D and follows a drag.
items.use: A portfolio or gallery wants to show many images as a browsable carousel with depth.
items.text: A draggable carousel that places image cards around an invisible circle in 3D space, tilts the ring and turns it slowly. Dragging spins it; releasing resumes the auto-spin. Rectangular photo cards stand around an unseen circle on a black stage, each tilted and angled like a ring seen from slightly above. Cards near the middle face forward while edge cards turn away in perspective. The whole ring turns slowly on its own. Pressing and dragging left or right spins it faster in that direction, and letting go restarts the steady rotation. photo card, ring, caption, drag surface

items.name: carousel-cards
items.title: Carousel Cards
items.blurb: Flick a rail of trip cards; it glides, tilts and snaps one card to centre.
items.use: A page should browse a set of destination or product cards without leaving the section.
items.text: A horizontal rail of travel listing cards with drawn landscape covers. The centred card shows its rating, dates and price, hearts save favourites, and the rail snaps between cards with momentum. A dark section header pairs a small eyebrow and the heading Weekend escapes with a 02/08 counter and two round arrow buttons. Tall 4:5 cards show flat mountain, dune or lake scenes in greys, each with a small white nights badge, a white heart and a title and location underneath. Dragging or flicking the rail carries momentum and springs to the nearest card, while edges rubber-band. As cards move they tilt in depth, the scene layers parallax and the centre card's rating, dates and price fade in; hearts fill red, arrows and keyboard step one card. rail header, card counter, arrow buttons, travel card, scene artwork, badge, heart button, card details
phrases: travel card rail you can flick
cards tilt and zoom toward the centre

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.blurb: Photo slides sit side by side, the chosen one bright with a title and button.
items.use: A handful of strong photos should sell a place or product and each deserves a caption and call to action.
items.text: A row of square photo slides where the selected one comes forward with its title over a dark tint and a white button, while its neighbours wait dimmed and tilted back. Four square landscape photos sit in a row on black; the front one is bright and full with white title text and a white rounded button near its centre, the others dimmer and slightly smaller. Two small round arrows sit below. Clicking an arrow or a side slide slides the row sideways over a second, bringing a new slide forward while the old one fades back. Moving the mouse over the front photo shifts it slightly for a parallax effect. photo slide, slide title, pill button, dimmed neighbour, previous arrow, next arrow
phrases: large picture slider for a landing page
slides with a caption and button
showcase travel photos one at a time

items.name: cart-button
items.title: Cart Button
items.blurb: Product list whose Add pills open into quantity steppers and a live total.
items.use: A short product list needs inline quantity control and a running total without a full cart page.
items.text: A compact cart of three grocery items with an Add button on each row. Pressing Add turns the button into a minus, count and plus, and the subtotal and checkout total update. A dark rounded panel lists three items, each with a tinted icon tile, name, price and detail, and a round pill button on the right. A footer row holds the subtotal and a white Checkout button. Pressing Add widens the pill into a minus, quantity and plus; holding either end repeats. The count rolls digit by digit and the subtotal and Checkout sum update, while a limit message appears at the maximum. cart panel, item row, icon tile, price line, add pill, stepper, subtotal, checkout button
phrases: add control that becomes a stepper
quantity picker on a product row

items.name: cascader
items.title: Cascader
items.blurb: A dropdown that drills through nested attribute levels with breadcrumbs.
items.use: The options form a hierarchy and a plain flat select would lose the parent context.
items.text: A single select for hierarchical data: the trigger opens a searchable list, and picking a branch replaces the list with its children while a breadcrumb shows the path. A slim outlined trigger reading Select an attribute with a chevron sits on black. Open, a rounded dark panel shows a search field, rows with small icons, counts and chevrons, and a breadcrumb above the nested list. Clicking the trigger drops the panel open; typing filters the current level, and selecting a branch with a chevron drills into its children while a back arrow and breadcrumb track the path. Choosing a leaf writes the full path into the trigger. trigger, chevron, search field, breadcrumb, result row, count, back arrow
phrases: choose a field from grouped options

items.name: category-bar
items.title: Category Bar
items.blurb: A stacked colour bar with a sliding marker that names the current score.
items.use: A value needs context against labelled ranges rather than a plain progress bar.
items.text: A single horizontal bar split into coloured ranges, with an optional marker and labels. It plots values like a credit score or storage usage against their bands. Thin segmented bars in pink, amber, lime and green sit inside dark cards, with small Poor to Excellent labels beneath. A slim white-ringed tick marks the current value and pops a small tooltip on hover. The marker glides to a new percentage when its value changes, and hovering it shows the exact figure in a small dark tooltip. Band colours are fixed per segment. segmented bar, segment, marker, tooltip, range labels, legend
phrases: single bar made of colored segments

items.name: caustics-background
items.title: Caustics Background
items.blurb: Headline floating over a rippling pool of light that stirs at the cursor.
items.use: A full-screen hero wants an atmospheric, interactive water surface behind its message.
items.text: A full-width hero backdrop painting moving pool-floor caustics, with a headline and buttons above. Moving the cursor or clicking sends ripples through the light. A deep teal field is covered by a bright, animated web of caustic lines. Centred white headline text, a small paragraph and two pill links sit above the water, softly shadowed. The caustic web drifts continuously, and the cursor leaves wakes of small rings while a click drops a larger ripple that bends the light. The headline's shadow sways with the same water. water background, caustic web, headline, paragraph, primary link, secondary link, ripples

items.name: changeable-pricing-section
items.title: Changeable Pricing Section
items.blurb: Plan picker with a monthly/yearly switch and features that unfold when picked.
items.use: A signup flow needs a compact plan chooser with billing period and inline feature detail.
items.text: A compact pricing card listing three plans as radio rows. A Monthly/Yearly switch springs across, prices roll, and the chosen plan expands to show its feature list. A dark rounded panel holds a Select a plan heading, a small segmented Monthly/Yearly switch and three stacked plan rows. Each row has a radio dot, plan name, description and a right-aligned price. Clicking the switch slides an orange pill and rolls each price to the other billing period. Selecting a plan fills its radio, tints its border orange and unfolds a dashed-top list of features inside that row. panel, heading, billing toggle, plan row, radio dot, price, feature list, continue button
phrases: select a plan card with features
choose a plan and see features

items.name: chart-area
items.title: Area Chart
items.blurb: A row of area charts with gradient, legend and step variants.
items.use: A dashboard needs several small area charts that stay readable in compact cards.
items.text: Three small analytics cards each holding an area chart of visitor numbers. Gradient and stacked fills sit beside a stepped version, and hovering a chart shows a tooltip. Three bordered dark cards sit side by side, each with a title, a grey area chart on faint horizontal gridlines and a small footer stat. Chart shapes differ: smooth filled humps, a two-tone stack and a blocky step line. Hovering over a chart reveals a small tooltip listing the month and values. The legend card's entries use dots, and the step chart holds each value flat before jumping. chart card, title, subtitle, area chart, gridlines, legend, tooltip, footer stat

items.name: chart-bar
items.title: Bar Chart
items.blurb: A trio of bar charts: paired columns, horizontal bars and negatives.
items.use: A dashboard needs a few compact bar charts to compare categories or months.
items.text: Three dark analytics cards showing bar charts: grouped monthly columns, horizontal browser bars and a chart with values below the baseline. Hovering shows a small tooltip. Three bordered dark cards sit side by side with grey bar charts. The first pairs narrow columns per month, the second runs long horizontal bars with browser names at left, the third has columns rising and falling around a zero line. Hovering a bar dims the rest and shows a small tooltip with the series and value. The negative chart tints values below zero in a lighter grey and keeps month names above each bar. chart card, title, subtitle, bar, axis label, tooltip, footer stat

items.name: chart-kit
items.title: Chart Kit
items.blurb: Bar and area charts with hatched columns and a glassy hover tooltip.
items.use: A dashboard wants a richer chart presentation than default bars, with texture and hover detail.
items.text: Two dark chart cards: monthly visitor bars pairing a blue gradient series with orange hatching, and a teal price area. Hovering shows a frosted tooltip with values. Two dark cards hold a twelve-month bar chart and a rising area chart. The bars alternate solid blue and diagonal orange hatching, while the area has a teal outline and fading teal fill over dotted gridlines. Bars grow in staggered from the baseline on load, and hovering a month dims the other columns and raises a frosted tooltip. The area chart draws a dashed cursor with a highlighted dot at the pointer. chart card, metric header, legend, bar, area line, area fill, gridlines, tooltip

items.name: chart-line
items.title: Line Chart
items.blurb: Three small line charts: multiple series, coloured dots and labels.
items.use: A dashboard needs small trend lines for one or two series with clear points.
items.text: A row of dark cards each holding a line chart. One plots two series, one marks each point in a colour, and one writes values above the dots. Three bordered dark cards sit side by side with thin grey line charts on faint horizontal gridlines. The first has two crossing lines, the second a line with coloured dots, the third a dotted line with number labels over each point. Hovering a point brings up a small tooltip with the month and series values, and the active dot grows. The labelled chart keeps its numbers above the dots at all times. chart card, title, subtitle, line, dot, value label, tooltip, footer stat

items.name: chart-pie
items.title: Pie Chart
items.blurb: Donut and pie charts with centre totals, labels and a month picker.
items.use: A dashboard needs to show a simple part-to-whole split in a compact card.
items.text: Three dark chart cards: a donut with a total in its hole, an interactive donut whose value changes with a month selector, and a pie with value labels on each slice. Three bordered dark cards hold grey pie charts. The first two are donuts with big centre numbers and a Visitors caption, the third a full pie with number labels around the rim. The sectors sweep in when the cards appear. Choosing a month in the second card re-highlights its slice and updates the centre number, while hovering any slice shows a tooltip. chart card, donut ring, centre total, slice, value label, month selector, tooltip
phrases: donut chart with total in the middle

items.name: chart-radar
items.title: Radar Chart
items.blurb: Six-sided spider plots compare monthly visitors across dark cards.
items.use: Comparing a few entities across the same fixed set of six to eight categories where the overall shape matters.
items.text: A row of dark cards, each holding a spider plot over six months with a spoke or ring grid, a pale filled area and month labels around the rim. Some cards add a two-item legend. Three dark rounded cards sit in a row, each with a small variant title and a caption line. A faint grey web of spokes or concentric rings sits over a pale filled six-point shape, with month labels around the edge. A footer pairs an up-trend arrow with a percentage and a date range. The plots do not move. Hovering a filled shape raises a small dark tooltip with the series label and its value for that month; otherwise the cards stay still. card, variant title, caption, radar grid, filled shape, month labels, legend, tooltip
phrases: compare categories on a circular grid
multi series spider plot with legend
graph that looks like a web
hover a point to see its value

items.name: chart-radial
items.title: Radial Chart
items.blurb: Hollow rings and half gauges hold visitor totals at their centre.
items.use: A single headline figure on a dashboard where a ring or gauge shows proportion instantly.
items.text: Three radial cards: a near-full ring, a half-circle gauge and a set of concentric browser bands, each with a large total in the middle and a footer trend line. Three dark rounded cards in a row. The left holds a hollow ring around a bold 200 and the word Visitors; the middle holds a half-circle gauge around 1,830 Visitors; the right packs several thin concentric rings with small browser names. Each card ends in a footer trend line and a caption. The arcs hold still. Hovering a ring or gauge raises a small dark tooltip naming the series and its visitor count, which is the only change across the frames. card, ring, centre total, half gauge, browser labels, footer trend, tooltip

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.blurb: Stacked revenue bars and two latency lines sit on paired dark cards.
items.use: A dashboard needs revenue bars plus a latency trend without hand-building axes, tooltips and legends.
items.text: A chart wrapper demo: a wide card of stacked monthly revenue bars with a two-item legend, and a narrow card of two smooth API latency lines across a week, both in grey on dark surfaces. Two dark rounded cards side by side. The wider one holds eight stacked grey bars climbing left to right over Jan to Aug, faint horizontal grid lines, month labels below and a small legend of two dots. The narrow card holds two pale curved lines over Mon to Sun, with its own legend. The charts hold still. Hovering a bar or line point opens a small dark tooltip listing each series and its value, and a faint vertical guide appears behind the hovered column. card, title, bar chart, line chart, axis labels, legend, tooltip
phrases: monthly revenue bars on dark card
api latency lines over a week
compare two series side by side

items.name: chat-coss
items.title: Chat
items.blurb: Rounded chat thread with reactions, quoted replies and a typing indicator.
items.use: You need a group conversation with replies, reactions and read state assembled from separate parts.
items.text: A dark group chat panel: an avatar stack header, a date pill and unread divider, incoming and outgoing bubbles with emoji reaction chips, quoted reply references, delivery ticks and a typing line above the composer. A tall dark panel with a header of overlapping avatars and the group name. Inside, short rounded grey bubbles sit left with tiny avatars and names, and right in a slightly lighter fill, with emoji chips underneath and a quoted block above one message. A rounded composer with a circular send button closes the bottom. Sending appends a right-aligned bubble whose small clock turns into a tick, and the thread scrolls to it. A New divider marks unseen messages, a Priya is typing line with dots sits before the composer, and reaction chips toggle on click. header, avatar stack, date pill, message bubble, reaction chip, reply reference, delivery tick, composer
phrases: quoted reply in a message bubble

items.name: chat-form-dropzone
items.title: Chat File Dropzone
items.blurb: Attach photos beside a paperclip and write a message underneath.
items.use: A message composer should let the sender attach a few pictures without leaving the bar.
items.text: A chat-style composer bar: a paperclip opens the picker, chosen images line up as thumbnails and a message box sits alongside. Four images of 1MB are the cap. A rounded dark bar with a thin border holding a paperclip button in a light square and a placeholder message line. Once images attach, small square thumbnails join the paperclip and the message field drops to a full-width second row. Picking or dropping images adds small square previews beside the paperclip, each with a remove X, and pushes the text field onto its own row. Clicking the paperclip opens the file picker. paperclip button, thumbnail, remove icon, message input, container border
phrases: type a message and attach images
paperclip upload in a message bar
send images with a short note
file attach next to a text box

items.name: checkbox-tree
items.title: Checkbox Tree
items.blurb: Nested categories where ticking a parent ticks all its children.
items.use: Users pick categories across a hierarchy, and ticking a parent should select everything below it.
items.text: A tree of category labels, each with a small square box, nested under thin indent rules. Ticking a parent selects everything beneath it, and a parent with only some children ticked shows a dash. A narrow dark list of light grey labels, each led by a small square box and stepped inward from its parent along a faint vertical rule. Ticked boxes are filled white with a dark mark; partly selected branches show a short dash. Clicking a box ticks it and every child under it, and clicking a full branch clears them all. A branch whose children are only partly ticked switches its own box to a dash. Nothing animates. root row, branch row, leaf row, checkbox, indent guide
phrases: tree of tick boxes for filters
folder list with squares to tick
partly selected parent shows a dash

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.blurb: Light square ticks a preference on, with a dash for partly on.
items.use: You need independent on and off choices, including one that is only partly selected across a group.
items.text: A small square checkbox with a tick, a dash for the mixed state, a focus ring and a faded disabled look, shown inside a card of account preferences with a label and a second line per row. A dark rounded card headed 'Account preferences' over four rows. Each row holds a small square box, a bold label and a dim second line. Checked boxes are filled light with a dark tick, the beta row shows a short dash, and the analytics row is faded. Clicking a box or its label toggles the tick with a short colour transition; checked boxes turn light, the partly-on option shows a dash, and the disabled row ignores clicks. Focus draws a ring around the box. card, heading, checkbox, label, description line, disabled row
phrases: tick box to agree to terms
square box you click to select
three state toggle with a dash
settings list with on off marks
select several options in a list
form row with a tick control

items.name: choice-poll
items.title: Choice Poll
items.blurb: Pick one answer, then the rows fill to show the vote split.
items.use: You want a one-question vote on the page and to show the split once the visitor answers.
items.text: A one-question poll: a heading and description over four radio rows. Choosing one locks the vote and turns every row into a bar with its share, a percentage and the total count. A dark card holds a bold question, a small muted sentence, and four stacked rounded rows with thin outlines. Each row starts with a circular marker and a label; after voting a soft fill grows from the left of each row and a percentage sits at the right. Hovering lights a row's border and background. Clicking one fills its marker with a tick, disables the rows, and reveals results: each bar grows to its share, percentages count up, and a footer shows the total votes and a "You voted" mark. question heading, description, option row, radio marker, result bar, percentage, vote total
phrases: vote for one option in a poll
choose one answer then see totals

items.name: chromatic-image
items.title: Chromatic Image
items.blurb: Mountains tear into red, green and blue ghosts as the pointer moves.
items.use: A hero or feature image needs a tactile, pointer-reactive treatment that makes a still photo feel physical.
items.text: A landscape photo on a rounded canvas that warps into horizontal bands and splits into shifted colour copies under the pointer, tilting in 3D and easing back when the pointer leaves. A wide rounded photo of snowy peaks above a sea of cloud at dawn, with a dark gradient washing the lower edge. Small tracked capital letters and a white headline sit at the bottom left, a quiet hint at the bottom right, and the whole frame leans slightly. Moving the pointer warps the picture in horizontal bands, offsets the red, green and blue channels and tilts it toward the cursor. Leaving the frame lets it settle back flat and sharp. image, vignette gradient, eyebrow text, headline, distortion hint

items.name: circling-elements
items.title: Circling Elements
items.blurb: Six square photos drift around an empty centre, pausing under the cursor.
items.use: A portfolio or gallery wants a playful, always-moving arrangement of thumbnails around a focal blank space.
items.text: Small square images spaced evenly on an invisible ring orbit a blank middle at a steady speed; hovering the group freezes the motion and each tile enlarges. Six small square photos of a pug, blossom, dune, flower, snowy peak and a dark figure float in a loose circle on a black stage. Their spacing is even, the middle is empty, and there are no frames or labels around them. The set turns continuously around the centre at a constant rate. Resting the pointer anywhere on the group stops the orbit, and the hovered photo grows slightly; leaving resumes the spin. photo tiles, orbit ring, centre gap

items.name: circuit-board
items.title: Circuit Board
items.blurb: Glowing circuit traces feed a Powered By chip above three tech cards.
items.use: A developer product wants a technology or integration section with a schematic feel and named cards below.
items.text: A dark band of hairline circuit traces with coloured pulses converging on a raised Powered By chip, over three rounded cards that fade in with icons and short descriptions. Fine right-angled circuit traces spread across the top half of a black stage, a few of them tinted orange, blue and pink. They meet at a small raised grey chip lettered Powered By. Below sit three dark rounded cards, each with a coloured icon, a title and an arrow, then two or three lines of grey copy. Bright dots and gradient pulses run along the traces toward and away from the chip on endless loops. The cards rise and sharpen into place in sequence, and each card carries a slow pulsing border glow that lifts on hover. circuit traces, colour pulses, Powered By chip, tech cards, icon, title, description

items.name: clerk-otp
items.title: Animated OTP Card
items.blurb: Six code cells fill themselves one digit at a time with cyan glows.
items.use: A sign-in or two-factor screen needs a lively placeholder or hero for the verification-code step.
items.text: A small dark verification card with six code boxes that type a random number into one cell after another, glow cyan on the current cell, flash together and repeat. A rounded dark card with six square cells in a row near the top, each a subtle gradient tile holding a pale grey digit. The active cell has a cyan outline and inner glow. A small white title and two lines of grey copy sit at the lower left. A random six-digit code types itself in, advancing about every 400ms; the current cell glows cyan, the whole row flashes once the last digit lands, then the digits fade and the loop starts again after a pause. card, code cell, digit, active glow, title, description
phrases: pin code boxes with cyan glow

items.name: clip-path-carousel
items.title: Clip Path Carousel
items.blurb: A photo strip where the centred slide unclips to full height with its caption.
items.use: A gallery should keep a row of images in view while making the current one the clear focus.
items.text: A horizontal carousel of tall photographs on black. The centred slide opens to its full height and fades in a title, while the slides either side stay clipped shorter; arrows and dots move between them. A row of portrait photographs with rounded corners on a black stage, each separated by wide gaps. The centred image is noticeably taller and carries a small grey caption beneath it, while its neighbours are cropped top and bottom; arrows and a row of dots sit below. Switching slides animates a clip inset so the outgoing image shrinks back to a short band and the new one opens fully, its title fading up from a blur. Arrows, dots, dragging or autoplay move it along. photo slides, caption, previous arrow, next arrow, pagination dots
phrases: photo carousel with active slide larger
images that unclip as you scroll

items.name: clip-trimmer
items.title: Clip Trimmer
items.blurb: Drag orange handles along a filmstrip to choose the seconds you keep.
items.use: A clip, recording or media file needs a quick in and out point before upload or export.
items.text: A video trimming card with a preview image, a ten-frame filmstrip and a ruler. Two orange handles set the start and end of the kept clip, dimming what gets cut, and a playhead loops over the selection. A dark rounded card holding a wide mountain preview in a rounded frame, with a timestamp pill and a round play button on it. Beneath sits a thin filmstrip crossed by two orange handles, a small ruler labelled in seconds, and a kept-length line. Dragging a handle narrows or widens the kept range, snapping to whole seconds and dimming the trimmed footage; dragging between the handles slides the whole clip. The playhead loops inside the selection, and Reset restores the full length. preview image, timestamp pill, play button, filmstrip, trim handles, ruler, kept length

choose a section of a video

items.name: cloud-shader
items.title: Cloud Shader
items.blurb: Soft white clouds drift across a blue sky behind whatever sits on it.
items.use: A landing section or app shell needs a calm moving sky as a backdrop with content layered on top.
items.text: A full-bleed animated sky with layered procedural clouds drifting past a sunlit haze, used as a backdrop that holds any centred content. A pale blue sky deepens toward the top and turns hazy near the horizon, filled with soft white clouds of several sizes. Nearest clouds show bright sunlit tops and grey underbellies, with a faint warm glow high on the right and thin cirrus streaks above. Clouds drift sideways at different speeds in parallax layers, wrapping around the edges and bobbing gently, while thin high streaks slide more slowly. The loop runs forever and ignores the pointer; overlaid content stays fixed. sky, clouds, sun haze, headline, buttons

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block

items.text: A dark block that prints source code with numbered lines and colour highlighting, a filename row with a copy icon, and optional file tabs for switching between snippets. Two rounded slate-black panels stack with a small gap, each holding numbered lines of code in soft yellow, blue and white monospace. The upper panel shows a filename and a small copy icon; the lower one shows two file tabs. Clicking a file tab swaps the code in the panel, one tab turning white and the other grey. items.name: code-comparison
items.title: Code Comparison
items.blurb: Old and new code sit side by side with red and green lines.
items.use: Show a refactor or migration as an old and new snippet side by side.
items.text: A two-pane code viewer that shows an earlier snippet on the left and its rewrite on the right, with removed lines tinted red and added lines tinted green. Two tall code panels share one thin-bordered dark frame. Each has a small header reading api.ts plus before or after, and a square VS badge sits between them at the centre. Code is set in a dim monospace, with a few rows washed red on the left and green on the right. Static: the panes do not move. Hovering one side fades and blurs the lines that are not marked as the focus of the change. pane header, code pane, VS badge, line tint

two code snippets next to each other

items.name: code-slots
items.title: Code Slots
items.blurb: Six code boxes that spring each digit in, then flash a tick on success.
items.use: A sign-in or two-factor screen needs a short numeric code entered quickly, including paste and SMS autofill.
items.text: A one-time code field split into individual rounded slots. Digits spring into place as you type or paste, the caret follows along, and a full code can show a success wash with a tick or drain away on error. A rounded dark card with a heading, a line naming the email address, and six rounded square slots in a row. Filled slots turn pale with dark digits, the active one glows, and a small resend line sits below. Typing a digit drops it into the current slot with a spring and moves the caret forward; pasting fills every remaining slot. A correct code opens into a white bar with a tick, while a wrong one drains the digits back out. heading, email line, code slots, digits, caret, resend line, success tick

items.name: code-tabs-animate
items.title: Code Tabs
items.blurb: Package-manager tabs swap install commands inside a dark code panel.
items.use: Documentation shows one install step for several package managers and readers need to copy the right one.
items.text: A compact code block with pnpm, npm, yarn and bun tabs; picking one moves the active underline and fades in that manager's install commands, with a copy button on the right. A slim dark rounded panel. Four lowercase tab labels sit across the top with a thin white underline under the active one and a small copy icon at the far right. Below, five short lines of small monospace commands, some words tinted blue or purple. Clicking a tab fades and blurs the old snippet out and the new one in while the underline moves to the chosen label. The copy button briefly swaps to a tick after copying. tab bar, tab label, active underline, copy button, code lines

items.name: code-tabs-mdx
items.title: Code Tabs MDX
items.blurb: Two install commands in tabs, with a copy icon on each line.
items.use: A setup step differs between tools and the reader needs to copy the matching command fast.
items.text: A slim dark code card that shows a single install command under two tab labels, so a reader can switch between variants and copy the one they need. A small dark grey rounded card with two tiny tab labels sitting along its top edge, one ringed by a thin outline. Below is one line of monospace text led by a faint dollar sign, with a small copy icon at the far right. Choosing a tab name changes the outlined label and replaces the command line underneath. The copy icon writes the command to the clipboard and turns into a tick for about a second. tab label, tab strip, command line, dollar sign, copy icon

code block with copy to clipboard

items.name: color-picker

items.text: An outline button showing the current colour opens a panel with a saturation-lightness square, a rainbow hue slider, an editable colour value and twelve preset dots. A small dark pill shows a round colour dot, an hsl value and a chevron. Opened, a dark card sits above with a bright gradient square, a slim rainbow strip, a value field and two rows of round preset colours. Clicking the swatch opens the panel with a quick scale; dragging in the square or along the hue strip updates the chosen colour live, and any preset applies instantly with a tick. swatch button, colour chip, value label, chevron, colour square, hue slider, value field, preset dots

items.name: colourful-text
items.title: Colourful Text
items.blurb: Each letter of a big heading pulses its own bright colour.
items.use: A short, playful headline should grab attention, such as a tagline or friendly greeting.
items.text: A short phrase drawn one letter at a time, each character in a vivid rotating colour that bounces, swells and briefly blurs, with the palette reshuffling every few seconds. A single bold sans-serif phrase on black, about one line wide, every letter a different saturated colour running from green through blue, purple and magenta to orange. Letters bounce up a few pixels, swell slightly and blur in and out on a staggered wave, then settle. Every five seconds the colours reshuffle and the whole word animates again. phrase, letter, colour

playful title for a kids site

items.name: comet-card
items.title: Comet Card
items.blurb: A portrait card tips in 3D and a white glare follows the cursor.
items.use: A single featured card such as a portrait, invite or product should feel physical under the pointer.
items.text: A dark portrait card that leans and shifts in 3D under the pointer while a soft white spotlight trails across its surface and the frame lifts slightly. A narrow dark card holds a portrait photo of a head against a blue backdrop, with a small mono footer reading 'Comet Invitation' and '#F7RA'. The card floats on black with a heavy soft shadow. As the pointer moves over the card it tilts toward the cursor, slides a little the same way, scales up and lifts, while a white radial glare tracks the pointer. premium card hover for a portfolio

items.name: comet-dial
items.title: Comet Dial
items.blurb: A radial dial you drag or flick, with a comet streak behind the value.
items.use: A dashboard or media control wants a compact, tactile dial instead of a straight slider.
items.text: A circular control open at the bottom, showing a large number inside and a coloured arc from the start to the current value. Dragging or flicking the arc changes the value with a springy overshoot, and a comet tail trails the moving handle. Two open-ring dials side by side on black, each with a faint full arc and a bright coloured arc ending in a small round handle. A large light number sits in the middle with a smaller unit, and the rings are open at the bottom. Dragging around the arc follows the pointer, and releasing with speed flicks the value on and springs it back with a small overshoot at the ends. items.name: comic-text
items.title: Comic Text

items.use: A playful banner or game screen wants a loud comic-book shout.
items.text: A single word rendered as a loud comic-book caption, in yellow halftone letters with a thick black outline, red and black drop shadows and a slight lean, popping in on a spring. The word KABOOM! fills the middle of a black stage in chunky uppercase comic lettering. The letters are yellow filled with fine red dots, edged in heavy black, cast with an offset black shadow plus a thin red one, and tilted slightly to the right. The word springs in from a little smaller and tilted, overshoots slightly and settles upright, then holds still. comic letters, dot pattern, black outline, drop shadow

items.name: command-button
items.title: Command Button
items.blurb: Its shortcut is drawn as real keycaps that sink when you press the keys.
items.use: A primary action has a memorable shortcut and you want it discoverable on the button itself.
items.text: A small action button with its keyboard shortcut shown as raised keycaps. Pressing the combination anywhere on the page pushes each cap down and fires the button, and a caption can report what happened. Three light-grey rounded buttons sit in a row on black, each with a dark label and a cluster of tiny raised keycaps for its shortcut. A thin grey caption line runs underneath. Each keycap stands a couple of pixels above the button and drops flush while its key is held, so the caps move in time with the real keyboard. When the whole combination matches, the button clicks and the caption below updates; hovering and pressing the button also darken it. button surface, button label, modifier keycap, letter keycap, caption

keycaps that press down with the keyboard
button fired from a keyboard shortcut
hotkey hint beside a button label

items.name: command
items.title: Command Palette
items.blurb: A dark command palette with grouped shortcuts and a search field.
items.use: A keyboard-first app wants one searchable menu for navigation, actions and shortcuts.
items.text: A modal command menu with a search box, grouped actions and a shortcut key at the right of each row. Typing filters the list down and the first match is highlighted. A dark grey rounded panel on black, topped by a search icon and a placeholder line. Below, two small grey group labels, Suggestions and Settings, separate six white rows, each ending in a tiny outlined shortcut key; the active row is slightly lighter. Typing in the search field filters the rows live; one frame shows a single Billing result under Settings. The first match is selected by default, arrow keys move the highlight, and choosing an item or pressing escape closes the dialog. search field, group heading, command row, shortcut key, panel surface, dialog backdrop

items.name: commit
items.title: Commit

items.text: A compact commit card with avatar, message, short hash, author and relative time, plus a copy button; clicking the header reveals each changed file with an A/M/D/R status and green or red line counts. A dark rounded card. The top row pairs a round MC avatar with a bold message line and a smaller line holding a commit glyph, short hash, author and time, with a copy icon at the right. Below a divider, five file rows each show a coloured status letter, file icon, monospace path and green plus or red minus counts. The header acts as a button that collapses or expands the file list, dimming slightly on hover. Rows tint under the pointer, and the copy icon swaps to a tick for a moment after the hash is copied. avatar, commit message, hash, author, timestamp, copy button, file row, change counts

items.name: comp-100
items.title: Hamburger Menu Button

A square icon button with rounded corners and a thin light outline sits on a near-black stage. Three short white horizontal bars are centred inside, evenly spaced. The button keeps the same size while the icon inside changes. At rest the button shows three stacked bars. A click rotates and slides them into an X over about a third of a second with a slight overshoot; a second click returns them to bars. icon button, top bar, middle bar, bottom bar

animated close button for slide out nav
button to show and hide navigation

items.name: comp-103
items.title: Pill Vote Buttons

A wide white pill sits on a near-black stage, its three sections divided by faint seams and the outer ends fully round. A dark chevron points up on the left, the score "235" sits in bold in the centre, and a matching chevron points down on the right. Hovering either chevron darkens its section of the pill and pressing darkens it further, giving vote feedback; the count itself stays fixed. items.name: comp-105

A small square dark button with a soft outline holds a thin copy glyph on a near-black stage. When hovered a grey rounded tooltip reading "Click to copy" floats above it, and a dim caption sits below. Hovering shades the button and opens the tooltip. add copy affordance to any value

items.name: comp-107

Four light-grey rounded squares sit in a row on a near-black stage, separated by thin seams. Each holds a small white glyph of stacked lines arranged left, centred, right or justified, with the active tile a brighter white than the rest. items.name: comp-118
items.title: Star Count Button

Inside, a thin outlined star, the bold word Star in near-black and a smaller grey count sit in one evenly spaced row. The button stays still; only its surface reacts. Hovering shifts the light fill toward grey and pressing deepens it, then it settles back to off-white. button, star icon, label, count

items.name: comp-122
items.title: Social Login Branded Buttons
items.blurb: Four solid brand-coloured login buttons, one provider per row.

items.name: container-text-flip
items.title: Container Text Flip
items.blurb: A word swaps out letter by letter inside a slab that resizes to fit.
items.use: A hero or section headline should cycle a few adjectives to keep an otherwise static page alive.
items.text: An animated headline that cycles through a list of words. Each word blurs in letter by letter while the slab behind it smoothly changes width. A short white headline sits above a raised rounded slab on a dark stage. The slab has a subtle slate gradient, a thin inset edge and a soft shadow, and holds one large bold white word. Its width grows and shrinks with the word. Every few seconds the word swaps for the next in the list: new letters blur in one after another, the slab eases out or in to the new width, and old letters blur away. It loops endlessly. headline, rounded slab, word, letters

items.name: context-menu-animated

items.text: A browser-style right-click menu with shortcut hints, a More Tools submenu, bookmark checkboxes and a people radio group; rows animate in sequence and the highlight glides between them. A small dark rounded menu with a translucent frosted panel. One column lists Back, Forward and Reload with shortcut glyphs, More Tools with a chevron, two bookmark toggles with ticks, then a People label and two people rows with a tick. A faint Right click here hint sits behind. Right-clicking opens the menu near the pointer with a staggered blur-and-scale reveal, and the row highlight glides as the pointer moves. items.name: contextual-ai-bar

items.text: A narrow dark pill with a music and a sparkle button on the left; the sparkle expands it into a prompt field with a send arrow while four tool icons slide away, and the music button collapses it again. A slim dark pill on black. Its left end holds a smaller pill with two round icon buttons, a music note and a sparkle, one on a grey active disc. Collapsed, four outline icons are spaced along the right; expanded, a prompt field fills the middle and a round arrow caps the right. Clicking the sparkle grows the pill, fades the tool icons out and reveals a focused text input with the send arrow; clicking the music note reverses it. tool icons beside a text box

items.name: continuous-pagination

Nine rounded square buttons in a row on black: a chevron-left, five numbered tiles and a chevron-right. The active number sits on a darker, slightly proud tile with a highlighted top edge, soft drop shadow and a faint sheen, while the other tiles stay flat grey with muted digits. Clicking a number or an arrow springs the raised tile to the new page, lifting and settling into place. A large thin ring frames a bright white core, circled by flatter pink and violet hoops, with small glowing orbs and a pale crystal near the middle. Two coloured buttons sit under the panel. A two-line white headline on black, with the final two words enclosed in a dark rectangle. Four small dim dots mark the box corners, and thin horizontal lines and a scatter of white specks appear across the words when active. Drag one letter sideways or brush it with the cursor and a knock runs along the row, then the letters swing down and settle. One large bold white word sits on a near-black stage, each letter suspended by a hairline thread from a thin horizontal rail above it. The letters are tightly tracked and level at rest, with a small grey caption centred underneath. Letters behave as pendulums hung from the rail: pull one to the side and it swings back, clipping its neighbour and passing the knock along until the far letter kicks out. Three tall media panels sit side by side on a white card. Each is clipped to a different lumpy, scalloped outline rather than a rectangle: left a red-toned photo of hands and a vintage camera, middle a bright broccoli head on deep blue, right a pale sepia building scene with a camera. A tall dark monospace card. A small Credits Used label over a large 56.4% sits beside a two-line caption and a tiny green toggle.
