One large rounded photo sits centred on a black stage, with two or three more cards stepped behind it to the right, each smaller and hazier. Small round arrow buttons flank the stage and a row of tiny dots rests at the bottom centre. Cards glide along the rail with a springy ease, the new front image sharpening as the old ones sink back. Dragging follows the pointer and flicks to the nearest card; scrolling, clicking a card, the arrows and the dot row all advance it. photo card, rear cards, arrow buttons, dot indicators
phrases: image carousel with blurred rear cards
picture rail with arrows and dots

items.name: depth-text
items.title: Depth Text
items.blurb: Heavy white letters extrude back into lavender layers and tilt in space.
items.use: A single large word in a hero or title slide that needs weight and a sense of dimension.
items.text: A single word built from dozens of stacked copies: a bright white face with a thick pale purple side behind it. It turns slowly on its own and leans with the pointer. The word fills the stage in very heavy white sans-serif with tight spacing, edge lit against near-black. Behind the face, many faint lavender copies offset upward and to the side build a deep solid wall, grounded by a soft purple shadow. The word orbits slowly in perspective, so the purple side sweeps from one edge to the other. Moving the pointer tips the whole block toward or away from the cursor, and releasing leaves it to its slow drift again. letter faces, depth layers, drop shadow
phrases: thick blocky letters for a hero

items.name: design-testimonials
items.title: Design Testimonials
items.blurb: A giant ghosted number backs an oversized quote that rotates.
items.use: A marketing page wants social proof presented as a bold editorial moment rather than plain cards.
items.text: An editorial testimonial rotator: one large quote at a time, a soft oversized index behind it, a company badge, author line and arrow buttons. Quotes swap on a timer and words fade in one by one. A near-black panel holds a faint oversized numeral on the left, a vertical label and thin progress bar at the far left, and a large pale quote across the middle. Below sit a small pill badge, an author name and role, two round arrow buttons and a faint row of company names. Every few seconds the quote, badge and author swap, with each word flipping up into place and the big numeral changing. Arrows step forward and back while a thin line fills as progress; the company ticker drifts endlessly. index numeral, vertical title, progress bar, company badge, quote, author row, arrow buttons, ticker

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.blurb: Dark rotary knob clicks through degrees of temperature.
items.use: A single numeric setting such as temperature or volume deserves a precise, tactile dial instead of a plain range slider.
items.text: A circular temperature dial with a ring of ticks around a large knob. Turning it snaps from notch to notch, flicks coast and settle, and the big readout rolls its digits as the value changes. On a black stage, a large dark circular knob with a thin rim and a short white indicator line sits inside a 270-degree ring of radial ticks, one glowing orange at the current value. Inside the knob Temperature sits above a big white readout, with 16.0° and 30.0° at the lower corners. Dragging around the knob turns the value, snapping toward each notch and coasting briefly after a flick before settling. Scroll-wheel and arrow keys step it, double-click returns to the default, and the readout's digits roll over as the number changes. tick ring, knob, indicator line, temperature label, value readout, end labels
phrases: turn a knob to set a value

items.name: dia-text-reveal
items.title: Dia Text Reveal
items.blurb: A colour band wipes across a rotating word in a headline.
items.use: A rotating tagline word should get a flash of colour each time it appears.
items.text: A heading whose trailing word changes between phrases while a multicoloured band sweeps across it, revealing each new word with a brief rainbow shine. The words Crafted with in bold white, followed by a single word on the same line. While a word appears, its letters are painted by a travelling band of pink, red, amber, lilac and blue. A gradient band slides left to right over the trailing word, uncovering it in colour; once past, the word rests in plain white, then fades out and the next phrase is revealed the same way. heading text, changing word, colour band
phrases: word that changes in a headline
text reveal with a light bar

items.name: dialog-default
items.title: Dialog Default
items.blurb: A small profile-edit card fades in over the page when you click.
items.use: A short two-field edit should happen in place without a full settings page.
items.text: A modal with a short edit-profile form: two labelled text fields and one wide save button, plus a close X. It fades up over a blurred backdrop. A pill-shaped light button labelled Open Dialog on black. Opened, a dark rounded card holds the heading Edit profile, a grey help line, two right-aligned labels with wide dark input fields, and a full-width pale button at the foot, plus an X. Clicking the trigger fades and slides the card in over a dim blurred page; the wide bottom button, the X, a backdrop click or Escape dismisses it. The name field shows an edited value in one frame. trigger button, dialog card, heading, help text, name field, username field, save button, close icon
phrases: edit profile popup with two fields
open a dialog to change details
centered form dialog over a page
quick edit window with one save button

items.name: dialog-stack
items.title: Dialog Stack
items.blurb: Multi-step dialogs stack up, older steps peeking behind the top one.
items.use: A short multi-step task such as workspace setup, checkout or invites should keep earlier steps visible and one tap away.
items.text: A three-step flow where each new dialog appears in front of the last, leaving earlier steps stacked behind as narrow edges you can click to go back. Steps move with Back and Continue buttons. A dimmed black backdrop holds a centered stack of dark bordered cards. Only the top card shows its content; earlier steps appear as thin rounded edges beneath it, each slightly narrower and lower. Cards hold a title, a small step note, fields or a list, and Back and Continue buttons at the bottom. The Create workspace button opens step 1 over a fading overlay. Continue brings the next step to the front and pushes the current card into the stack, while Back reverses it; clicking a stacked edge behind the top card jumps back to that step. Each change is a short fade and slide. overlay, dialog card, title, description, step content, footer buttons, stacked edges
phrases: wizard with cards behind each other

items.name: dialog
items.title: Animated Dialog
items.blurb: A dark confirm card fades over the page with two 50/50 buttons.
items.use: An action is destructive or costly and needs one clear stop before it runs.
items.text: A compact confirmation dialog with a heading, a warning paragraph and a bright primary button paired with an outlined cancel. It fades and slides in over a blurred dark page. A small dark button labelled Delete project on a near-black page; opened, a rounded dark card floats over a black wash holding a heading, two lines of grey body text, a bright Confirm button and an outlined Cancel, with a small X at the top right. Clicking the button fades the backdrop and slides the card up a little; the X, Cancel, a backdrop click or Escape closes it with the same fade. trigger button, dimmed backdrop, dialog card, heading, body text, close icon, confirm button, cancel button

items.name: direction-aware-hover
items.title: Direction Aware Hover
items.blurb: Photo cards that nudge and reveal a caption based on your entry side.
items.use: A gallery of people or destinations where captions should stay hidden until someone points at a card.
items.text: Square image cards on a black page. Entering one from a side shifts the photo and its caption a little in opposite directions, darkens the picture and fades in a white label at the bottom-left. Three square rounded image cards on black: a black-and-white swirl of contour lines, a bright office interior and a sky full of clouds. Each sits flat at rest, and a hovered one carries a dark veil with a small white label at its bottom-left. Entering a card from above, below, left or right nudges the image and the overlay text a few pixels in opposite directions, fades in a dark veil and reveals the label. Leaving reverses it. photo card, image, dark veil, label, subtitle
phrases: image card that reveals text on hover
photo reacts to which side cursor enters
gallery cards that darken on hover
text appears when hovering a photo

items.name: direction-aware-tabs
items.title: Direction Aware Tabs
items.blurb: A sliding pill marks the chosen tab and swaps the copy.
items.use: A compact section needs to switch between two to four short pieces of content.
items.text: A dark pill-shaped bar holds three tabs, with a lighter cap that springs to whichever is chosen. The panel beneath swaps its heading and copy with a sideways slide and a soft blur. A dark rounded panel holds a pill-shaped tab bar with three labels: Design, Develop and Deploy. The chosen tab wears a lighter rounded cap, and a centred heading with two lines of grey copy sits below. Clicking a tab sends the lighter pill sliding to it and swaps the panel text, which flies in from the side and blurs into focus. The panel height settles to fit the new copy. tab bar, active pill, tab labels, heading, body copy, panel
phrases: segmented control with a moving pill
tab switcher with a directional slide
ios style segmented tabs for the web
dark tab bar with pill background

items.name: directional-drawer
items.title: Directional Drawer
items.blurb: A dark settings drawer slides in from the left edge of the screen.
items.use: Secondary navigation should open over the page without shifting the layout.
items.text: A left-side slide-in panel with a small nav list and one call-to-action button at its base. Opening it dims the page behind, and the X or an outside click closes it. A dark panel fixed to the left of the frame, roughly 450px wide, with a white X at the top right, a bold heading, a line of grey helper text, four stacked nav links and a full-width light button pinned to the bottom. Clicking Open Drawer slides the panel in from the left while the rest of the page dims and blurs; the X, a click outside or Escape slides it back out. On narrow screens a drag handle replaces the X. trigger button, side panel, heading, helper text, nav link, close icon, bottom button
phrases: panel slides in from the side
menu that covers part of the page
pop out sidebar with close button
slide over panel for mobile nav

items.name: distorted-glass
items.title: Distorted Glass
items.blurb: A frosted, rippled glass band sits across the bottom edge.
items.use: A scrolling gallery needs a soft frosted fade at its bottom edge so images dissolve into the frame.
items.text: A short strip of frosted glass with a rippled surface, pinned over the bottom of a scrolling image feed. It warps and blurs whatever passes underneath and lets scrolling pass through. A narrow band along the bottom of a photo card looks like rippled frosted glass, smearing the image behind it into soft waves and glowing where the photo is warm. Above it, sharp stacked photos carry white captions. Static: nothing moves on its own. Whatever scrolls behind the strip is bent by the glass, and the strip ignores the pointer so the feed keeps scrolling under it. glass strip, rippled surface, thin border
phrases: rippled glass edge on a scrolling feed
blurred distortion at the bottom of a card
water ripple effect over a photo
frosted bottom bar for a feed
rippled glass panel over a gallery

items.name: dither-chart
items.title: Dither Chart
items.blurb: Charts drawn from coloured dither dots with tabbed variants.
items.use: A dashboard wants a distinctive pixel-art chart style instead of a standard smooth line or solid bar chart.
items.text: A chart card that renders bar, line, donut or funnel views from packs of tiny coloured dots, giving each fill a pixelated halftone texture. Switching a tab redraws the chart in front of you. A dark rounded card headed by a small grey revenue caption and a big white $742k figure, with a rounded tab bar of Bar, Line, Donut and Funnel at the top right. Beneath, the plot is made of tight grids of small coloured dots in magenta, cyan, yellow and green, arranged as bars, stacked bands or a ring. Selecting another tab swaps the chart type and redraws it from nothing over about a second, the dots filling in across the plot. Bars rise from the baseline, area bands grow, and the donut sweeps its slices into place, all holding a dithered halftone texture. caption, total figure, variant tabs, plot, dither dots

items.name: dither-field
items.title: Dither Field
items.blurb: Purple dithered light haze that brightens under the pointer.
items.use: A landing page wants a rich animated backdrop that feels technical and reacts to the cursor without heavy artwork.
items.text: A full-bleed background of purple light rendered as crisp square dots, glowing like a horizon and blooming around the mouse. It can also dither an image or video, and it holds overlaid page content. A full-width dark stage washed in purple light that reads as a horizon glow, brightening to near-white near the bottom centre. The surface is built from tiny square dithered dots rather than smooth gradients, densest where the light is brightest, with a loose band of haze across the middle. The glow drifts and flickers slowly on its own and brightens strongly around the mouse, pen or a held finger, easing back after the pointer. It pauses when scrolled out of view or when the tab is hidden; the demo centres a headline, paragraph and two buttons over it. dot field, horizon glow, pointer bloom, overlaid heading, buttons

items.name: dither-image
items.title: Dither Image
items.blurb: Photos turned into coarse dot patterns, wiped clean by the pointer.
items.use: You want a printed, retro dot-screen look, or a playful wipe between colour and dithered versions.
items.text: A figure that renders an image as a black-and-white Bayer dither, plus a reveal variant where a clean copy is wiped across the dot pattern as the pointer moves. Two square photos sit side by side on black. The left pug is fully rendered as a coarse black-and-white dot screen; the right mountain photo mixes clean colour with a dotted patch, split along a soft vertical edge. Tiny grey captions sit below. One photo stays fully dithered. Moving the pointer across the second wipes the boundary between the clean image and its dotted copy, and leaving resets it to the middle. pug photo, mountain photo, dither dots, reveal mask, captions
phrases: photo with retro dot pattern effect
halftone style picture for a website
cursor wipes photo to reveal colour

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.blurb: Tiny white dots twinkle across a dark, edge-faded field.
items.use: A dark hero or panel wants gentle texture and depth behind its text.
items.text: A dotted backdrop for dark sections where each dot slowly breathes brighter and fades again on its own timing, and the whole field dissolves into black at the edges. A near-black stage covered in a regular field of tiny white dots that thins to black toward the edges. A large white heading and two centred grey lines of copy sit over the dots. Individual dots slowly swell and brighten before shrinking back, each on its own random delay and duration, so the field twinkles instead of beating in unison. dot field, glowing dots, edge fade

items.name: dotmatrix-loaders
items.title: Dotmatrix Loaders
items.blurb: A grid of glowing dot-matrix loaders in many shapes and hues.
items.use: A product wants a set of coordinated loading indicators that share a dot-matrix look across several colours.
items.text: A collection of nineteen small loading indicators, each a grid of glowing dots arranged as a square, circle, triangle, hexagon or 3x3 block. They animate with sweeps, ripples, spirals and gradient blooms. A dark grid of small rounded-square cards, each holding a tiny matrix of dots and a short uppercase caption underneath. Dots glow in white, blue, mint, red, orange and purple, some with a soft bloom; the last cell instead shows a big 19 above the word loaders. Each loader runs its own loop: dots brighten in sweeps, ripples, spirals, comets or glyph morphs, with the lit pattern shifting every second or so. Some cycles use gradient colours and a glow; the set holds a still pattern when reduced motion is requested. loader card, dot matrix, label, bloom glow
phrases: dots that light up in sequence

items.name: dotted-glow-background
items.title: Dotted Glow Background
items.blurb: A near-black field of tiny dots that twinkle and pick up a faint blue glow.
items.use: A call-to-action or hero needs a quiet moving backdrop behind a card, cheap enough to leave running.
items.text: Covers its area with a staggered grid of tiny round dots on near-black. Each dot brightens and dims on its own rhythm, and the brightest gain a soft blue halo, so the whole field shimmers. A near-black stage filled edge to edge with a fine grid of tiny round dots, offset row from row. Most dots sit dim grey with a few brighter ones scattered like faint stars, and a dark rounded card with a heading, paragraph and two buttons floats in the centre. Each dot pulses between dim and bright on its own phase and speed, and the brightest briefly gain a soft blue glow. The field keeps shimmering in place indefinitely and never reacts to the pointer. dot grid, glow, pricing card, heading, buttons
phrases: dots that pulse with a blue glow
subtle animated background for a cta
canvas dots fading in and out

items.name: dotted-map
items.title: Dotted Map
items.blurb: A world map of tiny dots with orange pulses over eight cities.
items.use: A page should show worldwide locations or coverage without pulling in a heavy interactive map.
items.text: A dotted world map built from thousands of small circles, with pulsing orange markers placed at given latitudes and longitudes. On black, a world map is formed by thousands of tiny grey dots packed in rows, continents legible through their density. Each marked city is a solid orange dot wrapped in one or two thin orange rings. The dots hold still while every marker keeps sending out one or two rings that expand and fade on a loop. Nothing responds to the pointer, and the pulses never settle. dot map, marker dot, pulse rings
phrases: world map made of tiny dots
pulsing location pins on a globe
minimal world map for a landing page
blinking radar rings on a map
lat long markers on a dotted planet

items.name: drag-items
items.title: Draggable Reorder List
items.blurb: White task cards slide up and down the list when pulled by their dot grip.
items.use: A short task or issue list needs manual reordering by dragging rather than by a sort menu.
items.text: A narrow stack of white task cards, each with a title, a line of detail, a due date, a black Open task button and a nine-dot grip on the right. Dragging a grip lifts its card while the rest slide aside to make room. Three white rounded task cards stacked with small gaps on a black page. Each shows a bold title, a faint subtitle, a small date row and a black Open task button, with a pale nine-dot grip at the right edge. Pressing a grip lifts its card with a soft shadow and shrinks the grip slightly; the card follows the pointer while the rows below slide to close the gap. Releasing drops it into the new position and the list settles with a spring. task card, title, detail line, due date, open button, drag grip
phrases: drag task cards to reorder a list
sortable todo list with grip handle
vertical list that springs into place
reorder rows by pulling the dots
task list you can rearrange by hand
todo cards with due dates and buttons
draggable rows with a lift shadow
issue list for a project board

items.name: draggable-card
items.title: Draggable Card
items.blurb: Scattered polaroid-style photo cards you can drag and tilt.
items.use: A hero or gallery wants a tactile, messy photo spread people can rearrange themselves.
items.text: A set of tilted photo cards strewn across a dark stage; each tilts in 3D under the pointer, lifts on hover, and can be dragged around with momentum before settling. Six dark cards with square landscape photos and a country name below sit at different angles across a black stage, showing mountains, coast, snow and forest. Their corners overlap and shadows separate them. Moving over a card tilts it toward the pointer and adds a faint white glare; dragging throws it in the direction of motion until a spring brings it to a stop and flattens the tilt. photo card, photo, country label, glare, shadow
phrases: photo cards you can drag around
polaroid style photos on a board
cards you can fling with momentum
card stack that tilts with the mouse

items.name: drape-background
items.title: Drape Background
items.blurb: A dark pleated curtain ripples and parts when the cursor pushes it.
items.use: An atmospheric full-bleed backdrop for fashion, launch or editorial pages where copy sits over texture.
items.text: A full-bleed simulated fabric backdrop in charcoal tones, hanging in soft vertical pleats with white copy centred over it. It sways in a slow breeze and can be pushed, grabbed and pulled aside. The frame is filled by dark cloth in even vertical pleats, its crests catching faint grey light while valleys fall to black. Centred over it are a white headline, a tiny spaced-out eyebrow and one line of grey copy. The curtain hangs and sways under a slow breeze, its lower folds drifting in long curves and settling again. Moving the pointer presses the fabric and drags it along; pressing grabs the nearest fold so it can be pulled aside. cloth, pleats, headline, caption
phrases: fabric that moves with the mouse
soft black drape for a hero

items.name: draw-line-text
items.title: Draw Line Text
items.blurb: Serif word traced in outline, then filled solid white.
items.use: A short hero word or brand name should feel handwritten and reveal itself once when the page loads.
items.text: A single word of serif italic text that draws itself in outline letter by letter like handwriting, then fills in solid. It replays and can stagger each letter. On a black stage, a large white italic serif word sits centred above a small grey caption. Mid-animation the letters read as thin hairline outlines with serif flourishes; once complete they are solid white letterforms with faint shadows. On mount the strokes are traced from nothing over a few seconds, letter by letter, then the fill fades in. The demo restarts it every eight and a half seconds, so the word alternates between outline strokes and solid white. word, outline strokes, filled letters

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.blurb: Outlined button drops open a narrow list of account actions.
items.use: A trigger needs to open a short list of account or row actions without leaving the page.
items.text: A compact account menu: an outlined button opens a rounded dark panel with a muted heading, icon rows carrying shortcut hints, a ticked toggle row and signed-out action, all stacked with faint dividers. A small outlined 'Open menu' button on black. Opening it shows a narrow dark rounded panel with a muted 'My account' heading, four icon rows with tiny keys on the right, a ticked 'Show status bar' row, a 'Team' row and 'Log out', split by thin rules. Clicking the button fades and zooms in a menu just below it. Passing over a row highlights it in a slightly lighter grey; choosing a row or clicking outside closes the panel, and the tick toggles in place. trigger button, menu panel, heading, menu row, shortcut key, checkbox row, divider
phrases: list of actions that pops open
button that reveals a small list

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.blurb: A black pill expands from a thin strip into a wider banner.
items.use: You want a compact status pill that can grow into a small panel without leaving the page.
items.text: A black rounded island rests as a small pill with one short label and springs into wider and taller shapes on demand. Its text fades and blurs out as the pill resizes. A solid black rounded pill sits in the middle of a dark panel above a row of grey preset buttons. At rest it holds a single short white label, and it stretches into a long shallow pill holding the same centred text. Choosing a preset springs the island to a new width and height, its corners and label settling with it. The previous text fades and blurs away while the new label scales in. black pill, label, preset buttons
phrases: black pill that expands on click
expanding status pill at top of screen

items.name: echo-text
items.title: Echo Text
items.blurb: Ghost copies of a word trail behind it and lean with the cursor.
items.use: A bold hero or section word where movement adds drama without changing the copy.
items.text: A heavy white word with a train of faded, softly blurred copies behind it. The copies lag and stretch as the pointer moves, flare outward on a click, then gather back into one word. One crisp white word dominates a pure black stage, with a row of paler duplicates stepping away behind it and dissolving into the dark. The copies grow steadily softer until only a faint smear of light remains. Moving the pointer toward a side pulls the copies that way while the front word leads, so the tail stretches and springs back. Clicking throws a few copies outward to fade, and the train vanishes when the pointer leaves. front word, echo copies, click burst

items.name: editor-toolbar-dock
items.title: Editor Toolbar Dock
items.blurb: A tiny icon toolbar hops between the edges of a dark canvas.
items.use: A canvas or editor app needs a compact tool switcher that can be thrown out of the way.
items.text: A compact design-tool dock on a dark canvas: a grip plus six line icons, the active one sitting on a white sliding plate. Tools show labels, grouped tools open flyouts, and the strip can be dragged to another edge. A near-black bordered canvas holds a short white rounded strip near its bottom edge, made of a small grip and six dark line icons. The chosen tool sits on a white rounded plate, and a small white menu of tool names can open above it. The white plate slides from icon to icon as tools are picked. Hovering shows a label with a shortcut, and pressing the corner of a grouped tool opens its flyout; dragging the grip carries the dock across the canvas and it snaps to the nearest edge, turning vertical on the sides. grip handle, tool buttons, selection plate, tooltip, flyout menu
phrases: toolbar that snaps to screen edges

items.name: editor
items.title: Editor
items.blurb: Rich text editor with a selection toolbar and task-list content.
items.use: A product needs an in-page document editor with block commands, inline formatting and checklists, not a plain textarea.
items.text: A rich text editor showing a launch-plan document with headings, bold and italic text, a checklist and a quote. Selecting text raises a floating toolbar with block, format and link controls, plus a word count. A dark rounded card holds a document: a bold heading, a paragraph with bold and italic runs, a checked task list with square checkboxes, a left-bordered quote and a line of names. A word count sits in the bottom-right corner, and selection shows a rounded floating toolbar above the text. Typing slash on a new line opens a command list for blocks; selecting text pops a floating toolbar with Text, Format and Link menus. Choosing Bold, a heading or a list restyles the selection in place, checkboxes toggle, and the corner word count updates. document, heading, task list, checkboxes, blockquote, word count, floating toolbar
phrases: format text with a popup toolbar
task list with checkboxes and quotes
select text to make it bold

items.name: elastic-line
items.title: Elastic Line
items.blurb: Thin line bends toward the cursor and springs back.
items.use: A sparse editorial page wants one playful interactive detail that rewards moving the cursor across it.
items.text: A hairline drawn across a dark page that can be caught by the pointer. Moving near it drags the middle into a stretch, and letting go springs it back to a straight line. On a black stage a single hairline runs horizontally across the full width, over dark demo copy. At rest it is perfectly straight and very thin; when pulled it bows into a smooth curve, up to a tall pointed arch, before settling flat again. The line draws itself in from left to right on first load. When the pointer comes within a few pixels it grabs the midpoint and stretches it toward the cursor; moving past the release threshold or leaving the area springs it back with a light wobble. hairline, stretched curve
phrases: line you can pull with mouse

items.name: elastic-mesh
items.title: Elastic Mesh
items.blurb: Glossy blue letters inflate like balloons and wobble when poked.
items.use: A playful logo or short word as the centrepiece of a promo, game or brand page.
items.text: A word turned into a puffy, shiny blue solid that looks like inflated rubber. The letters spring in on load, lean toward the pointer, and dent and stretch when pressed or dragged. A fat rounded word in deep royal blue sits centred on pure black, each letter shaped like a filled balloon with bright white streaks across the top. Soft shading rounds the tubes and a faint dark shadow grounds them. Letters arrive one after another with a bouncy overshoot, then rest. The surface tips gently toward the pointer; holding presses a dent into the rubber and dragging stretches the shape around the grab point before it springs back. inflated letters, specular highlights, floor shadow

items.name: electric-logo
items.title: Electric Logo
items.blurb: A lightning-bolt mark traced in crackling electric light.
items.use: A brand mark, game icon or badge that should feel charged, alive or high-voltage.
items.text: Any logo shape outlined by restless electric strands, glowing blue-white on black. The current wanders along the edge, throws short arcs, and flares brighter as the pointer nears. A tall lightning bolt glows in pale electric light on pure black, its outline not a clean line but a bundle of thin wavering filaments. Soft blue halos follow the shape and faint loops of current flicker around the corners. The edge never rests: strands drift and swell while brightness pulses and short arcs snap across the notches. Moving the pointer close heats the glow and draws more arcs, and a click sends a ripple and flash along the mark. logo outline, electric strands, spark arcs, glow
phrases: blue energy logo for a brand

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.blurb: Searchable emoji grid in a compact popover with a preview footer.
items.use: Users need to drop an emoji into a chat, comment or status field and want search and categories, not a long scroll.
items.text: A compact emoji picker with a search box, a row of category tabs, a scrollable grid of native emoji and a footer preview. Typing filters by name or shortcode, and picking one writes it to the linked field. A narrow dark rounded panel with a pill search field on top, then a row of small grey category icons, a caption for the current category and a dense six-column grid of yellow emoji. A footer strip shows a larger emoji with its name and shortcode and a small hand icon at the right. Typing in the search filters the grid live and switches the heading to Search results, while a clear button empties it. Hovering an emoji updates the footer preview, and clicking one selects it and writes its value to the field below the panel. search field, category tabs, emoji grid, category caption, preview footer, skin tone button
phrases: insert a reaction into a message
pick a face for a comment

items.name: emoji-reaction
items.title: Emoji Reaction
items.blurb: Pill reaction bar with emoji, rolling counts and a particle burst.
items.use: A post, comment or message needs lightweight emoji reactions with visible counts and a quick extra-emoji picker.
items.text: A row of rounded reaction pills, each holding an emoji and a count. Clicking toggles your reaction, rolls the number like an odometer and fires a small particle burst, with an optional picker for more emoji. A horizontal row of rounded pill buttons, each with an emoji on the left and a number on the right, outlined with a thin border; a reacted pill sits slightly darker and inset. items.use: A dark, low-contrast backdrop behind large type or product shots that need quiet motion.
items.text: An almost-black backdrop with a slow current of tiny lilac fibers twisting through it in soft-focus ribbons. The strands glow at the folds and drift all the time, with a faint answer to the pointer. On near-black a wide band of minute lavender dots sweeps diagonally like embroidery on folded cloth, brighter along one curved crest at the top. Ends and edges blur into soft haze and a few loose specks. The dotted ribbon keeps flowing and twisting, its folds brightening as they catch the light and dimming as they turn away. Moving the cursor bends the fibers nearby and shifts focus; clicking sends a faint pulse of light along the strand. fiber ribbon, dot strands, fold highlights, dust specks

A black rectangle filled with a faint 40px lattice of thin grey lines, strongest in the middle and dying to pure black at the edges. A single large word, shaded from pale grey at the top to mid-grey below, sits centred. Static: nothing animates or responds. items.name: hacker-background
items.title: Hacker Background
items.blurb: Green characters stream down a black screen like falling code.
items.use: A page needs an instant hacker or cyberpunk mood behind a short headline.
items.text: A canvas of bright green letters raining down in narrow columns over black, each column leaving a fading tail. It fills its area and sits behind whatever text you layer on top. A black surface covered in thin vertical columns of small monospaced green characters. The brightest letter sits at the head of each column and the characters above it dim into a greyer trail, so the rain looks denser near the top and sparse towards the bottom. Random letters fall column by column at roughly thirty frames a second, each pass painting a faint dark wash that slowly wipes away the tails. When a column reaches the bottom it restarts at the top at a random moment, so the pattern never repeats. green character, falling column, faded trail, black backdrop
phrases: green letters falling like the matrix

items.name: halftone-reveal
items.title: Halftone Reveal
items.blurb: A dotted halftone portrait clears to a real photo under the cursor.
items.use: A hero or gallery image that should look printed until the visitor explores it with the pointer.
items.text: A photograph printed as a coarse two-colour halftone. Where the pointer moves the dots swell open and the sharp picture shows through, and a click spreads a clearing ring across the print. A smiling woman with dark hair and a red top fills the frame, rendered as large halftone dots in brick red against pale cream. Under the cursor a soft round patch turns smooth and photographic, showing her face and hair clearly. The whole picture stays as a dotted print while a soft-edged brush follows the pointer and converts the dots to the real photograph inside its reach. The revealed patch lingers briefly then fades back, and clicking sends a widening clear ring outward. halftone image, reveal brush, click rings

items.name: halo-card
items.title: Halo Card

items.use: A dark app needs a standout container for a short list or a settings block.
items.text: A rounded, frosted dark card with a hairline border and soft multicolour light bleeding from under its bottom edge. It stacks a heading, a short paragraph, an avatar list and two pill buttons, and lights its rim on hover. A wide rounded rectangle in near-black with a translucent, slightly lighter surface and a one-pixel border. A blurred band of pink, magenta and cyan light glows behind the lower half, brightest beneath the footer buttons, and the whole panel sits on a black page. The coloured glows drift slowly side to side all the time. Hovering the card or focusing something inside brightens the border and sweeps a moving streak of light around the rim; the primary button carries its own matching glow. card surface, title, description, more button, avatar, person row, role label, footer button

card with pink and blue light underneath

Underneath, each queued file shows a thumbnail, name, size, progress bar and remove cross. A wide rounded dropzone with a faint dashed border and a pink, blue and green glow inside. A small circular upload arrow sits over white instruction text and a grey hint line. Below are two near-black rows, each with a white page thumbnail, a thin progress bar and a cross. Files can be dropped onto the panel or chosen through the browser picker, which also opens from Enter or Space. Rows slide in, their thin bars fill with a pink-to-blue gradient, then turn green with a tick at completion; clicking a cross removes that row. dropzone panel, upload icon, instruction text, format hint, file row, page thumbnail, progress bar, remove cross

The glow drifts slowly at rest, swivels when the pointer enters, and flares to a brighter pink ring once the field is focused. On the first, a pale yellow band with torn, uneven edges sits behind the words "highlighted text" and overhangs them slightly. The cells pulse in two shades, a soft glow fades above and below the strip, and a thin caption row sits under each tile. The band moves from above the image to below it on a repeating cycle, squares flickering between the two accent colours while the picture shows through. items.text: A bordered code panel that renders a JSON object as an indented tree. Keys and values are colour-coded by type, branches fold open, long arrays truncate, dates get a relative hint, and the header offers Expand All, Collapse All and Copy. Every recorded frame is a near-black stage holding only a grey warning triangle above the words "Preview unavailable", centred in large grey type. The viewer itself, its border, title row and tree never appear. From the code, each object or array folds and unfolds on click, its chevron rotating as it opens; the header expands or collapses every branch and copies the payload, and arrays over five items hide behind a Show more button. The frames show none of this. warning icon, error message

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.blurb: Three stacked columns of task cards that can be dragged between.
items.use: A small project or pipeline needs a compact draggable board of tasks inside a page.
items.text: A small kanban board with three columns of dark cards, each card carrying a coloured tag, a title, an assignee avatar and a due date. Cards lift while dragged and spring into their new column over a glowing drop line. Three narrow columns on a black stage, each headed by a tiny status icon, a bold title and a count on the right. Under them sit rounded dark-grey cards with a small coloured tag pill, a two-line title, a round avatar and a date at the lower right. Dragging a card lifts it on a deeper shadow and leaves its slot open. Hovering another column tints that list blue and shows a glowing drop line, and releasing springs the card into the new stack; cards in Launched fade and get struck-through titles. column header, status icon, count, card, tag pill, assignee avatar, due date, drop line
phrases: move a card to another column
project tracker with tags and avatars

items.name: key-value
items.title: Key Value
items.blurb: Rows of key and value fields with remove crosses and an add button.
items.use: A settings or deploy form must edit a variable number of key/value pairs.
items.text: An editor for key/value pairs where each row has a monospaced key field, a value field and a remove button, plus an add button that appends an empty row. Pasting a .env listing fills several rows at once. A dark form under a small heading and a grey hint line. Each row pairs a narrow outlined key box with a wider outlined value box, both with grey borders, followed by a square cross button; a full-width outlined Add button sits under the rows. Typing in a key or value updates the pair immediately and checks for duplicate keys, showing a red message under the field. Add appends a new empty row and focuses it, the cross deletes a row, and pasting several KEY=value lines expands them into separate rows. heading, hint text, key field, value field, remove button, add button, error message
phrases: edit environment variables in a list
editor for pairs of names and values
add and remove rows of fields
paste a dotenv file into a form
headers editor with key and value
two column text inputs with remove

items.name: keyboard
items.title: Interactive Keyboard
items.blurb: A miniature Mac keyboard whose keys press under your fingers.
items.use: A page teaches keyboard shortcuts and needs a recognisable keyboard that reacts to real presses.
items.text: A light 75% keyboard drawn as tiny square keys, from the function row down to the arrow cluster. Clicking a key, or typing on the real keyboard while it is in view, squeezes that key. A pale grey keyboard about 900px wide on a black stage, wrapped in a rounded shell. Five rows of small keys carry tiny labels, with a wide space bar and a compact arrow cluster at the lower right. Each key dips slightly on press, from a mouse click or from a real key press while the board is on screen. An optional line above can echo the last key, and optional per-key sounds play if enabled. function row, number row, letter rows, shift row, modifier keys, arrow keys
phrases: on screen keys you can type on
mini key grid with clickable caps
keys that press when you type
virtual keypad for a shortcut demo

items.name: kinetic-text
items.title: Kinetic Text
items.blurb: Letter weight swells under the cursor, a few glyphs at a time.
items.use: A headline should invite the pointer and show off typography without colour or motion.
items.text: Three stacked lines of text whose individual letters thicken as the pointer passes over them, with the neighbours taking a smaller boost. It reads like type reacting to touch. Three centred lines of white sans-serif text on black, in descending sizes: a large heading, a medium line and a small line. Most letters are light-weight, and a short run near the pointer turns noticeably heavier, giving the line an uneven ripple of thickness. As the pointer crosses a line the letter under it thickens to a heavy weight and gains a faint outline and extra side padding, while the glyphs either side thicken slightly less. All of it eases back to light within half a second of leaving. heading line, second line, third line, individual letters
phrases: letters get bolder as you hover
text that reacts letter by letter
font weight changing on mouse move
playful type that thickens on touch

items.name: knob-slider
items.title: Knob Slider
items.blurb: Round dial ringed with ticks that spins and blurs its number as you drag.
items.use: A single value should be set with a tactile rotary feel, such as volume or intensity.
items.text: A circular knob edged with fine tick marks. Dragging around the ring turns a small triangle pointer and snaps the value to the nearest tick, while the big number rolls and blurs as it spins, then sharpens when it stops. A large near-black circle on a black stage, ringed by dozens of short radial ticks. Inside sits a slightly lighter disc holding a very large white number, with a small grey triangle on the outer edge marking the current angle. Pressing the dial jumps the value to that angle, then dragging sweeps the triangle around and snaps to one of seventy-two positions. While the pointer moves, the number blurs and rolls like a slot machine and clears as it settles. outer disc, tick ring, inner disc, value number, angle marker
phrases: turn a dial to pick a number
drag around a circle to set value
spin a knob to choose a level
round volume knob for a web app

items.name: label
items.title: Form Label
items.blurb: Small bold caption above a dark field that rings when focused.
items.use: Every form field needs a visible caption tied to its control for sighted users and screen readers.
items.text: A form label in small bold type sits above an email input and a line of helper text. Focusing the field swaps its faint border for a bright ring. A short bold white caption, 'Email address', above a rounded dark input holding a grey placeholder, with a dim single-line helper note below. When focused, the field's edge becomes a bright thin ring. The caption itself never moves. Focusing the field below turns its faint outline into a bright ring, and typed characters replace the placeholder one at a time. caption text, email input, placeholder, helper text, focus ring
phrases: small bold caption for a field
short hint under an email box

items.name: lamp
items.title: Lamp
items.blurb: A cyan lamp glow beams down onto a headline in a dark panel.
items.use: A dark hero needs a single elegant light source to frame a short headline.
items.text: A deep navy panel with a bright cyan lip and a soft cone of light fanning downward over a centred headline. On entering view the light widens and the words rise and fade in. A deep navy-black panel with a thin bright cyan line near the top and a soft cyan cone of light spilling down from it like a lamp. Below the light, a two-line grey headline sits centred, fading darker toward its lower line. As it enters view the lamp cone and its bright lip widen from narrow to full over about a second, while the headline drifts up and fades in just after. Both settle and stay still; the pointer does nothing. lamp line, light cone, headline, dark panel
phrases: cone of light from the top of a hero
cyan glow behind a quote section
light shaft on a dark banner
glowing cone at the top of a page
theatre light effect for a landing page

items.name: lanyard-react-bits
items.title: Lanyard
items.blurb: A photo ID badge on a strap swings, drags and flips in 3D.
items.use: A profile, event pass or product needs a tactile 3D object that invites dragging and flipping.
items.text: A realistic ID badge hanging from a woven strap on a black stage. It sways under gravity, can be grabbed and thrown with the pointer, and flips over when clicked. A glossy portrait-format badge with rounded corners and a punched slot, hung by a silver clip from a dark woven ribbon that rises out of the frame. The badge holds a full-bleed photo, with a faint grain and soft studio reflections across its surface. The strap and badge swing on a spring like a real lanyard, never quite still in the ambient breeze. Dragging the card moves it in 3D, releasing throws it, and a short click flips it to a back face. lanyard strap, metal clip, punched slot, badge card, photo, glossy surface
phrases: card you can throw and flip

items.name: lattice-loader
items.title: Lattice Loader
items.blurb: Rows of tiny dot lattices tick beside labels as an agent works.
items.use: An AI agent or background job needs a compact, readable status line with a timer.
items.text: Compact status rows for background tasks: a grid of cells pulses in patterns beside a label and a running stopwatch, then switches to a green done mark when the row finishes. Three stacked rows on a dark card, each led by a small square grid of round dots, followed by a bright label and a smaller grey timer. The finished row's dots turn green and its timer stays fixed while the others count up. The dots light in a travelling pattern while the timer beside them counts every tenth of a second. On completion the lattice fades out, green dots snap into a check-like mark and the timer freezes. card eyebrow, status row, dot lattice, status label, timer, done mark

items.name: layered-progressive-disclosure
items.title: Layered Progressive Disclosure
items.blurb: Nested config panel that uncovers a switch, then tabs, as you switch it on.
items.use: Settings have levels of detail and advanced controls should stay hidden until switched on.
items.text: A stack of inset rounded cards showing width and height readouts, a row whose label flips, and an asymmetric switch that reveals a two-tab selector and reverses the opacity and blur values. Each new layer springs in out of a blur. A narrow dark panel titled Animation, built from rounded cards in shades of charcoal that sit one inside another. It holds two small stat chips, a wide label row with up-down chevrons, two value rows with an arrow between numbers, and a light Add Property button at the base. Clicking the Visual Change row swaps its label to Transition and slides open an Asymmetric switch. Turning that switch on springs out a two-tab selector and flips the Opacity and Blur values, each layer appearing from above with a short blur. panel, title, stat chip, feature row, chevron, asymmetric switch, tab selector, add button
phrases: settings panel that reveals more options
config panel with switches and tabs

items.name: layout-grid
items.title: Layout Grid
items.blurb: Click any photo in the mosaic and it grows into the centre with its caption.
items.use: An image-led section where visitors should open a single photo without leaving the page.
items.text: A four-photo mosaic of travel images. Clicking one lifts it into the middle of the grid, dims the rest and slides a white title and caption up over the picture; clicking the dark area puts it back. A four-photo mosaic on black: a wide close-up of hands fanning banknotes, a dark contour swirl, a plant against a tiled wall and a wide sea cliff. Cards sit close together with small gaps, and the whole grid dims when one is open. Clicking a photo lifts it into the centre of the grid, where it enlarges while a black veil fades behind it and its title and copy slide up from the bottom. Clicking the dark area returns it. photo tile, photo, title, description, dark veil
phrases: photo grid where a card expands on click
gallery that zooms a picture to center
image mosaic with click to enlarge
grid of photos that open in place

items.name: layout-text-flip
items.title: Layout Text Flip
items.blurb: A headline word that blurs out and swaps for the next phrase on a timer.
items.use: A headline must cover several products or benefits without adding more lines or vertical space.
items.text: A fixed line of heading text with a rounded badge beside it that holds one word at a time. Every few seconds the word blurs out and a new one drops in, the badge resizing to fit each phrase. White bold heading text, "Build Amazing", sits on a near-black stage beside a dark rounded rectangle badge. The badge holds a lighter phrase such as "Landing Pages", hugging the word with even padding and sitting level with the heading. On a fixed interval the badge swaps phrases: the current word slides down and blurs away while the next drops in from above, out of blur. The chip grows or shrinks to the new word's width, then holds still until the next swap. static heading, word badge, rotating word
phrases: rotating word next to a heading
cycle through keywords in a chip

items.name: left-directional-drawer
items.title: Left Directional Drawer
items.blurb: A pencil on a portrait opens a slide-in panel to swap the photo.
items.use: A profile picture needs replacing in place from the page that shows it.
items.text: A profile-picture editor that slides in from the left when you tap the pencil over a portrait. It offers an initials placeholder, a file picker and a save button. A portrait photo with a small dark pencil button at its corner; the drawer that slides over it is a dark left panel with an X, a truncated heading and helper line, a rounded square placeholder marked JP, a file input row and a white Save Changes button. Tapping the pencil slides the panel in from the left over the dimmed photo; the X or a click outside closes it. The form offers a file field and a Save Changes button. portrait photo, edit button, side panel, heading, initials placeholder, file input, save button, close icon
phrases: change profile picture from a side panel
edit avatar in a sliding form
upload a new headshot in a drawer
slide over form with file chooser
edit my photo without leaving the page
avatar update sheet with save button

items.name: letter-pullup
items.title: Letter Pullup
items.blurb: Letters rise into place one by one to spell two lines.
items.use: A hero headline should arrive with a bit of character instead of a plain fade.
items.text: Each character of a string rises up into position in sequence, starting transparent and low, so a headline assembles itself letter by letter. Two lines of very large sans-serif text sit centred on black: Launch day in white and is finally here in blue. A small Replay button rests in the lower right. On mount every letter starts below and invisible, then springs up into line with a small stagger from left to right. Replay restarts the whole sequence. first line, second line, letters, replay button

items.name: light-speed
items.title: Light Speed
items.blurb: Streaks of pink and teal light rush down a dark highway.
items.use: A hero or splash wants a fast, atmospheric night-drive mood that reacts to a press.
items.text: A night drive rendered in 3D: glowing car lights and lane markers stream toward the viewer and bend with the road. Holding the pointer speeds them up. A black sky tops a dark road where dozens of neon streaks converge to a vanishing point. The left lanes glow magenta and purple, the right lanes teal and blue, and a white instruction line floats over the middle. The light trails stream toward the camera continuously, sweeping as the road bends. Pressing and holding the pointer accelerates the rush, then it eases back on release. dark road, light trails, lane dashes, instruction text

items.name: light-tunnel
items.title: Light Tunnel
items.blurb: White light strands swirl into a tunnel that drifts with the cursor.
items.use: A hero or section needs a moving dark backdrop that reacts to the pointer without carrying any text.
items.text: A full-screen swirl of curved light filaments converging into a dark vanishing point. The strands drift and carry racing comets, the centre bends toward the pointer, and a click sends a surge inward. Hundreds of thin white strands curve inward like a whirlpool, brightest toward the outer edge and fading into a black hole at the centre. Short bright comets ride along some strands, giving the dark field a sense of speed. The whole swirl rotates and flexes slowly, bending its centre toward the pointer while streaks of light travel along the cables into the middle. Clicking sends a bright ring surging toward the vanishing point. light strands, vanishing point, comet streaks, dark backdrop, surging ring
phrases: comets of light in a vortex

items.name: lightboard
items.title: Lightboard
items.blurb: Amber dot-matrix sign whose text scrolls sideways like a ticker.
items.use: You want a retro LED sign effect or a scrolling announcement strip that draws the eye.
items.text: A wide grid of small dots renders blocky amber text that scrolls sideways like an LED sign; drawing can be enabled to light individual dots by hand. A long black rectangular panel filled with a fine grid of dim dots, with chunky amber letters lit out of them. The message sits centred vertically in the band, with dark margins around the sign. The message crawls right to left on a fixed interval and wraps forever. Hovering pauses it; when drawing is enabled, dragging lights dots along the pointer path. dot grid, lit letters, dark panel, canvas
phrases: scrolling announcement strip for a site
dot grid sign with glowing letters

items.name: lightbox-grid
items.title: Lightbox Grid
items.blurb: Click a photo tile and it grows out of its slot into a full-screen view.
items.use: A page shows a handful of photos and each should open large without losing its place.
items.text: A compact grid of rounded nature photos where the first tile spans four cells. Any thumbnail opens into a full-window viewer with arrows, a counter and a caption, and can be swiped or dragged back into place. Six rounded photo tiles pack tightly on black, with one large landscape image filling a two-by-two square on the left and five smaller portrait and landscape photos beside it. The open view centres one photo on a dark backdrop, with a counter and close at top right, round arrows at the sides and a small caption below. Tapping a tile sends that same photo flying from its slot to the middle of the screen, growing and uncropping as it goes. Inside, a sideways swipe steps to the next photo, pulling down shrinks the image and flies it home, and Escape, arrows or the buttons close it. photo grid, large tile, thumbnail, lightbox photo, caption, counter, arrow buttons, close button
phrases: photo grid that opens a fullscreen viewer
click a thumbnail to zoom it
image gallery with swipe between photos
drag down to close a lightbox
full screen picture viewer with arrows

items.name: line-shadow-text
items.title: Line Shadow Text
items.blurb: An italic word trails a hatched shadow that slides across it.
items.use: A hero headline needs one word to feel alive without pulling attention from the copy.
items.text: A line of large white text where one word is set in italic and carries a diagonal striped shadow behind it, slowly sweeping across on a loop. Two oversized white words on black, an upright one followed by an italic one. Behind the italic word sits a fine diagonal-stripe shadow of the same letters, offset slightly down and right. The hatched shadow drifts diagonally across the italic word on a long fifteen-second loop, so the streaks seem to slide and gather behind the letters. The text itself stays still. upright word, italic word, striped shadow
phrases: text with sliding outline behind it

items.name: line-sidebar
items.title: Line Sidebar
items.blurb: Menu labels slide right and glow purple near the cursor.
items.use: A docs or app sidebar needs a compact, cursor-aware menu with a clear active page.
items.text: A vertical menu where each numbered label and its short tick react to pointer proximity, shifting right and turning purple. Clicking a row sets a lasting accent and grows the marker beside it. A narrow column of twelve small numbered labels, each preceded by a thin grey rule, evenly stacked on a black field. The active row is tinted purple and pushed right, and rows near it extend their ticks and brighten. As the pointer moves down the list, rows within reach slide right, shift toward purple and stretch their tick marks like a fisheye. Clicking a row keeps it accented and lengthens the marker line beside it. numbered label, tick mark, active marker, item row, list
phrases: vertical menu that reacts to cursor
sidebar with shifting text on hover
menu items that slide when hovered

items.name: linear-modal-center-content
items.title: Linear Modal Centered
items.blurb: A photo tile springs open into a full centered article card.
items.use: A gallery of photos should open into readable detail without leaving the page.
items.text: Three photo cards that expand into one large centered reading panel when clicked. The backdrop blurs, the picture stays on top and the text fades in below it. Three tall photo tiles in a row on a black page, each with a small title bottom-left and a round plus button bottom-right. Open, one becomes a tall rounded panel: a full-width photo above a heading, a paragraph of small text and an X at the top right. Clicking a tile grows it with a spring into a centered tall card while the page behind blurs and dims. The image, title and text scale and fade in; the X closes it back to the row. photo tile, title, plus button, expanded panel, large heading, description text, close button, dimmed backdrop
phrases: photo card that opens into an article
click a picture to read more
card morphs into full screen panel
gallery tile opens a large view

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.blurb: Hovering an underlined link floats up a small screenshot of its page.
items.use: Body copy contains links and a screenshot would help readers decide whether to click.
items.text: A word inside body copy opens a rounded card showing a screenshot of the page it points to. The card springs up above the link and drifts sideways as the pointer moves. A white rounded card floats above an underlined link, holding a small screenshot of the linked page with a thin light border and soft shadow. It sits over a dark stage with a bold sentence beneath. Hovering a link for a moment pops the preview up from below with a spring, and it slides slightly sideways as the pointer crosses the word. It closes after a short delay when the pointer leaves. trigger link, preview card, page screenshot, caption sentence
phrases: hover link to show website screenshot
see page before clicking a link
link that opens a mini screenshot

items.name: liquid-gauge
items.title: Liquid Gauge
items.blurb: Drag the liquid level up or down and the surface sloshes like water.
items.use: A usage or quota number should feel tangible and let people scrub the value by hand.
items.text: A tall usage gauge filled from the bottom with simulated liquid. Dragging sets the fill, the surface ripples and bubbles rise, and past a warning threshold the liquid turns red with an Almost full label. Two tall dark rounded panels sit side by side on black. Each shows a small label, a huge percentage, a used-of-capacity subline and a status at the bottom; the lower part is a solid liquid fill with a gently wavy surface, and the readouts repeat in inverted colour inside it. The right gauge is almost entirely red. Dragging vertically sets the fill, and the surface springs, overshoots and settles; sideways dragging rocks the whole body while hovering through the liquid stirs it. Small bubbles rise as the level climbs, and crossing the warning threshold turns the liquid red and changes the status. gauge card, label, percentage, used subline, liquid fill, wavy surface, bubble, status line
phrases: storage meter filled with sloshing liquid
drag up and down to set a usage level
animated gauge that turns red when full
interactive capacity meter for a dashboard
quota meter with a wavy surface

items.name: liquid-glass-mobile-icons
items.title: Liquid Glass Mobile Icons
items.blurb: Glassy icon tiles float over a leaf photo like a phone control centre.
items.use: You want a phone-like cluster of quick toggles laid over a photo or wallpaper.
items.text: A grid of translucent rounded glass tiles holds phone control icons — rotation, notifications, brightness, mute, focus, flashlight, timer, camera and screen record — floating over a photo backdrop. A cluster of glassy tiles in two sizes: small round squares for single icons and tall or wide pills for sliders and the Focus toggle. Icons are white outlines on smoky translucent glass with faint inner highlights. They sit over a green leaf beaded with water droplets. The arrangement is static and nothing moves on its own. Each glass tile can be dragged on its own and springs back to its spot, and every tile scales up a little on hover and down on press. glass tile, icon, slider pill, focus bar, label
phrases: glass icon buttons on a photo

items.name: liquid-glass-music-card
items.title: Liquid Glass Music Card
items.blurb: A spinning vinyl record sits beside the track title, seek bar and controls.
items.use: A page needs a self-contained music widget with a tactile disc and standard playback controls.
items.text: A compact now-playing card with a spinning vinyl disc you can grab to scrub, a progress bar, rolling timestamps and previous, play and next buttons, optionally set on a frosted glass panel. A small rounded panel, mildly transparent, holding a black vinyl disc with a bright printed centre label beside a five-bar level meter and the words Now Playing above a track title and artist. A thin orange progress bar and three round playback buttons sit below. The record turns steadily at 33⅓ speed while the track plays; grabbing the disc and flicking it scrubs the song, and the timestamps roll over digit by digit. Play and pause spin the disc up or down, and next swaps in a new track. disc, centre label, tonearm, level meter, track title, artist name, progress bar, playback buttons

items.name: liquid-glass-notification
items.title: Liquid Glass Notification
items.blurb: A glass notification stack blooms open to reveal a photo.
items.use: You want a rich notification that can open to show an attachment or preview without leaving the page.
items.text: Two stacked glass notifications sit at the bottom of a photo backdrop, each with an app icon, title, message and time. Hovering or clicking the top one expands it from a slim row into a card with a preview image. Two slim dark glass cards stacked with a small gap, each showing a rounded gradient app icon, a bold title, one or two lines of white text and a time at the right. When open, the top card grows tall and reveals a mountain lake photo beneath its text. At rest the notifications are slim rows. Pointing at or clicking the top card expands it downward with a spring to reveal the preview image, then it shrinks back. The lower card stays compact throughout. notification card, app icon, title, message, timestamp, preview image
phrases: push alerts on a photo background

items.name: liquid-glass-sidebar-menu
items.title: Liquid Glass Sidebar
items.blurb: A dark glass menu panel with icon rows floats over a mossy photo.
items.use: You want a floating app menu that keeps the background photo visible behind it.
items.text: A narrow rounded sidebar of five icon-and-label rows — Dashboard, Search, Sales Analytics, Notification and Account Settings — on a smoky glass panel over a photo, with the active row as a white pill. A tall dark rounded panel, about 280px wide, sits over a photo of mossy stone and water. Five full-width rows each pair a small line icon with a label; the top row is a white pill with dark text, the rest are white text on near-black glass. A soft edge highlight outlines the panel. The panel can be grabbed and dragged as a whole, springing back toward its start when released. Menu rows lighten to a translucent white wash on hover, and the current Dashboard row stays a filled white pill. sidebar panel, active row, menu row, icon, label
phrases: vertical menu with active white pill
glassy menu list for an app

items.name: liquid-glass-weather
items.title: Liquid Glass Weather
items.blurb: White weather readouts sit on glass panes over a bright cloudscape.
items.use: You need a compact at-a-glance weather panel that layers on top of a photo or gradient.
items.text: A compact weather panel built from translucent glass cards: an hourly strip across the top, the current temperature and a clock beside it, and a five-day forecast below, all over a cloud photo. Four white-tinted glass panels of differing widths float over a bright blue sky with white clouds. The top strip lists six hourly slots with small weather icons; below, one panel shows a big temperature, another a clock and a location pill, and a wide panel lists five days with high and low figures. Static once drawn: the hourly, current and daily figures never change and no state is wired. Each glass panel can be dragged on its own and springs back, scaling slightly on hover and press. hourly strip, temperature, clock, location pill, daily forecast row, weather icon

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: Liquid Glass Card
items.blurb: A frosted pane floats on a purple gradient and blurs what is behind it.
items.use: You want a translucent panel that keeps a vivid background visible behind the content it holds.
items.text: A translucent rounded card sits on a coloured background and blurs whatever shows through it, with bright inner edges and a soft outer halo. It can be picked up and dragged, and it lifts a little on hover. A rounded frosted rectangle, about a sixth of the frame, resting on an indigo-to-pink gradient. White text reads a big temperature, a condition and a city, with a faint hint line below. Its edges catch a thin white highlight and a soft glow spreads outside. The pane can be grabbed and dragged; letting go lets it spring back with a slight bounce. Hovering enlarges it a fraction and pressing shrinks it briefly. Content inside stays sharp while the area behind is blurred. frosted card, temperature, condition, location, hint text, outer glow
phrases: frosted glass card on a gradient

items.name: liquid-gradient
items.title: Liquid Gradient
items.blurb: Rainbow ribbons swirl inside a rounded banner behind white text.
items.use: A signup or early-access CTA needs to feel animated and eye-catching without extra illustration.
items.text: Seven overlapping gradient sheets blend into a slow, liquid rainbow that keeps reshaping. In the demo it fills a rounded pill behind the words Get early access and slows down while hovered. A wide pill-shaped banner on a black page, filled edge to edge with layered rainbow gradients — hot pink, orange, green, cyan and violet — that curve and fold like fabric. Centred white bold text sits on top. The gradient morphs and reshapes on a continuous ten-second loop, never sitting still. Hovering stretches the same motion over a fifty-second cycle, so the colours drift much more slowly while the label stays fixed. pill banner, gradient layers, button label
phrases: liquid colour flowing inside a pill

items.name: liquid-logo
items.title: Liquid Logo
items.blurb: A black logo mark shimmers like liquid chrome with rainbow edges.
items.use: A brand mark should feel premium and moving rather than a static SVG.
items.text: A canvas that renders an image as a glossy, melting surface, bending its shape and adding thin iridescent highlights that drift over it. Two interlocking rounded black tiles form an offset plus shape on a dark stage. Their surface looks like polished chrome, with a white sheen and a thin rainbow band running along the inner edges. The chrome surface ripples continuously, sliding its bright highlights and rainbow fringes along the shape. The silhouette wobbles slightly but stays recognisable. logo mark, chrome surface, rainbow fringe, highlight

items.name: liquid-slider
items.title: Liquid Slider
items.blurb: Fills a glass with blue water as you drag the level up or down.
items.use: A single level or amount benefits from a tactile, literal liquid metaphor such as water tracking.
items.text: A vertical water-volume control shaped like a drinking glass.
