It is used to show two tools or services connecting into a single integration. A wide dark blob shaped like two circles fused by a curved neck, with a thin light border and a faint outer glow. A database cylinder sits in the left lobe, a sparkle in the right, and a small faint plus marks the middle. Static: nothing moves or responds; the two icons and the plus stay fixed in place. bubble outline, left icon, right icon, centre plus
phrases: two logos joined into one shape

items.name: mesh-gradient-background
items.title: Mesh Gradient Background
items.blurb: Bright green glow pools drift behind a large white heading.
items.use: A marketing hero wants a bright, energetic backdrop with a place for a large headline.
items.text: A bright green animated backdrop with a bold white line of text centred over it; soft light pools swell and shift behind the words as it runs. The frame is a bright lime-green field filled with soft, rounded pools of lighter and darker green, like light through water. Centred in white, heavy sans-serif text reads 'Fresh ideas, daily', casting a faint drop shadow. The green pools keep swelling and drifting across the field, brightening to near-white in places, so the backdrop slowly changes without any input. The heading stays fixed and readable throughout. green gradient field, light pools, dark blooms, white heading, drop shadow

items.name: mesh-shadergradient
items.title: Mesh Shader Gradient
items.blurb: Warm orange gradient bands sweep and drift like flowing light.
items.use: A landing page or hero needs a moving colour backdrop with no content of its own.
items.text: A full-bleed animated gradient that keeps moving: broad orange and rust bands slide across deep shadow, with a faint grain and cool blue-grey glow creeping into the corners. The whole frame is a grainy, full-bleed wash of warm colour. A broad diagonal band of orange and rust sweeps from upper left to lower right, a bright cream rim catching its edge, against deep near-black on the other side; blue-grey light gathers in the corners. The gradient never stops moving: the bands slowly slide, bend and reform so the bright edge travels across the frame. No interaction is needed; it runs on its own as a looping animated surface. gradient bands, bright rim, dark field, grain, corner glow

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.blurb: A chat thread that keeps the newest reply in view with a jump pill.
items.use: A conversation receives long or streamed replies and the reader should stay at the newest text without scrolling.
items.text: A scrolling message list for a conversation: user turns sit right in pale bubbles, assistant replies run left as plain text, and the view follows a reply while it streams. Scrolling up reveals a button that returns to the newest message. A rounded dark chat card with a Trip planner header, user questions in pale rounded bubbles on the right, and assistant answers as grey left-aligned paragraphs. A muted follow-up bar and a round arrow send button sit along the bottom edge. New assistant text streams in and the viewport stays pinned to the bottom while it grows. Scrolling up detaches the pin and fades in a circular arrow button near the bottom, which returns to the latest message when pressed. chat card, header, user bubble, assistant text, follow-up input, send button, jump button
phrases: chat box that follows new messages
scroll to bottom button in chat
chat window pinned to latest reply
streaming answer that stays in view
message list with user and bot bubbles
chat with jump to newest button

items.name: messenger-testimonial
items.title: Messenger Testimonial
items.blurb: Customer praise plays out as a live chat thread with emoji reactions.
items.use: A support or SaaS page wants testimonials that feel like a live conversation rather than static quote cards.
items.text: A pale page holding a narrow messenger window where a support conversation types itself out one message at a time. Bubbles carry avatars, names and times, reactions pop underneath, and live stats sit at the bottom. Off-white page with a bold heading and grey intro above a slim chat column bordered by thin rules. Inside: a white pill with a green dot, alternating grey and black rounded bubbles with round avatars and faint times, tiny emoji chips, then a live-status bar and three metric tiles. Messages arrive in sequence, each preceded by three bouncing typing dots, and spring up with their avatar. Clicking a bubble toggles a small emoji reaction chip under it, while the pulse dot and the online count stay in motion. heading, subtitle, live pill, message bubble, avatar, reaction chip, status bar, stat tile
phrases: testimonials shown as a chat thread
messages that appear one by one

items.name: metal-button
items.title: Metal Button
items.blurb: Pill buttons wrapped in a slow liquid-metal sheen.
items.use: A hero call to action should feel physical and premium without changing the button's layout.
items.text: A pair of pill buttons, one near-white and one dark, each ringed by an animated metallic edge and a faint glow. The shader drifts around the rim while the label, size and fill behave like normal buttons. Two rounded pill buttons sit side by side on black: a near-white Get Started with dark text and a dark Learn More with light text. Each has a thin metallic rim and a soft halo, and the light one carries a silver gradient across its face. A shader ring travels around each button's edge and its glow slowly breathes; the labels and fills stay in place. Hovering brightens the button surface through its normal colour transition. pill button, label, metal ring, glow
phrases: button with a liquid metal edge
shiny chrome ring around a button
get started button with a chrome outline
silver ring button for a hero

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.blurb: Faint shooting stars streak diagonally across a dark, softly glowing card.
items.use: A dark card or panel needs quiet continuous motion to feel alive without competing with its text.
items.text: A looping shower of thin diagonal light streaks that fall across whatever container it sits in, usually a dark card. It adds slow night-sky motion behind the text. A dark, softly rounded card on black with a blurred blue-teal halo leaking out behind its lower edge. Inside sit a small ring icon, a bold white heading, two grey lines of copy and a thin outlined Explore button, crossed by a few pale diagonal streaks. Around twenty thin streaks enter from the top of the card at randomised delays and speeds, drift down-left and fade out near the bottom, looping forever. The whole layer fades in once when it mounts. card, halo, ring icon, heading, paragraph, streaks, explore button
phrases: shooting stars falling across a card
diagonal streaks of light on loop
decorative backdrop for a call to action

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.blurb: A revenue tile whose figure rolls and chart re-shades as you scrub the days.
items.use: A dashboard needs one headline number that can also be examined day by day or over a dragged range.
items.text: A card showing a metric total, its change against the previous period, a shaded trend line and a three-part breakdown. Dragging across the chart selects a day or a range and the number and captions update. A tall dark rounded card: a Revenue label with 7D, 30D and 90D pills at the top, a huge white figure below with a small green or red percentage, then a white area chart over a dashed prior line, orange event ticks and three weighted bars with labelled value rows. Hovering or dragging on the chart reads a single day or a span, rolling the figure and lighting only that slice while the caption names the compared dates; a dragged range stays until Clear is pressed. The period pills morph the line into a new shape. metric label, period pills, big figure, change caption, trend chart, event marker, breakdown bars, segment row
phrases: kpi card with sparkline and total
drag across chart to pick dates
number that counts as you hover

items.name: micro-slats
items.title: Micro Slats
items.blurb: A wall of tiny purple slats ripples with bright glints.
items.use: A hero or section wants a tactile, moving wall texture that reacts to the cursor.
items.text: A full-screen field of small rounded purple slats whose heights rise and fall in slow swells, catching white glints. Moving the pointer stirs a fluid swirl through the field. A dense grid of narrow vertical lozenges, deep purple on black, evenly spaced across the whole stage. Patches of the grid stretch taller and light up white, so bright bands sweep across like light on water. The slat heights ride overlapping waves and the raised crests catch a white glint as the swell travels across the screen. Moving the cursor pushes a fluid vortex through the grid, and a click splashes it outward. slat grid, purple slats, glint crest, dark background, cursor swirl
phrases: liquid cursor trail on a grid

items.name: mini-calendar
items.title: Mini Calendar
items.blurb: A week of day chips with arrows to page, and the chosen day's agenda below.
items.use: A page needs a narrow date selector with the selected day's schedule right beside it.
items.text: A compact horizontal strip of seven stacked month-and-day buttons between previous and next arrows. Clicking a day marks it and lists that day's events in a panel underneath. A short rounded bordered strip holding a left chevron, seven narrow day cells with a tiny grey month above a bold number, and a right chevron on black. The selected day is a white pill, today a grey one; a bordered card below lists times and event titles. The arrows shift the window a whole week at a time. Hovering a day tints it grey and clicking it fills it white, while the panel below swaps to that date's heading and its list of events. calendar strip, previous arrow, day cell, month text, day number, next arrow, agenda panel, event row
phrases: pick a day and see events

items.name: minimal-card
items.title: Minimal Card
items.blurb: A soft dark card holding a photo, title and short copy.
items.use: A grid of articles or places needs a calm, low-chrome tile people can scan.
items.text: A rounded dark card with a photo filling its top and a title plus three lines of muted text beneath. Its only change is a slight lightening of the surface when hovered. A tall dark card with generously rounded corners sits on black. A wide photo of snowy peaks above a sea of cloud fills the top, with a white title and three lines of grey body text below. Almost still: the only change is a faint lightening of the card surface while the pointer rests on it. Nothing moves on its own. card surface, photo, title, description text

tile for a grid of articles
soft shadow card for a landing page

items.name: mock-browser-window
items.title: Mock Browser Window
items.blurb: A dark browser window frames a small analytics dashboard.
items.use: You want to frame a dashboard screenshot as a believable app window on a marketing page.
items.text: A rounded mock app window with three macOS dots, a URL bar and a left sidebar, holding a demo dashboard of three stat cards and a bar chart. It is a frame; the sidebar and content come from props and children. A dark rounded window with a thin border. The top row has three small traffic-light dots on the left and a pill-shaped URL bar in the centre. A narrow left sidebar lists five items, the first tinted as active, beside three small stat cards and a row of grey bars. Static: nothing moves or responds. The URL, sidebar items and inner content are supplied by props and children, but the frame itself has no interaction. window frame, traffic light dots, address bar, sidebar, sidebar item, stat card, bar chart

items.name: molten-metal
items.title: Molten Metal
items.blurb: Glowing purple filaments swirl across black like molten wire.
items.use: A hero or section wants a dark, dramatic glowing backdrop with a molten-metal feel.
items.text: A full-screen shader of slow-moving molten filaments in violet and white on black. The ribbons curl and brighten, drift toward the cursor, and flare where you click. Thin luminous ribbons of violet and white twist across a near-black stage, looping into loose knots and glowing brightest at their bends. Much of the field stays deep black, so the strands read as hot wire in darkness. The filaments drift and fold slowly, their glow sliding along the curves. Moving the pointer nudges the flow, and clicking sends out a bright flare. glowing filaments, dark background, bright glints, flow currents

items.name: morph-slider
items.title: Morph Slider
items.blurb: Photos melt into each other inside a rounded slider with arrows and dots.
items.use: A hero or gallery wants a cinematic photo carousel with a stand-out transition and captions.
items.text: A full-width image slider whose slides dissolve through a liquid melt, ripple, shear or swirl effect. Captions cross-fade, arrows step through slides and dots mark the position. A large rounded rectangle holding a full-bleed landscape photo, framed by a thin black border of empty stage. A dark translucent caption sits at the bottom left, round arrow buttons at mid height and a row of small dots at the bottom centre. Slides change with a shader that warps and melts the outgoing photo into the incoming one, briefly smearing colours. Captions fade and lift, the active dot stretches, and autoplay advances after a pause while hovering stops it. photo slide, caption pill, arrow buttons, indicator dots, rounded frame

items.name: morph-surface
items.title: Morph Surface
items.blurb: A tiny pill grows into a small message box.
items.use: You want a lightweight feedback or note box that stays a small pill until someone writes.
items.text: A collapsed pill with a dot, a label and a Send Feedback prompt springs open into a rounded card holding a textarea and a cmd-Enter shortcut. Submitting folds it back and briefly flashes a tick. At rest a wide rounded pill shows a white dot, the words Morph Surface and a muted Send Feedback prompt. Opened it becomes a taller rounded card, keeping the label at the top left, cmd and Enter keys at the top right, and a large text area below. Clicking the pill springs it open into the card and focuses the textarea. Escape or an outside click folds it back; cmd-Enter submits, after which the card closes and the dot shows a check for a moment. pill, status dot, label, trigger prompt, shortcut keys, message box

small message form at the bottom
collapsed bar that opens a text box

compact note form for a website

items.name: morphic-navbar
items.title: Morphic Navbar
items.blurb: The nav links pull apart into separate pills around whichever one is active.
items.use: A small site wants a distinctive top navigation with only a handful of links.
items.text: A compact pill navigation bar on black. The active link sits in its own gap-separated pill, hover opens a hairline gap, clicking moves the split, and pressing and dragging across the bar scrubs between links. Five white rounded links, Home, Work, Notes, Blog and About, form one horizontal bar on a black stage. The active label is darker with a short underline, and small gaps open on each side of it so the bar reads as separate islands, with a thin caption line underneath. Choosing a link springs the gaps to surround it and darkens its label; hovering another link opens a small gap around that one. Pressing and dragging across the bar moves the split continuously and a flick lands on a later link, while keyboard focus moves link to link instantly. nav bar, link segments, active link, underline, split gaps, caption

drag across nav to scrub links

nav where the active tab pulls apart

items.name: morphing-discovery-bar
items.title: Morphing Discovery Bar

items.use: A filter row should stay compact but still offer search without opening a separate overlay.
items.text: A rounded row of category pills with a search button at one end. Clicking search widens it into a typing field while the category pills blur and slide off, and a close button brings them back. A dark rounded capsule bar holding a small circular search button and four icon-and-label pills; the active pill gets a pale tinted background and a coloured label, while the others stay neutral grey. Tapping the search circle springs it open into a wide input while the category pills blur, shrink and slide away, and a round X appears beside it. items.name: morphing-tabs
items.title: Morphing Tabs
items.blurb: Tab pills melt and split apart as the active one is chosen.
items.use: A playful nav or settings switcher where switching tabs should feel physical rather than a plain fade.
items.text: Four rounded tab buttons sit side by side; the selected one pulls away from the others while the rest blend into one continuous bar. Choosing a new tab makes the shapes flow and stretch into their new arrangement. Four light rounded rectangles labelled Home, About, Work and Contact lie in a row on a black stage. The chosen tab is pulled slightly away from its neighbours, while the remaining three touch and blend into a single bar with soft rounded ends. A small caption below reads the active tab name. Clicking a tab makes it the active one: its side margins grow so it separates, the others close up and merge, and the gooey filter stretches and rounds the join while it moves. The row settles into the new arrangement in under a second. tab buttons, merged tab bar, active caption

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.blurb: One bold word blurs and melts into the next.
items.use: A hero needs a short list of phrases to cycle in place without shifting the layout.
items.text: A large centred word that dissolves through a heavy blur and re-forms as the next phrase in a list, cycling forever without the layout moving. A single very large, heavy white sans-serif word sits in the middle of an otherwise empty black canvas. During a transition the word softens into a fat, rounded blob before sharpening into the next word. The current word blurs out while the incoming word sharpens in, the two briefly melting together, then the new word holds for half a second before the cycle repeats down the list. word, blurred word, dark background

big text that changes by itself

landing title that shifts between phrases

items.name: motion-drawer

items.use: A compact nav or filter panel should slide over the page with a physical feel.

A dark panel slides over the page from the left, about 280px wide, with a small Menu heading, four stacked link rows and a white Upgrade Plan button at the bottom. Behind it the page title Motion Drawer and its hint stay visible on black. A menu icon at the top left opens a spring-driven dark panel from the left while a light overlay dims the page; the X, an overlay click or a sideways drag closes it. Links tint on hover. menu icon, overlay, drawer panel, menu heading, nav links, upgrade button, close icon

items.text: A stack of labelled rows for Adults, Children and Rooms, each with a minus and plus button around a large number. Pressing a button or typing changes the figure with a rolling digit animation. A dark rounded card divided into three rows. Each row carries a bold label and a small grey hint on the left, and on the right a strip of minus sign, large white number and plus sign. Pressing minus or plus steps the number within its bounds and the digits roll vertically to the new value; typing into the field does the same. items.name: motion-number-upvotes
items.title: Animated Upvote Counter
items.blurb: An upvote card whose count rolls and flips green or red as you vote.
items.use: A post, comment or feature needs a lightweight up and down vote control with an animated score.
items.text: A small rounded card showing an upvote total between two round arrow buttons. Clicking up or down rolls the number and tints the card and the chosen button green or red. A compact rounded card with bold light text reading 14 Upvotes above two black circular buttons, one holding an up arrow and one a down arrow. It sits on black; pressing an arrow turns the card deep green or deep red. Pressing an arrow nudges the number up or down with a vertical rolling animation inside the total. items.name: mouse-wave-text
items.title: Mouse Wave Text
items.blurb: Bold letters ride a rolling wave that follows the cursor across the page.
items.use: A hero word should feel alive and respond to the pointer without shipping a video.
items.text: A giant word cut into thin vertical strips, each bobbing up and down with a moving delay so the letters ripple in a wave. Moving the cursor steers the wave and pressing the mouse squashes the whole word. The word Wavelength set in very heavy white capitals across a black stage, with a soft grey duplicate sitting just behind and below it. The tops of the letters stand at uneven heights, giving a rippled silhouette. A wave runs across the word, lifting and dropping each narrow slice in turn while the cursor's horizontal position shifts its phase. Holding the mouse presses the word down as the grey shadow blurs and shrinks, and releasing springs it back. word, letter strips, drop shadow, hint text

kinetic type that moves with mouse

items.name: moving-border
items.title: Moving Border Button
items.blurb: A blue spark runs around the rim of a dark pill-shaped button.
items.use: A primary button should keep drawing the eye with a slow glowing rim.
items.text: A pill button on a translucent dark slate fill with a white label. A small blue glow travels the full perimeter on a loop, so the edge is always lit in one moving spot. A rounded pill button on black, filled in a translucent dark slate with a faint darker border and a white medium-weight label reading Moving Border. A soft blue highlight glows on one part of the rim at a time. A blue radial glow circles the entire perimeter continuously, completing a lap roughly every three seconds, so the bright spot travels along the rim without a pause. phrases: button with light running around its edge
glowing ring that circles a button
neon light circling a pill button
call to action with a moving glow
button rim lit up and rotating

items.name: moving-line

items.blurb: A hairline rule down the page shortens as the reader scrolls.
items.use: A long photo story or article wants a quiet marker of how far the reader has travelled.
items.text: A vertical rule sits left of a column of story chapters and retracts from the top as the page scrolls, its last drawn point following the reader. The chapters carry dates, headings, copy and paired photos. A dark page column of travel chapters, each with a small grey date, a bold heading, a paragraph and two wide landscape photos side by side. A pale hairline rule runs down the left edge of the column, faint at the top and a little brighter toward the bottom. As the reader scrolls, the vertical line shortens from its top end, the remaining length tracking page progress and settling with a spring when scrolling stops. The chapter content scrolls past as normal. vertical rule, chapter, date label, heading, paragraph, photo pair

timeline rule tied to page position
story chapter layout with a progress bar

thin rule shrinking between photo sections

items.name: multi-layout-accordion
items.title: Multi Open Accordion
items.blurb: A question list where several answers can stay open together.
items.use: You want a compact FAQ where readers can compare several answers without reopening each one.
items.text: A single column of FAQ rows that can all be expanded at once. Each question opens its answer in place and stays open while others are opened, without collapsing the rest. A single column of dark rounded question bars under a small heading, each row ending in a chevron. Open rows show a pale header and a block of grey answer text below, with up to three answers visible at the same time. Clicking a question toggles its answer open or shut with a short height animation. items.name: multi-selector

A dark rounded field with a thin grey outline holding small rounded chips, then a clear X and a chevron. pick multiple items in one field

items.name: multi-step-loader

Each row opens with a circular check icon; the running step is lime green and the finished rows above it show solid white checks. onboarding steps finishing one by one
loading screen with checked off tasks

wait screen listing what is happening

items.name: music-toggle

items.use: A header needs a few top-level destinations whose contents are worth previewing in a panel.
items.text: A short horizontal menu of top-level links where Products and Docs carry chevrons and open a bordered panel of two-line destinations. Hovering a trigger highlights it and flips its chevron while the panel slides in. Three light grey links in a row on black, with small chevrons after Products and Docs. An open trigger gets a soft grey rounded background, and a dark bordered panel drops below holding bold titles stacked over muted description lines. Hovering or clicking a trigger opens its panel with a short slide and fade while the chevron turns upward; moving to another trigger swaps the panel in place. Clicking outside closes it. menu row, trigger, chevron, dropdown panel, link title, link description
phrases: menu bar for a website header
hover to reveal a list of pages
products and docs tabs with chevrons

items.name: neon-border
items.title: Neon Border
items.blurb: Pill-shaped cards ringed by a glowing two-colour gradient border.
items.use: A dark landing panel, pricing tier or status card that should read as futuristic and draw the eye without extra artwork.
items.text: A rounded panel wrapped in a thin gradient ring that glows outward in two colours. Three versions show the glow travelling around the edge, covering half or all of the border, or sitting still. Three stacked rounded rectangles on black, each ringed by a thin gradient stroke that fades between two colours and casts a soft coloured haze. The top ring runs blue to pink, the middle purple to magenta all the way round, the bottom green to orange. White label text sits centred inside each dark panel. The animated rings slide their colour band around the perimeter on a loop, so the glow travels steadily; the half version lights only half the edge, the full closes around, and the static one stays put. Nothing reacts to the pointer. rounded panel, gradient border, outer glow, label text
phrases: glowing gradient border around a card
neon outline that moves around the edge

items.name: neon-gradient-card
items.title: Neon Gradient Card
items.blurb: Card border drifts through pink and cyan with a soft coloured halo.
items.use: A promo or feature card should feel high-energy on an already dark page.
items.text: A dark rounded card whose thin border runs a pink-to-teal gradient that slides and pulses endlessly, throwing a blurred glow onto the backdrop. The content sits untouched inside. A near-black rounded rectangle centred on a very dark stage. Its thin border carries a magenta-to-cyan gradient and casts a soft coloured haze onto the surrounding backdrop. Three lines of heavy gradient text fill the inside. The gradient slides up and down the border on a slow three-second loop that alternates direction, and the blurred halo outside shifts with it. The card itself never reacts to the pointer or clicks. card, gradient border, outer glow, gradient heading
phrases: neon frame around a content box
glowing halo behind a dark panel

items.name: nested-vaul-drawer
items.title: Nested Vaul Drawer
items.blurb: Bottom sheets that stack on top of each other as you go deeper.
items.use: A mobile or tablet flow needs layers of detail shown as stacked bottom sheets with swipe to close.
items.text: A black stage with a single Open Drawer button. Clicking it raises a dark bottom sheet with a drag handle, a title and text, and buttons inside open further sheets layered on top, each dismissed by swiping or tapping away. Idle, just a small white rounded button on black. Opened, a charcoal sheet rises from the bottom with a short grab handle, a bold title, two or three grey paragraphs and a full-width pale button. A nested sheet covers most of it, repeating the handle, title, copy and button. Clicking the button slides a sheet up over a dimmed backdrop with a springy settle. The inner buttons push new sheets up on top of the previous ones, and dragging the handle down or tapping the backdrop closes them in order. trigger button, dim overlay, drag handle, sheet, title, paragraph, inner button, footer links
phrases: bottom sheet that stacks another sheet
drawer that opens from the bottom

items.name: network
items.title: Network
items.blurb: Rings of portraits circle a centre while a coloured line links two people.
items.use: A section should convey many people connected around one hub, such as a community or team map.
items.text: A circular diagram of two dashed rings packed with small portrait avatars around a larger central one. Every few seconds a glowing coloured line draws between two random people and their names appear as little labels. A dark field with two faint dashed circles, the outer ring crowded with small round portraits and the inner ring a little smaller, all around one large central face. Small white name pills float above a few avatars. Every four seconds the previous link vanishes and a new coloured line draws itself between two random portraits while their name pills fade in; hovering any avatar also reveals its name. The whole layout rescales with the window. outer ring, inner ring, avatar, centre avatar, connection line, name label
phrases: circle of faces connected by lines

items.name: neumorph-eyebrow
items.title: Neumorph Eyebrow
items.blurb: Tiny embossed labels that sit above a heading.
items.use: You need a short pre-heading label that reads as a soft physical tag rather than a flat chip.
items.text: A short, pill-shaped label with a thin border and a soft pressed-in shadow, made to sit above a section heading. It comes in cream, pale blue and pale green. Small fully rounded pills with a hairline border and a soft top-lit glow that makes them look pressed out of the surface. The default is cream with near-black text; the other two tint both fill and text pale blue or pale green. Static: nothing moves or responds. Each pill simply shows its short piece of text, and hovering or clicking does nothing. pill label, label text, soft border
phrases: tiny pill label above a heading
pre heading pill for a landing page

items.name: noise-background
items.title: Noise Background
items.blurb: Slow pink, blue and orange blobs drift behind a fine grain wash.
items.use: A hero or call-to-action panel needs a warm moving colour wash without images or a shader.
items.text: A soft full-bleed panel of drifting colour: violet-pink and warm orange blobs move slowly over deep blue-green, with a fine grain texture and a thin rainbow strip along the top edge. A full-bleed, soft-focus wash of colour with deep blue-green at the edges, a violet-pink area through the middle and a warm orange patch toward the right. A fine grain sits over the whole panel and a tiny grey label marks the centre. Three radial colour blobs drift slowly in random directions, easing along and changing course every couple of seconds while staying inside the frame. A thin multicolour strip along the top edge slides in step with them. gradient blobs, noise grain, top colour strip, label
phrases: aurora style background for a section

items.name: not-found-page
items.title: Not Found Page
items.blurb: Oversized 404 numerals fade into black above a short apology and two buttons.
items.use: A site 404 should feel calm and on-brand instead of showing a browser error.
items.text: A centred error page with huge 404 digits whose lower halves fade out, a two-line explanation and Go Home and Explore buttons. It sits on an empty-state layout with generous negative space. A black stage with three enormous white-to-grey numerals, their lower halves dissolving into the background, over two centred lines of white text and a pair of pill buttons, one solid light and one dark with an outline. Static apart from the buttons: each changes fill under the cursor, with Go Home in the solid style and Explore outlined. 404 numerals, explanation text, home button, explore button
phrases: go home button on error screen
minimal error page for a website
dead end page with two actions

items.name: notch
items.title: Notch
items.blurb: A small floating pill holds theme, text and language pickers that pop open.
items.use: A reading app or dashboard needs a few global settings always reachable without a full menu.
items.text: A capsule pinned near the screen edge with grouped settings; each group opens into a short list of choices and the bar shows the current value for every group. A dark rounded capsule floats low on a near-black article page, split by dotted dividers into three items, each with a small icon plus a label and current value. Opening one raises a narrow panel of rounded option rows. Tapping a group expands the pill upward into a list with a spring and blur, the active row filled indigo with a dot. Choosing closes it and updates the bar; clicking outside or pressing Escape dismisses it. floating pill, group trigger, dotted divider, icon, selected value, option panel, option row
phrases: floating settings bar at the bottom
small menu that drops from a pill
reader settings for font size and theme

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.blurb: A stack of notification cards that fans open on hover and swipes off to dismiss.
items.use: A dashboard or inbox should show a few recent alerts without taking up a full panel.
items.text: A short pile of notification cards showing app, message and time, with a count and a Show all toggle. Hovering fans them into a list, and swiping one or pressing its corner cross removes it. A header row with Notifications, a count and a Show all link above stacked white rounded cards, each with a coloured app icon, a bold title, a grey body line and a time. Collapsed, the cards behind peek out as thin strips. Hovering or focusing fans the pile into a full list and the header flips to Show less. Dragging the front card sideways follows the pointer and, past a short distance or a quick flick, throws it off the edge while the rest close the gap. header, count, show all toggle, notification card, app icon, timestamp, dismiss cross
phrases: stack of alerts that fans out
card pile that opens on hover

items.name: notion-mention-link
items.title: Notion Mention Link
items.blurb: Hover a page link to pop open a card with image, blurb and domain.
items.use: Long documents cite other pages and readers should glimpse the target without leaving the text.
items.text: A Notion-style inline mention of a web page, shown with a tiny favicon and the page title. Hovering it brings up a card with the page's image, summary and domain without leaving the document. Body text in a document with an inline chip made of a small square favicon, a grey site name and an underlined bold page title. On hover a rounded card drops below holding a mountain photo, a heading, a short paragraph and the domain. Hovering or focusing the link waits a moment, then shows a loading skeleton that settles into the preview card; leaving closes it shortly after. Details can be fetched and cached on mount or on first hover. document heading, paragraph, favicon chip, site name, page title link, preview card, preview image, preview text
phrases: clickable mention of a web page

items.name: novatrix-background
items.title: Novatrix Background
items.blurb: Soft iridescent ribbons of mint, pink and lavender drift like folded silk.
items.use: A landing or hero area wants a soft moving backdrop behind text without images or video.
items.text: A full-bleed animated background of flowing pastel bands in mint, pink and purple, like light folding through silk. It drifts on its own and can be set to lean toward the pointer. The whole frame is filled with smooth, glossy bands of pale mint, bubblegum pink, lavender and white, curving into folds and hollows with no text or controls. The palette is light and high-key. The bands slide and fold continuously in a slow loop, so no shape ever settles. With pointer response switched on, the pattern drifts slightly toward the cursor. colour bands, fold highlights, shadowed troughs
phrases: shifting gradient for a landing page

items.name: number-flow-trading
items.title: Live Price Ticker
items.blurb: A share price that rolls to new numbers, with a green or red change badge.
items.use: A dashboard or marketing page wants a compact animated price readout with a direction indicator.
items.text: A stock-style price display for NVDA showing a large dollar figure and a rounded badge with an arrow and percent change. A Shuffle button cycles sample prices, rolling the digits and turning the arrow for losses. A large white dollar amount sits on black beneath a small NVDA · Nasdaq caption. Beside the price is a small rounded pill in green or red holding a tiny arrow and a percentage, with a dark Shuffle pill centred below. Pressing Shuffle swaps to another sample price: the dollar digits roll vertically to the new value, the percent badge updates colour, and its arrow spins to point down when the change is negative. ticker caption, price, change badge, arrow, shuffle button

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.blurb: Numbers spring upward from zero to their target values.
items.use: A stats section should make its numbers feel alive when it comes into view.
items.text: An animated figure that counts up or down to a target with a spring easing the first time it scrolls into view, formatted with commas and optional decimals. Three large white numbers stacked on black, each above a small grey label: a user count, a percentage and a dollar figure. The digits are tight, bold and tabular. Each number rises from zero toward its target once it enters the viewport, decelerating into place and then staying fixed. user count, users label, uptime percentage, percentage label, revenue figure, revenue label

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.blurb: A short setup card steps through dots, choices and Next.
items.use: A product needs a short, self-contained first-run setup with a few steps and choices.
items.text: A bordered setup card that walks through a few steps: dot progress at the top, a serif title and description, step content, then Back and Next buttons, with Start Creating on the last step. A rounded bordered card on dark holds a centred row of three small dots, a serif heading in white and a grey description. Step content sits below, with two pill buttons at the bottom: a muted Back and a white Next. Clicking Next advances the dots and swaps the step content; Back returns and sits disabled on the first step. On the final step Next turns into Start Creating. Choice rows lighten on hover. step dots, title, description, step content, back button, next button
phrases: install wizard steps with back and next
guided setup for a new user

items.name: opacity-swapy
items.title: Opacity Swapy Layout
items.blurb: Pastel icon rows in a narrow list that turns half see-through while dragged.
items.use: A short list of items should be reordered by dragging the row itself with clear feedback.
items.text: Six pale tinted rows, each with a coloured line icon and a short benefit title, stacked in a narrow column. Dragging a row drops it to half opacity while the others slide apart to show where it will land. A narrow centred column of six rounded rows in pale blue, pink, green, yellow, purple and cyan on black, each with a thin dashed outline, a small coloured icon at the left and a dark medium-weight label. Dragging a row anywhere on its surface lifts it out of the stack at half opacity, and the rows above and below slide apart to open a gap. Releasing settles it into that gap, and the list holds the new order until the page reloads. row, icon, label
phrases: pastel rows you can drag to sort
reorder a vertical list of benefits
draggable list with a faded item
rows that slide apart when dragged
rearrange order by dragging a row
light list on a dark page

items.name: open-in-chat
items.title: Open in Chat
items.blurb: Buttons and a dropdown that send a prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
items.use: A docs or blog page wants readers to continue a question in a full AI chat instead of a short callout.
items.text: A small control that turns a prompt into links opening it in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok or v0. It can appear as an inline row of brand icons or as a dropdown under one trigger. A card footer with a pale bar holding the label Ask AI and five tiny brand marks, plus an outlined Open in chat button with a chevron. The open menu is a dark rounded panel of five labelled rows, each with a brand glyph and a small external-link arrow. Clicking the trigger drops the list of assistants; choosing a row opens that service in a new tab with the prompt filled into its query. The inline version shows each site as an icon, and hovering one shows a tooltip naming it. Ask AI label, brand icon, Open in chat button, dropdown panel, menu row, external-link arrow, tooltip
phrases: ask ai links for an article
pass a prompt to another ai
share question with an ai tool
hand off text to a chatbot

items.name: option-wheel
items.title: Option Wheel
items.blurb: A curved list of options spins to a blurred, tilting selection.
items.use: A short list of labels should feel tactile and playful rather than a plain dropdown.
items.text: A vertical wheel of word options arranged on an arc. Scrolling, dragging or arrow keys spin it with momentum, and the item at rest sits sharp and white while its neighbours tilt and blur. Genre names stack down an invisible arc on the left of a black stage, sharpest and white in the middle and fading to grey, tilted and blurred above and below. A large title and a small instruction sit to the right. Scrolling, dragging or the arrow keys roll the list with eased momentum; the chosen word snaps to the middle, turns white and grows. Neighbouring words lean away, dim and blur, and the readout on the right updates. option word, curved list, selection, readout heading, instruction text

items.name: orbit-carousel
items.title: Orbit Carousel
items.blurb: Profile photos orbit a ring while the chosen one fills a card in the centre.
items.use: A team or community page wants a memorable way to browse several people one at a time.
items.text: A team carousel where eight round avatars sit on a circle around a centred profile card. Stepping with the arrows, or clicking an avatar, swings the ring around with a springy overshoot and swaps the card. A faint circle on black ringed by eight circular portraits, one edged in indigo. In the middle a small rounded card shows a larger photo overlapping its top edge, a bold name, a role and email in grey, and two chevrons either side of a purple Connect pill. Pressing an arrow or clicking a portrait rotates every avatar around the circle with a bouncy spring, and the card fades out and back in with the new person's details. The active portrait keeps its photo upright and carries an indigo ring. orbit ring, avatar, profile card, profile photo, name, role and email, connect button, chevrons
phrases: team members arranged in a circle
click an avatar to see their info

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.blurb: Coloured lettered dots circle a small hub on two faint rings.
items.use: A product wants a looping diagram of tools or steps circling a central hub.
items.text: Small coloured discs marked with letters travel along two circular orbits around a central Hub circle, the inner ring spinning faster and the opposite way from the outer. A dark panel with a tiny circle labelled Hub at the centre and two thin faint ring outlines around it. On the rings sit small round chips, three on the inner and four on the outer, each in a different bright colour with a white letter. The chips glide smoothly around the rings without pause, the inner ones clockwise and quicker, the outer ones the other way and slower. Nothing is clickable; the motion runs on its own. hub, orbit ring, orbiting circle, letter

items.name: origin-ui-timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.blurb: Steps stack on a thin vertical rail, filled up to the current stage.
items.use: You need a fixed sequence of stages with dates and a clear sense of how far along it is.
items.text: A vertical list of five numbered stages, each with a small date, a bold title, a description and a hollow circle on a connecting line. Steps up to the active one brighten, and clicking a title moves the marker. A narrow column on a black stage holds a small uppercase label, a bold heading and five stacked entries. Each entry has a faint date, a title, a two-line grey description, and a small ring on a thin vertical line at the left; the first entries look brighter than the last two. Clicking a step title makes it the active stage, so that entry and all above it turn bright while the rest stay dim. The recording shifts the active step a few times and the rail fills up to the chosen point; nothing scrolls or folds. section label, heading, vertical rail, step circle, step date, step title, step description
phrases: order tracking steps down the page
dots connected by a line with dates
order status stepper for a shop
checkout progress shown as a list
activity feed with dots and dates

items.name: page-flip
items.title: Page Flip
items.blurb: A book whose pages you drag by the corner to turn.
items.use: A short collection of content should feel like a printed book or menu you leaf through.
items.text: A two-page book styled like a printed menu. Dragging a corner folds the paper over the spine with a live shadow, and releasing springs it flat onto the next spread, with arrows and a page counter below. An open book showing two dark grey pages with a faint gutter at the spine and small page numbers, sitting on black. Closed, it becomes a deep green cover with a thin circular emblem and a prompt to turn the corner. Dragging a page corner peels the sheet across the spine, bending a folded triangle with a soft shadow. Releasing past the spine completes the turn and springs flat, while a short tap or an arrow key also advances. book cover, paper spread, page corner, fold shadow, spine gutter, page counter, nav arrows
phrases: book with pages you can turn
two page spread with page numbers

items.name: pagination-animated
items.title: Pagination (animated)
items.blurb: The current-page outline glides along the row when you pick a new number.
items.use: A long list or table is split into pages and the current page should stay obvious while you page through.
items.text: A horizontal page switcher with Previous and Next arrows, numbered links and an ellipsis. The rounded highlight marking the current page slides to the link you choose instead of blinking across. On a black stage, one thin row: a Previous link with a left chevron, the numbers 1 to 5 spaced evenly, a three-dot ellipsis, then Next with a right chevron. The active number sits in a soft grey rounded rectangle slightly lighter than the bare links. Clicking a number, Previous or Next moves the grey highlight to that link, easing it across the row with a short spring rather than hiding and reappearing. Hovering a link tints its background faintly; otherwise the row is still. previous link, page number, current page outline, ellipsis, next link
phrases: page numbers with previous and next arrows
sliding highlight on the current page number
row of links to move between pages of results
numbered page switcher with more pages dots
browse long list one page at a time
outline that moves when you change page
how do i jump between pages of a list

items.name: paper-crumple
items.title: Paper Crumple
items.blurb: A photo crumples into a folded paper ball while you drag it.
items.use: A portfolio or campaign wants a playful, tactile image that reacts to a press and drag.
items.text: An image on a 3D paper sheet that crumples in your hand as you hold and drag it, the folds catching the light, then springs back flat when released. A portrait photo of a mountain range above clouds, printed edge to edge on a sheet with a slight paper texture and soft drop shadow. Mid-gesture it balls up into a wrinkled, faceted clump with the image wrapped around the folds. Pressing and dragging pushes the sheet into itself, buckling the image into creases and a rounded clump that follows the pointer and tilts as it is thrown. Releasing lets it smooth back into a flat photo. photo sheet, paper folds, drop shadow, caption
phrases: hold and drag to wrinkle picture

items.name: parallax-floating
items.title: Parallax Floating
items.blurb: Scattered photos drift at different speeds as the pointer crosses the page.
items.use: A creative hero or promo panel wants a playful photo collage that reacts to the pointer without needing scroll.
items.text: A set of small photographs scattered around a centred serif wordmark, each sitting at its own depth so the collage slides in layers when the pointer moves and the headline stays still. On a black canvas, eight small photographs of mixed shapes and sizes are pinned around the edges and corners, each in a thin frame. In the middle sits a large cream serif italic wordmark with a small white rounded Download pill beneath it. As the pointer moves, every photo eases toward it by an amount set by its depth, so the pictures drift at different speeds while the centre wordmark holds still. Photos fade in one after another on load and grow a little on hover. photo tiles, centre wordmark, download pill, black backdrop
phrases: photos around a headline that shift with the mouse
layered picture collage that drifts with the pointer
small floating images at different depths
pictures that move at different speeds on mouse move
scattered snapshots around a large centred logo
interactive photo layout for a creative studio
how to make images follow the cursor in layers

items.name: parallax-hero-images
items.title: Parallax Hero Images
items.blurb: Photo cards pin to the screen edges and drift gently with the cursor.
items.use: A landing hero wants a calm, editorial photo collage with gentle pointer depth.
items.text: Up to eight rounded photos pinned around the edges of a hero, each floating a little against the pointer at its own depth. It is a calm, blurred-in collage meant to sit behind headline copy. A dark hero with six rounded photo cards around its margins: mountain ranges along the top, a laptop and a black sneaker at the sides, a figure in soft cloud and a single leaf at the bottom. Between them sit a small pill, a very large bold white headline and a short grey paragraph. Each photo stays pinned to its spot but glides up to forty pixels away from the pointer at its own depth on a spring, so the collage breathes as the cursor moves. On load the photos fade in one by one from blurred and slightly small. photo cards, dark backdrop, pill, headline, paragraph
phrases: hero with floating photos around the edges
images that shift with the mouse
moodboard collage for a landing page
photo cards floating behind a headline

items.name: parallax-scroll-2
items.title: Rotated Parallax Grid
items.blurb: Photo columns tilt and slide in opposite directions as you scroll.
items.use: A showcase needs a bolder, more editorial take on a scrolling photo wall.
items.text: Three columns of photo tiles whose outer two lean and travel sideways as the box scrolls, one clockwise and one anticlockwise, while the middle one stays upright. It reads as a leaning gallery wall. A three-column wall of rounded photo tiles on black whose outer columns sit at visible angles. The photos show a forest at sunset, a hand holding a device, a red-and-yellow striped facade, a snow-capped peak, a couple on a bench in golden light and a hazy shoreline. Scrolling moves the outer columns upward and inward while rotating them further, the left one anticlockwise and the right clockwise, so the wall shears and the rows cross. The middle column stays straight, and everything returns when you scroll back. photo grid, tilted column, photo tile, middle column
phrases: image columns that rotate as you scroll

items.name: parallax-scroll
items.title: Parallax Scroll Grid
items.blurb: Three columns of photos drift at different speeds as you scroll.
items.use: A photo gallery should gain a sense of depth as visitors scroll past it.
items.text: A scroll box holding three columns of photo tiles. As it scrolls, the outer columns rise while the middle one sinks, so the pictures slide past each other and the rows never stay level. A three-column wall of rounded landscape photos on black, spaced with wide even gaps. Each column stacks warm, atmospheric shots: vintage cars before yellow garage doors, a backlit figure in golden light, a grey sea wall, a starry night and a patch of forest. Scrolling the box moves the outer two columns upward and the middle one downward, each by a different amount, so photos cross and no row stays aligned. They settle at their offsets when scrolling stops. photo grid, column, photo tile
phrases: photo grid that shifts while scrolling
three columns of pictures at different speeds
image wall with depth on scroll
photos drift apart as the page moves

items.name: particle-button
items.title: Particle Button
items.blurb: It flips to a spinner, then a tick, or shakes red when the save fails.
items.use: A click starts an async save, publish or payment and the button should report its outcome in place.
items.text: A button for async actions. Returning a promise makes the label crossfade to a spinner and a pending word, then to a drawn tick and success word with a burst of particles, or to a red shaking error. Three small pill buttons on black: a white filled Save changes, a dark outlined Publish post with a right arrow, and a grey Pay $49.00. While busy the icon becomes a spinner, success swaps in a drawn tick, and failure turns the whole button red with an alert circle. A click shows the pending label while the promise runs and the button's width springs to fit each new word. On resolution the label blurs and slides to a tick and success word, with small chips bursting from the top edge, or the button shakes and stays red long enough to read. button surface, button label, status icon, arrow icon, particle burst
phrases: button that shows saving then saved
async button with spinner and check
submit button that shakes on error
button with a particle burst on success
payment button with loading and declined states
form submit with an error shake

items.name: particle-image
items.title: Particle Image
items.blurb: A logo drawn in tiny dots that scatter where the cursor sweeps.
items.use: A hero or portfolio showcase where a logo or photo should feel alive and reward the pointer moving across it.
items.text: An image is rebuilt out of thousands of small dots that hold the picture's own colours. Moving the pointer through it pushes the dots apart, opening a gap that slowly heals back into the shape. On a black stage, the word Spark and a lightning bolt are formed from a dense field of tiny pale dots rather than solid ink. Where the cursor has passed, the dots are flung into a widening ring, leaving a hole shaped like the pointer's path. A faint caption sits above. Every dot drifts toward its place in the picture, so the logo holds together while shimmering slightly. Sweeping the pointer across it shoves nearby dots outward on a circular wave; when the cursor leaves, they are pulled back and the logo reforms. particle logo, dot field, scatter hole, caption
phrases: image made of tiny moving dots
picture that scatters when you move mouse
image dissolves into particles on hover

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.blurb: Tiny white specks drift on black and scatter from the cursor.
items.use: A dark hero needs gentle motion and depth that reacts to the pointer.
items.text: A canvas field of small white dots that drift slowly and push away from the pointer, fading in and out near the edges. A headline can sit on top. A black stage sparsely dusted with tiny white dots of varying brightness, densest across the middle. A large grey gradient word sits centred over the dots. Dots drift in random directions and fade out near the canvas edges; the pointer gently pushes nearby dots aside as it moves across the field. dot field, particles, headline
phrases: floating dots that follow the mouse

items.name: pass-strength-dotted-indicator
items.title: Password Strength Dotted
items.blurb: Password field fills five colour-coded dots as the rules pass.
items.use: A sign-up or reset form must show, rule by rule, why a chosen password is accepted or rejected.
items.text: A password field that fills a row of five dots and ticks off five rules as you type. A status line names the current strength and an eye button reveals what you entered. A dark form column on black: a Password label, a rounded input with a placeholder and an eye icon, then five pale rounded bars in a row. Below sits a Must contain line with a strength word and a five-line checklist with tick or cross icons. Typing fills the dots from left to right and recolours them green as more rules pass, while each checklist line flips from a cross to a green tick. items.name: settings-page

items.name: shader-lens-blur

items.use: A hero or feature panel needs a single bold shape with an interactive, tactile surface.
items.text: A WebGL shader that draws a large rounded triangle filled with drifting pastel colour, blurring and inverting near the pointer and following touch. gradient blob that reacts to mouse
interactive shader shape for a hero

items.name: shader-reveal-transition
items.title: Shader Reveal Transition
items.blurb: Photos wipe into each other under a colourful noise or stripe shader.
items.use: A gallery or hero needs a memorable scene change between images, and a plain crossfade feels too ordinary.
items.text: A framed image card that swaps scenes behind a full-cover WebGL shader. Each change plays one of eight effects — noise, wipe, circle, stripes, zoom, luma, planetary or push — chosen from pills beneath the frame. A wide 16:9 photo sits in a rounded frame with a place name and white title in the lower left. Under it, a row of small round outline pills names eight effects, with Next scene at the right; mid-change the frame fills with pink, green and cyan shader patterns. Pressing Next scene starts a shader wipe: a bright noise, blade or stripe pattern sweeps across the frame, the photo swaps at the midpoint, and the pattern fades to reveal the new one. Choosing a pill sets the effect for the next wipe. photo frame, place label, photo title, variant pill, next button, shader overlay

items.name: shadow-text
items.title: Shadow Text

items.text: A hero heading whose letters throw long, soft shadows angled by the time of day or by the pointer acting as a lamp. A subtitle and call-to-action button sit beneath. A large white sans-serif headline sits centred in a dark rounded panel above a muted subtitle and a small white pill button. Each letter carries a long soft black shadow stretching away, and a tiny mono line at the bottom-left records the time. The shadows rest at an angle set from the clock and tick forward every half minute. items.name: shape-hero

items.text: A hero section where named component pills and coloured dots drop in, collide and settle into a heap along the bottom. The pile can be grabbed and thrown, and rests once it stops moving. A full-width dark section with a small dot badge, a two-line white headline, a grey paragraph and two pill buttons centred above. Around and below them, outlined and dark labelled pills plus orange and white circles lie at odd angles in a loose pile. On load the shapes fall from above in sequence, bounce off each other and the edges, and settle. items.name: shared-tooltip

A dark rounded toolbar holds five thin white icons: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and a link. Above the hovered icon sits a white rounded bubble with dark text and a small downward arrow; the active icon gains a faint grey square behind it. Hovering an icon opens the shared tooltip above it after a short delay. items.name: shifting-dropdown
