items.text: A heavy heading with a handful of small four-point stars scattered over and around it, each fading and scaling in and out at random spots so the text keeps glittering. The words sit large and bold in white on black, with a few very small four-point stars in purple and pink dotted around the letters. The stars are much smaller than the type and easy to overlook. Each star shrinks to nothing and grows back at a slightly different moment, at random positions over the text, and the set is periodically replaced so new spots light up. heading text, sparkle star, dark background
phrases: four point stars near a title

items.name: sparkles-title
items.title: Sparkles Title
items.blurb: A glowing blue horizon with sparkles behind a centred logo and headline.
items.use: A product's front page needs a calm, atmospheric hero that puts a logo, name and one-sentence pitch front and centre.
items.text: A hero block with a glowing blue arc at the bottom, a faint grid, tiny rising sparkle particles, a small white logo tile and a centred white headline over a short paragraph. On black, a soft blue glow rises from the bottom centre inside a wide dome, with a fine grid of faint lines across the top and small white specks drifting upward. A white rounded-square logo sits above a centred white headline and two small grey lines of copy. The background sparkles drift slowly upward and fade in and out while the blue glow and grid stay still. Hovering or clicking adds particles, but the title and copy never move. glow arc, grid lines, sparkle particles, logo tile, headline, body copy
phrases: black hero with blue glow arc
grid and glow backdrop for text

items.name: sparkles
items.title: Sparkles
items.blurb: White specks drift upward on black, twinkling and sparking under the pointer.
items.use: A launch or beta hero needs a living backdrop that reacts to the pointer without competing with the headline.
items.text: A full-bleed field of tiny white particles drifting upward while their brightness pulses. Moving the pointer pulls thin lines between nearby dots and a click adds a burst of new ones. A black stage packed edge to edge with hundreds of small white dots of slightly varied size. Centred on top sits a faint uppercase eyebrow, a large white headline and a short two-line paragraph. Dots rise continuously while each one fades in and out, so the field sparkles. Bringing the pointer close draws faint lines to nearby dots, and clicking pushes a burst of particles outward before they resume drifting. particle field, dots, eyebrow label, headline, paragraph
phrases: twinkling particle field for a hero
interactive particles that follow the cursor
animated particle canvas for landing page

items.name: special-offer
items.title: Special Offer Banner
items.blurb: Cyber sale strip with a glowing countdown and a boxed promo code.
items.use: You want a loud, self-contained sale banner that keeps the deadline visible while the page is open.
items.text: A full-width bar for a limited-time sale: copy on the left, a countdown of days, hours, minutes and seconds in the middle, and a boxed discount code on the right. It ticks down each second, then swaps to an ended message. A wide dark bar with a warm orange glow behind the left copy, fading to near-black on the right. The left column holds a small blue label, a white headline and a highlighted paragraph. Four square countdown tiles follow, the first orange and the rest blue, split by colons, ending in a bordered promo-code box. The countdown drops once per second while the four tiles keep their values padded to two digits. Once the target date passes, the banner is replaced by a short 'Sale Ended!' message. Nothing responds to hover, click or keyboard. sale label, headline, offer paragraph, countdown tiles, separators, promo code box
phrases: limited time offer strip with timer
promo code bar across the page
sale countdown with days hours minutes seconds
black friday banner with glowing numbers
website banner showing percent off and coupon

items.name: specular-button
items.title: Specular Button
items.blurb: Dark glass buttons with a bright sheen that follows the cursor around the rim.
items.use: A dark or premium landing page needs a call to action that reacts to the cursor without leaving the page.
items.text: A pair of rounded glass buttons on black. A specular highlight and faint glow travel along the button's edge toward the pointer, brightening as it approaches and easing back to a dim idle shine. Two rounded rectangles sit side by side on a black field. The left is near-black glass with a thin grey rim and a white "Get started" label; the right is tinted deep indigo with a violet rim and a lighter "Book a demo" label. Both carry soft outer shadows and a faint light streak along part of the border. The rim sheen slides around the edge to face the cursor and the button brightens as the pointer nears, from about 250px away. Pressing adds a stronger shine that then fades, and when the pointer leaves the light eases to a dim idle spot. button, glass fill, rounded rim, label, specular sheen
phrases: glass button with light on the edge
frosted glass call to action button
premium black button with rim light

items.name: speech-input
items.title: Speech Input
items.blurb: Round mic button goes red and ripples outward while it listens.
items.use: A composer or email box should let people speak their message instead of typing it.
items.text: A circular dictation button. Tapping it starts listening, turns it red with a stop square and sends out pulsing rings; tapping again ends the recording and hands the words to your text field. A dark rounded card holding two lines of grey draft text, a small hint at the lower left and a round button at the lower right. The button is white with a dark microphone glyph, and red with a white square while recording. Tapping starts listening: the button fills red, the glyph swaps to a stop square and three rings pulse outward on staggered delays. Tapping again returns it to white, and a spinner takes the glyph's place while the audio is being transcribed. text field, draft text, hint text, mic button, stop icon, pulse rings
phrases: mic button that types what you say
voice dictation control for a textarea
record audio with pulsing red rings
round mic icon that turns into a stop
dictate a message instead of typing

items.name: speed-dial
items.title: Speed Dial
items.blurb: Plus button spins to a cross as labelled actions fan upward.
items.use: One obvious action should stay in reach while a few secondary actions hide until the user asks for them.
items.text: A round floating button that opens a vertical stack of quick actions. The plus rotates into a close cross while Share, Copy and Like slide up with their labels, arriving one after another. A round white button with a black plus sits low on a dark stage. Opened, three circular outlined icon buttons stack above it, each with a small rounded label sitting to its left. Clicking the plus rotates it into a cross and reveals the stack, whose items fade and slide in with a short stagger. Picking an action collapses the stack, spins the trigger back and prints a status line above it. trigger button, plus icon, action button, action icon, action label, status line
phrases: floating action button with quick actions
plus button that fans out options
quick action menu that fans out
expandable stack of buttons on click
quick action menu from one circle

items.name: spending-ring
items.title: Spending Ring
items.blurb: Spin a spending donut and it settles with one category's total under the marker.
items.use: A finance dashboard wants a compact category breakdown that people can explore by spinning.
items.text: A monthly spending donut chart you can spin like a dial. Each slice that passes the top marker takes over the centre, showing its name, amount, share and change. A dark rounded card holds a multicoloured donut ring with a small dark marker at the top, a large amount and percentage in the middle, and a two-column legend of coloured dots and rounded totals below. Dragging around the ring turns it and dims unselected slices while the centre readout swaps to whatever sits under the marker. A flick coasts on a spring and settles, and clicking a legend row turns straight to it. title, total, donut ring, marker, centre readout, legend row
phrases: spending donut chart you can spin
drag the wheel to read a slice

items.name: spinning-text
items.title: Spinning Text
items.blurb: A circular caption of white letters turns steadily on black.
items.use: A badge, stamp or hero accent should show a rotating circular caption.
items.text: A string of small text laid out around a circle with dot separators, rotating continuously so the whole ring of words travels around the centre. A thin ring of small white letters on black, each character angled to follow the circle. Round dots separate the phrases, and the letters are tightly and evenly spaced around the empty centre. The entire ring rotates at a constant speed in one direction, so each word sweeps past the top and around again. It never stops or changes pace. letter, separator dot, text ring
phrases: text going round in a circle

items.name: spline
items.title: Spline
items.blurb: A glossy 3D robot turns and leans to follow your pointer.
items.use: A landing hero or feature banner where a 3D mascot or product model should react to the visitor's pointer.
items.text: A dark two-column banner with a headline and paragraph on the left and a real-time 3D robot on the right. The robot rotates and shifts its pose as the pointer moves across the canvas. A wide black banner split in two: white headline and grey paragraph on the left, a glossy black-and-white humanoid robot on the right. The robot has a smooth rounded helmet head, a chest with fine mesh texture and articulated arms, lit from above against the dark. The 3D robot turns, tilts and shifts nearer or farther as the pointer moves across the canvas, giving the impression it is watching the cursor. While the scene downloads, a loading message sits in its place. 3D robot, canvas, headline, paragraph
phrases: webgl model that reacts to pointer

items.name: split-flap-text
items.title: Split Flap Text
items.blurb: A departure board of dark letter tiles that clacks through to each new phrase.
items.use: A headline or status line should feel mechanical and retro, cycling through several short messages.
items.text: A split-flap board that scrambles its letter tiles and settles on a new line each cycle, styled like an airport departures sign. Words, timing and tile styling are configurable. Rows of small dark rounded tiles each hold one pale monospace capital, split by a faint hinge line across the middle. Sparse uppercase captions sit above and below the board on a black surface. Every character cycles through random glyphs before settling on its target, cascading left to right, then the board holds and moves to the next phrase on a loop. tile, character, hinge line, top caption, bottom caption

items.name: spoiler-text
items.title: Spoiler Text
items.blurb: Hidden phrases sit under shimmering static that scatters away when clicked.
items.use: A conversation or article must hide a plot point behind a deliberate click.
items.text: Inline hidden text covered by a drifting field of speckles, shown inside a small group chat. Clicking or focusing a patch throws the specks outward and fades the words into view, and Hide again restores them. A dark chat panel headed # the-finale holds three messages, each with a round initial avatar, name, time and a short paragraph. Two phrases are replaced by dense rectangular patches of pale speckles; revealed phrases show normal text on a faint grey highlight, with a Hide again link at top right. While hidden, the specks twinkle and drift inside each phrase's box. Clicking a patch, or focusing it and pressing Enter, sends a wave from that point that blows the specks outward as they fade, letting the blurred words sharpen, while Hide again re-covers both phrases. chat panel, channel name, avatar, message text, speckled spoiler patch, hide again button
phrases: click to reveal hidden text inline
speckled blur that clears on click
tv show spoiler cover in a chat
reveal text with a particle wave

items.name: spotlight-card1
items.title: Spotlight Bento Grid
items.blurb: Photo tiles in a bento grid lit by a faint pointer glow.
items.use: A landing section needs varied tile sizes to show several features at once.
items.text: A rounded black panel of photo tiles arranged in a bento grid, one large and two small. A faint light tracks the cursor, and one card can carry a heading and paragraph. A dark bento grid of image tiles: a square photo of a brick hall sign, a wide sunlit field under a blue gradient sky, and a large pale tile with blue jellyfish-like forms and wisps scattered across it. A faint radial highlight follows the pointer over the tiles and a soft gradient tracks it inside each card. The pictures themselves never move or animate. bento grid, large tile, small tile, photo, glow
phrases: feature grid with different tile sizes
stat tiles mixed with a big image
bento box layout for a landing page

items.name: spotlight-card4
items.title: Proximity Spotlight Card
items.blurb: A skyline photo card with a heading and a quiet pointer glow.
items.use: One feature needs a visual card that still feels alive as the pointer passes.
items.text: A single dark card pairing a city-at-dusk photo with a heading and a line about supported technologies. A faint spotlight follows the pointer near it. One dark rounded card floating on black, with a wide dusk cityscape photo near the top, a white centred heading and three grey centred lines of small body text beneath. A soft proximity spotlight brightens a patch of the card as the pointer approaches, though in the clip the card looks almost still. Nothing is clickable. card, city photo, heading, body text, glow
phrases: card with a photo and pointer glow
dark card that lights near the cursor
single card with image and caption
spotlight card for a feature list
card that reacts as the mouse nears
rounded tile with photo on top
image and text card with soft light

items.name: spotlight-new
items.title: Spotlight
items.blurb: Two soft blue beams sweep down from the top corners behind a headline.
items.use: A dark hero needs depth behind centred copy without carrying an image or video.
items.text: A black hero backdrop with two wide diagonal shafts of pale blue light that drift slowly in opposite directions behind centred white copy. A near-black stage with two broad, blurred light shafts falling inward from the upper corners in pale blue, forming a soft V over the middle. A white headline and a grey subline sit centred on top. Each pair of gradient panels slides sideways a short distance and eases back on a slow loop, so the light gently breathes behind the text. Nothing responds to the pointer. dark backdrop, left light shaft, right light shaft, headline, subtext
phrases: blue light beams behind a headline
two shafts of light from the top
cinematic backdrop for a saas hero

items.name: spotlight-testimonial
items.title: Spotlight Testimonial
items.blurb: One big customer quote at a time, fading to the next every few seconds.
items.use: A landing page wants one large rotating testimonial with minimal chrome and obvious dot controls.
items.text: A wide pale section with a heading, then a single oversized testimonial under a round quote mark. The quote fades to the next automatically, each with a portrait, name and role, and three dots below switch between them. Off-white page with a centred black heading and a grey two-line intro. Below sits a pale circular quote-mark medallion, three lines of large dark quote text with one phrase in grey italics, a small round portrait, an uppercase name, a grey role and three small dots where the active one stretches into a short dark bar. Every three seconds the current quote and author fade away and the next pair rises in. Clicking a dot jumps straight to that quote and widens the chosen dot while the others stay small. heading, subtitle, quote mark, quote text, avatar, name, role, dot nav
phrases: single quote carousel for landing page
customer praise with photo and role
quotes that fade every few seconds
social proof one quote at a time

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight Background
items.blurb: A cone of white light drifts down over a dark grid and settles on the headline.
items.use: A dark page needs to hint at a focal line of copy without adding a heavy or looping animation.
items.text: A near-black backdrop with a faint square grid and one soft diagonal beam of light that fades in and widens over the text below it. It is there to pull the eye to a single block of copy. A near-black stage crossed by a faint square grid. A wide, soft white cone of light enters from the top-left and falls diagonally across the middle, brightest and broadest over the centred white headline and the small grey paragraph under it. On load an oversized blurred ellipse fades in and slides down-left for about two seconds, growing into the beam, then holds still. It does not follow the pointer; the sweep happens once. grid lines, light beam, headline, paragraph
phrases: beam of light behind a headline
radial glow that draws the eye
subtle light sweep across a banner
animated backdrop for landing page text
stage light effect for website header

items.name: spring-calendar
items.title: Spring Calendar
items.blurb: Day name blurs and re-forms as you switch between upcoming dates.
items.use: A dashboard, booking app or sidebar that shows a short agenda and lets people jump between upcoming days.
items.text: A small dark card listing upcoming events for one day. Five dated buttons sit at the bottom; tapping one morphs the big weekday label with a blur, swaps in that day's events and springs the card to a new height. A tall rounded dark card on a black stage. A large bold weekday name sits top left, then a line reading Upcoming Events with a tiny calendar glyph, and one or two bordered event tiles beneath. A row of five small bordered buttons, each with month, date and weekday, runs along the bottom. Clicking a dated button makes the big weekday label blur and morph into the new day while its event tiles fade and slide in. The card's height springs to fit the number of events and the chosen button stays subtly tinted. weekday heading, events label, event tiles, day buttons, calendar icon

items.name: spring-element
items.title: Spring
items.blurb: Tag you can drag away on a coiled spring that snaps it home.
items.use: A playful page wants one draggable token that visibly remembers where it belongs.
items.text: A small round label that can be dragged anywhere; a drawn coil stretches between it and its resting spot, and letting go lets the spring pull it back with a wobble. A pale circular chip reading "Drag" sits on a black stage. Pulled away, it trails a thin grey wire of even loops back to an otherwise empty anchor point, the coil lengthening as the gap grows. Dragging moves the chip with the pointer and redraws the coil every frame, thinning it as it stretches. Releasing sends the chip back to its anchor on a spring that overshoots once before settling, and with reduced motion it jumps straight home. drag chip, label text, spring coil, anchor point
phrases: circle that snaps back when released
elastic drag with a coiled wire
thing tied by a spring to its spot
pull it away and let it bounce back

items.name: squiggle-arrow
items.title: Squiggle Arrow
items.blurb: A wobbly hand-drawn arrow points the way to a button.
items.use: You want a hand-drawn arrow to nudge attention from a note toward a button or field.
items.text: A thin hand-drawn squiggle ending in a small arrowhead, meant to point at a nearby button or field. Three waveform styles and four directions, sized by width and height. Thin white hand-drawn lines on black: a wavy arrow points right toward a cream Get started pill, with a tilted monospace "try it here" note before it. Below sit three more arrows, a bouncing right arrow, a smooth left arrow and a wavy downward arrow, each with a tiny grey caption. Static: nothing moves or responds. The arrows are fixed drawings; width, height, direction and variant pick their size and shape. squiggly line, arrowhead
phrases: hand drawn arrow pointing at a button
sketchy arrow for a landing page

items.name: squiggly-text
items.title: Squiggly Text
items.blurb: One word in a sentence jitters like a hand-drawn wave.
items.use: One playful word inside a headline should draw the eye without setting the whole sentence in motion.
items.text: Wraps any run of text in a live filter that keeps warping it, so a single word quivers and ruffles in place while the rest of the sentence stays crisp. A single line of bold white text on black. One word inside it has slightly ragged, doubled edges, while the words around it stay perfectly sharp. The wrapped word is continuously displaced by a shifting noise filter that cycles through five shapes many times a second, so it shivers like a wobbly drawing. Nothing responds to input. text line, wobbling word
phrases: word that wobbles in a sentence
make part of a sentence animate

items.name: squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.blurb: Toggle thumbs stretch with speed and squash against the end of the track.
items.use: A settings or preferences list wants a switch that feels tactile and can also be dragged, not just clicked.
items.text: A row of preference switches in a dark card. Each pill flips on click or drag, and its round thumb stretches along the track as it moves, then squashes back when it lands. A rounded dark card holds three stacked rows, each with a title, a smaller grey hint and a wide pill switch on the right. Off switches are dark grey with a pale round thumb at the left; on switches turn near-white with a dark thumb at the right. Clicking or dragging the switch flips it and the thumb springs to the other end. Faster flicks stretch the thumb along the direction of travel, it squashes on landing, and hovering swells it slightly while dragging lets it follow the finger. settings card, row title, row hint, switch track, switch thumb
phrases: toggle switch that stretches when flicked
on off control for settings page

items.name: stack-panel
items.title: Stack Panel
items.blurb: Tap a settings row: its page slides in and the label flies up into the title.
items.use: An app needs several levels of preferences without leaving the panel or routing to new pages.
items.text: A phone-style settings panel that drills down through levels. Choosing a row pushes its page in from the right as the row's label becomes the header, and a swipe, Back or Escape pops it again. A rounded dark panel with a centred header title, and a back label when a page is nested. Rows sit in grouped rounded lists with a label on the left and a grey value, chevron, check or pill toggle on the right, separated by captions and small footnote lines. Tapping a row slides its page in from the right while the tapped label grows from the row up into the header, and the page underneath shifts a third as far. Swiping the page right, pressing Back or hitting Escape pops it and returns focus to the row that opened it, with the panel's height springing to each page. panel header, back label, title, settings row, value text, toggle switch, chevron, footnote
phrases: phone settings panel that drills in
tap a row to slide in a subpage
swipe right to go back a page
settings menu with toggles and checks

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack Trace
items.blurb: Red error bar unfolds into dimmed monospace call frames.
items.use: A developer tool or assistant answer needs to show a real runtime error without dumping raw text.
items.text: A compact error panel showing the error type and message with copy and expand controls. Opening it lists each call frame and greys out library and runtime internals. A wide dark rounded panel. Its header pairs a small warning triangle, a red error type, a white message and two icon buttons; expanded, a bordered body underneath lists monospace frames line by line. Clicking the header or the chevron unfolds the frame list with a fade and flips the chevron. The copy button writes the raw trace to the clipboard and briefly shows a tick, while frames from node_modules and node internals sit dimmed. panel, warning icon, error type, error message, copy button, chevron, stack frames
phrases: show a javascript error call list
exception details with a copy button
hide library frames in a stack
console crash report with file paths
runtime error banner with line numbers

items.name: stacking-card
items.title: Stacking Card
items.blurb: Colour-block cards pin near the top and shrink as the next one covers them.
items.use: A creative portfolio wants each project to get its own full screen without separate pages.
items.text: A photographer's project list where each large coloured card sticks near the top of the screen and the next slides up over it. Each card pairs a short bio and See more link with a big image panel. Wide rounded cards in periwinkle, lavender and deep indigo on a near-black page, each with a centred white name, a small bio and underlined See more on the left, and a large blue-and-white mosaic panel on the right. A dark hero with a faint grid opens the page. Scrolling holds each card near the top while the following card rises from below to cover it, so the stack builds downward. The covered card shrinks slightly and its inner panel zooms back out before the group scrolls away. hero heading, project card, name, bio text, see more link, artwork panel
phrases: cards stack on top of each other while scrolling
full screen cards that pile up
scroll through a stack of project cards
cards pin and shrink as the next covers them

items.name: stateful-button
items.title: Stateful Button
items.blurb: A green pill that swaps in a spinner, then a tick, after a click.
items.use: A form submit or save action needs to show progress and confirm success in the same spot.
items.text: A rounded green submit button that spins up a loader while its click handler runs, then flashes a circled tick before settling back to its normal label. A wide bright-green pill with bold white 'Submit' centred on near-black. On hover a second green ring appears around it; while busy a white spinner sits just before the words. Clicking grows a small spinning arc beside the label, holds the button in place during the async work, then swaps the arc for a circled tick for two seconds before returning to the plain state. pill button, label, hover ring, spinner, check icon
phrases: submit button with a loading spinner
button that shows a tick when done
save button that spins then confirms

items.name: stats-banner
items.title: Stats Banner
items.blurb: One huge number on a hot gradient banner, over three counting stat cards.
items.use: A landing page needs a short proof-of-scale band with one headline number and three supporting metrics.
items.text: A dark metrics band with a heading and one wide banner showing a large total on an orange-pink gradient. Beneath it, three bordered cards count up smaller figures when the section comes into view. Near-black page with a centred white heading, a small grey subtitle, then a wide rounded banner filled with a vivid orange, pink and red gradient holding an oversized white "500K+". Below it sit three dark rounded cards with thin borders, each with a big white figure and a small grey caption. Scrolling the section into view slides the blocks up and runs each number from zero to its target with an eased count. Hovering a lower card lifts it slightly, lights its border and deepens its shadow. heading, subtitle, hero banner, stat card, stat number, stat label
phrases: numbers that count up on the page
big number on a gradient background
large total with smaller metrics below

items.name: stats-bento
items.title: Stats Bento Grid
items.blurb: Bento of dark metric tiles led by a giant market share number.
items.use: A startup wants a compact, pitch-deck style metrics block mixing one headline figure with three proof points.
items.text: A compact stats grid on black: one tall card holds a huge percentage, a growth card carries a small rising bar chart, and two smaller tiles show awards and a peer review score. Figures count up on first view. A black page holding four charcoal rounded cards in a bento layout. The tall left card has diagonal hatch lines in one corner, a small uppercase pill, a very large white "64%" and a short grey caption; the right side stacks a wide growth tile, a narrow awards tile and a review tile with a gold star. When the grid enters view the cards rise in staggered order, each number counts up from zero and the mini chart bars grow upward from the baseline. items.name: stats-bold
items.title: Bold Stats Display

items.name: stats-details

Each starts with a small outlined square icon, a tiny uppercase grey label, a large pale figure and two lines of small grey text. A hovered card is flooded with a pink-to-red abstract photo and an orange icon tile. items.name: stats-section

A near-black section fading into deep purple at the bottom corners. Left: a thin outlined uppercase pill, a huge heading whose second line is grey, then large figures for 2023, 100%, $2.5M and 50+ with tiny spaced labels. Right: two grey paragraphs divided by a short thin line. The four facts slide in from the left one after another when the section enters view. figures on the left copy on the right

items.name: status-island
items.title: Status Island
items.blurb: Dark pill tracks running jobs and opens into their full progress list.
items.use: Long uploads, exports or syncs should stay visible and inspectable without blocking the page.
items.text: A floating pill appears when a background task starts, showing its spinner and percentage. Hovering, focusing or clicking it expands into a list of every task, where finished ones get a green tick and an action button. A dark rounded pill sits low on the stage, holding a small ring icon, a job label with a dim detail and a percentage or action chip. Expanded, it becomes a taller rounded panel with one row per task, each with its icon, label and percentage or small button; thin stacked layers peek behind the closed pill. The pill fades and blurs in when a task starts and swaps its text as the newest task changes. Hover, focus or click opens the list with a spring; leaving or pressing Escape closes it. Rows swap the ring for a green tick when done, and finished tasks leave on their own. pill, progress ring, job label, detail text, percentage, expanded list, task row, action button

items.name: status-mark

A dark rounded card headed AGENT RUN stacks five task rows. Each row starts with a small circular glyph and grey text; completed rows show a solid green circle with a tick and lighter text. items.name: stay-picker
items.title: Stay Picker
items.blurb: Pick check-in and check-out on a price-per-night calendar.
items.use: A booking flow needs guests to pick a stay while seeing nightly prices and unavailable nights.
items.text: A booking calendar for choosing a stay. Each night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and the chosen range becomes one pill with a running total and a Reserve button. A dark rounded calendar card. A month heading with two chevrons sits above a Mo-Su grid where each day number carries a tiny nightly price, and sold-out days are hatched and struck through. Below the grid a status line sits over a Total figure and a Reserve pill. Clicking a night starts a stay and a second click ends it, with the range drawn as one pill that wraps across week rows. Hovering previews the end night, sold-out nights are refused, and Reserve turns green once booked. month heading, month arrows, weekday row, day cell, nightly price, stay pill, status line, reserve button

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper

items.use: A short linear flow needs its position and finished steps visible at a glance.
items.text: A four-step progress path: each step is a small numbered circle above a bold title and a muted description, with Back and Next buttons underneath. Reaching a step fills the previous circle into a tick. Four evenly spaced steps across a black stage, each a small circle above a bold label and a dim line of text. Completed circles are white with a dark tick, the current one is white with its number, the rest stay grey; two small buttons sit centred beneath. Clicking Next fills the current circle with a tick and lights the next step, Back reverses it, and clicking a circle jumps straight to that step. Both buttons dim when they reach either end. step circle, step number, check mark, step title, step description, back button, next button

items.name: sticky-banner

Three equal columns of square building photos separated by thin dark gaps, with a white sculpture, an orange block and a glass tower in the middle column. items.text: A showcase grid of tall black cards, each holding one button in a different style: solid white, outline, filled blue, outlined blue, purple gradient or grey. Hovering a card reveals a small copy icon. A two-by-three grid of tall black rounded cards on a dark stage, each holding one horizontal pill or softly rounded button in white, blue, purple gradient or grey. A faint dot texture fills every card, and a tiny clipboard icon sits in the top-right corner on hover. Hovering a card reveals a small clipboard icon in its corner. Hovering each button darkens, lightens or fills it depending on its style; nothing else moves. card, button label, copy icon, dot background

items.name: team-classic
items.title: Team Classic Grid
items.blurb: Four portrait cards on pink, each with a coloured ring on hover.
items.use: A small startup team page wants a soft, friendly roster with social links.
items.text: A pink team page with a script-like heading and four member cards: square photos, names, green role labels and three small social icons each. A pale pink page with a centred heading and two lines of tiny grey copy. Four cards show a rounded square portrait with a soft shadow, a bold name, a small green uppercase role and three grey social icons in a row. Hovering a card adds a coloured ring around the photo and pops a small emoji badge into the top corner. The social icons darken on hover. heading, paragraph, photo frame, name, role label, social icons, emoji badge
phrases: team page on a pink background
four member cards with photos and socials
colour ring around portrait on hover
script heading for meet the team
small social icons under each name
soft pink team section for a startup

items.name: team-clippath
items.title: Team Clip Path
items.blurb: Arched team portraits that widen on hover to name the person.
items.use: An about or careers page needs a team row where each portrait gives up role and personality tags on hover.
items.text: A team row of four tall photo cards on a light page. Hovering one widens it and slides in the teammate's name, role and a row of small tags while the others shrink and blur. A light grey page with a centred dark heading and a thin subtitle, above four equal photo cards with rounded, arched tops. Each card is a cut-out portrait over a coloured studio backdrop; the open card becomes a wide rectangle with a dark gradient at the bottom. Hovering a card grows it to roughly three times its width, squeezes the others into narrow slots and blurs them. Name, job title and tag pills fade up in sequence inside the open card, then everything returns to four equal cards when the pointer leaves. heading, subtitle, portrait card, name, role line, tag pill
phrases: team members with expanding photo cards
photo cards that grow on hover

items.name: team-expert
items.title: Team Expert Grid
items.blurb: Four expert portrait cards that turn burnt orange on hover.
items.use: A team or expert lineup needs small profile cards plus a row of related activities.
items.text: A light team showcase: a four-across row of portrait cards with names and roles that fill with orange on hover, and four activity cards beneath. A warm off-white section under a centred heading and grey paragraph. Four portrait cards in pale peach hold a square photo, a bold name, a small role line and a READ MORE link; below sit four white cards with round orange icon tiles. Hovering a portrait card floods it solid orange, turns its text white and nudges the READ MORE arrow sideways. The activity icons swell slightly on hover too. heading, paragraph, portrait card, photo, name, role, read more link, activity card
phrases: team section with four portrait cards
cards that turn orange on hover
expert profiles with read more links
people cards with photos and roles
team page with activity buttons below

items.name: team-synth
items.title: Team Synth Grid
items.blurb: Grey team portraits on a purple grid that light up in colour under the pointer.
items.use: A game studio, esports team or creative brand wants a moody synthwave about page with portrait cards.
items.text: A near-black team section with a glowing purple floor, a huge gradient title and three photo cards. Hovering a card lifts it, brings the portrait into colour and lights cyan details. A black page crossed by a faint square grid at the top and a violet glow rising from the bottom. A wide italic uppercase heading in cyan-to-blue gradient sits over a short grey rule, above three square portraits in dark violet frames with cyan names, tiny pink roles and five thin bars. On first view the title and cards rise in one after another. Hovering a card tilts and lifts it, swaps the greyscale photo for full colour, draws cyan corner brackets and fills the five segment bars, then all of it fades back when the pointer leaves. heading, rule, member card, portrait, name, role, segment bar
phrases: dark team section with neon glow
team members that lift on hover

items.name: team-vr
items.title: Team VR Section
items.blurb: Team portraits that turn into a warm quote panel when hovered.
items.use: A startup or product team page wants portraits that flip into a short mission quote under the pointer.
items.text: A tall dark team section ending in a magenta and orange glow. Three square portraits sit under a bold heading, and hovering one floods it with a hot gradient, a quote mark and a line of white text. Black background with a faint square grid and a strong magenta-to-orange wash along the bottom. A tiny uppercase label and a large white heading sit above three rounded square portraits shown in greyscale, each followed by a white name and a small grey role. Cards fade up one at a time when the section scrolls into view. Hovering a portrait pushes a pink-to-orange gradient panel over it with a large quote mark, zooms and colours the photo beneath, and turns the name into a gradient; leaving reverses it. kicker label, heading, portrait card, quote overlay, name, role
phrases: team cards that reveal a quote on hover
dark team page with pink glow

items.name: tear-ticket
items.title: Tear Ticket
items.blurb: Event ticket tilts in 3D; grab the perforated stub and tear it free.
items.use: A ticket, voucher or pass benefits from a tactile reveal that marks it used, not just a checkbox.
items.text: A boarding-pass style ticket with a photo header, trip details and a perforated stub. Moving the mouse tips it in perspective; dragging the stub pulls thin fibres until it rips away and tumbles off. A wide rounded ticket in dark grey, a mountain photo across the top under the route line, three labelled details beneath and a dotted perforation separating a narrow stub that shows the seat. The card leans toward the pointer in a soft 3D tilt, with the photo and text shifting at slightly different depths. Dragging the stub pulls thin fibres across the perforation until they snap and the stub falls away. ticket body, photo header, route title, detail columns, perforation, seat stub
phrases: event ticket with tear off stub

items.name: tech-text
items.title: Tech Text
items.blurb: Plain white wordmark turns the letter under the cursor into a dashed blueprint.
items.use: A technical or creative studio headline can trade a plain title for a letter that reveals its construction on hover.
items.text: A large single-word headline where the letter beneath the pointer switches from solid white to a dashed technical outline ringed by measuring lines and small size labels. Clicking or dragging a letter nudges it. A large white sans-serif word sits alone on a dark stage. The letter the pointer touches becomes a hollow dashed outline, boxed by thin guide lines with small pixel measurements above it. On hover the touched letter crossfades from solid to dashed vector strokes, gaining construction guides and a size label, and returns when the pointer leaves. A letter can be dragged aside and springs back. wordmark, dashed letter outline, guide lines, size label
phrases: word with measurement guides on hover

items.name: terminal-animation
items.title: Terminal Animation
items.blurb: A browser-window terminal types commands and streams coloured output.
items.use: A landing page or portfolio wants to show a product or developer workflow inside a familiar terminal.
items.text: A fake terminal window with traffic-light dots and tabs for commands like new, dev, test and build. It retypes the command for the chosen tab, then prints its coloured output line by line behind a blinking cursor. A dark rounded terminal window with three coloured dots and a row of six text tabs at the top, filled with a large monospaced command line and output lines. It floats on a violet-to-indigo gradient backdrop that darkens toward the edges. Picking a tab retypes that tab's command character by character, then reveals its output lines one after another with timed pauses; the cursor blinks while typing and disappears once output finishes. The whole window also slides up into place when it first scrolls into view. window frame, traffic-light dots, tab bar, command line, output lines, blinking cursor, gradient backdrop
phrases: animated console output for landing page
macos terminal window with traffic light dots

items.name: terminal-ui
items.title: Terminal UI
items.blurb: Mac-style terminal types onboarding lines under glowing purple bars.
items.use: A developer onboarding or wait screen wants a terminal aesthetic while the product pretends to get ready.
items.text: A scripted CLI onboarding inside a fake terminal window. Shimmering purple bars spell out scanning and profiling steps with percentages, then status lines type themselves out and further bars and rules follow. A dark violet terminal inside window chrome with three traffic-light dots and a zsh path label. Rows of monospace characters glow purple as filled progress bars, each with a small star icon and token count, and dashed rules divide sections. A bar crawls to full while its label and percentage change and a highlight sweeps across the letters, the icon pulsing in step. Status lines then type out character by character behind a blinking caret, and the next divider and bar begin before the sequence stops. window chrome, traffic lights, path title, progress bar, label text, percent, typed line, divider
phrases: mac terminal window with typed text

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test Results
items.blurb: Test report where suites fold open to pass, fail and error rows.
items.use: A dev tool or assistant answer needs to report a test run with per-suite detail and failure messages.
items.text: A test run report card that sums the run in pass, fail and skip badges over a green progress bar. Suites expand to list each test, its duration and status, with a red error block for failures. A bordered card headed by three coloured count badges and a duration on the right, over a green progress bar with a small red tail. Below, suites sit in bordered boxes; an open failed one shows test rows, tiny durations and a red error panel with monospace lines. Clicking a suite header folds its tests open or shut and rotates a small chevron. Status icons colour each row, pulsing for a running test, while the badges and progress bar stay put at the top. header badges, duration, progress bar, suite row, chevron, test row, status icon, error panel
phrases: pass fail summary with green bar
ci results with an error stack
green and red progress bar for tests
qa report panel for a deployment

items.name: testimonial-basic
items.title: Testimonial Basic
items.blurb: Big video stills beside long five-star customer quotes.
items.use: A coaching, course or SaaS page wants rich proof rows that pair a video still with a long quote and a rating.
items.text: A white editorial page stacked with review rows. Each row pairs a wide video thumbnail with a play badge and timecode next to a rounded avatar, bold name, monospaced role, an oversized quotation and five gold stars. White page framed by thin grey rules, with a small spaced "« TESTIMONIALS »" label and a very large black uppercase title. Rows pair a landscape video still with a white play button and timecode against a rounded avatar, heavy name, mono role, large quote and five gold stars. The rows stack down the page and scroll normally. Hovering a video still nudges the photo slightly larger and grows the play badge; nothing else moves and no video plays. label, heading, video thumbnail, play button, avatar, name, quote, star rating
phrases: quote and video side by side

items.name: testimonial-slider
items.title: Testimonial Slider
items.blurb: Quotes fade and swap around a round photo, with arrows on either side.
items.use: A landing or pricing page that needs one strong customer quote at a time without a wall of cards.
items.text: A single large testimonial on a dark panel: a circular avatar under a soft halo, a bold quote and a name with role. It rotates to the next quote on a timer, or by the round arrow buttons. One testimonial fills a wide dark slate panel. At the top a small round portrait sits inside a faint radial halo, then a bold white quote over two or three lines, and under it a name and job title in italic. Round arrow buttons sit at the left and right edges. Every few seconds the current quote and portrait fade out and the next slides in on a light rotate, with a brief crossfade between the two. Clicking the round arrows jumps forward or back, pauses the timer and later resumes it. avatar, halo, quote, name and role, arrow buttons
phrases: single quote with next and previous arrows
social proof block for a landing page
reviews that change on a timer

items.name: tetris
items.title: Tetris Background
items.blurb: A quiet grid where single blocks drift down and stack up.
items.use: A developer or gaming site that wants a quietly moving grid backdrop behind a headline, no gameplay.
items.text: A dark grid of thin-bordered cells covering the background. One indigo square drops a row at a time, one column at a time, and clicking a filled cell deletes it; full bottom rows clear. A full-bleed grid of square cells drawn with thin slate-blue borders on a near-black base, evenly spaced across the whole stage. A few cells are filled with a translucent indigo square, and here and there these line up into short vertical columns. Faint white text sits centre. Once a second a new block appears at a random column in the top row and every block falls one cell downward, so columns build and eventually reach the bottom. A completely filled bottom row empties, and clicking a filled cell clears it. grid cells, cell borders, filled blocks, caption
phrases: pixel grid animation for a hero

items.name: text-3d-flip
items.title: Text 3D Flip
items.blurb: Letters pivot in 3D one after another when the pointer arrives.
items.use: A short bold headline should answer the pointer with something more tactile than a colour shift.
items.text: A headline whose letters spring through a 3D flip in a stagger, starting from the first, last, centre or a random glyph, around the axis you choose. Two left-aligned lines on black: a bold white headline and a smaller grey subheading. Each glyph has its own slot, and while animating some turn edge-on and show a mirrored back face before snapping upright. Moving the pointer into the text sets every letter flipping around the chosen axis in a cascade, each springing back to face forward over a few tenths of a second. The sequence runs once per entry and never overlaps itself. headline letters, subheading letters, letter slots
phrases: letters flip around in 3d on hover
text that flips over on mouse over

items.name: text-3d
items.title: Text 3D
items.blurb: White letters with black and yellow offset layers that tilt and wobble.
items.use: A playful hero or event headline that should feel like a printed poster sticker rather than clean type.
items.text: The words Hello 3D are set in heavy white type with a thick black outline and two offset copies behind, one black and one yellow. The whole word gently rocks back and forth. Large heavy white letters read Hello 3D against black. Each letter is wrapped in a thick black stroke, and two offset copies sit behind it down and to the right, the first black and the second bright yellow, so the word looks extruded in layers. The whole block is slightly rotated. The entire word rocks around its centre on a looping animation, tipping about five degrees left and right and settling level between swings. No pointer input is involved. letters, black outline, black offset, yellow offset
phrases: comic style title with drop shadow
letters that rock side to side
layered text effect with yellow shadow

items.name: text-along-path
items.title: Text Along Path
items.blurb: Blue monospace words march around a rounded rectangle like a ticker.
items.use: A launch or waitlist page wants its call to action framed by moving text that pulls the eye.
items.text: A line of repeated text travels endlessly along a rounded rectangle outline, wrapping from one side to the next. It can loop on a timer or follow the reader's scroll, with room in the middle for a form. Lowercase blue monospace words repeat in a continuous loop around a large rounded rectangle on black, running upside down and right to left along the bottom edge. In the middle sit a thin outlined email field and a solid blue Subscribe button. The words slide clockwise around the track without a visible seam, since a second copy chases the first. Typing an address and submitting swaps the button label for a spinner, then a Done tick, and later returns to its resting state. text loop, rounded path, email field, subscribe button, loading spinner
phrases: words that travel along a border
svg text along a path animation
text going round a rounded box

items.name: text-animate
items.title: Text Animate
items.blurb: A heading and a caption settle in with a soft staggered fade.
items.use: A heading or tagline should enter with a soft staggered fade as it scrolls into view.
items.text: A bold heading over a smaller grey caption, both built to fade, slide and blur into place word by word or character by character when scrolled into view. Two centred lines on black: a thick white heading reading Animate your text beautifully, and below it a smaller grey sentence. There is generous space above and below the pair. The words rise and sharpen from a blur in a staggered sequence, while the caption below fades one character at a time. The clip itself only catches the finished state. heading text, caption text, dark background
phrases: text that fades and blurs in

items.name: text-cursor-proximity
items.title: Text Cursor Proximity
items.blurb: Bold blue poster whose letters blur wherever the cursor passes.
items.use: A bold display headline should respond as the pointer sweeps across it, giving the type a tactile feel.
items.text: Display text that restyles letter by letter according to how near the pointer is. In the demo the closest letters turn soft and blurred while the rest of the words stay crisp. A tall electric blue panel on black, with white bold "DIGITAL WORKSHOP" at the top left and five lines of small contact details across the bottom. Letters near the pointer look smeared while the others remain sharp. As the pointer moves each letter measures its distance to it and is restyled every frame, so a soft blur travels across the words and fades with distance. Any CSS property pair can drive it, using linear, exponential or gaussian falloff. poster card, headline text, blurred letters, detail lines
phrases: text that reacts to cursor distance
interactive type for a poster page
blur follows the pointer across text
headline that responds to how close you are
fancy hover text for a landing page

items.name: text-flipping-board
items.title: Split Flap Board
items.blurb: Letter tiles scramble and flip into place like an airport departure board.
items.use: A hero or event page wants a nostalgic mechanical board that cycles through messages.
items.text: Recreates a mechanical split-flap display as a grid of tiles. Each character flips through random letters before landing on its target, with a few tiles filled in solid colour as accents. A dark rounded panel holds a grid of small square tiles, most near-black with a faint horizontal split line. A few tiles glow solid red, orange, yellow, green, blue or violet, and pale monospace characters sit on the others. Each character tile cycles through random letters, then flips over to its target with delays spreading across rows and columns. The message settles among coloured accent tiles and holds until the text changes again. board panel, letter tiles, colour tiles, split lines
phrases: letters flip like a departure board
tiles that rotate to show letters

items.name: text-generate-effect
items.title: Text Generate Effect
items.blurb: A bold sentence sharpens into focus one word at a time.
items.use: A short statement should draw the eye as it assembles the first time it is seen.
items.text: Takes a sentence and splits it into words that fade in from a blur one after another, so the line assembles itself on load. It plays once and settles as plain bold text. A single bold white sentence across a black stage, set in two centred lines. In early frames the tail of the sentence is soft and blurred while the opening words are already crisp. On mount the words reveal left to right, each one lifting from blurred and transparent to sharp white with a short stagger, until the whole line is legible. It runs once and never repeats. sentence, word, line break
phrases: text that fades in from blur

items.name: text-glitch
items.title: Text Glitch
items.blurb: Headlines jitter into red and cyan slices like a broken screen.
items.use: A gaming, tech or event hero that wants a tense, broken-signal headline instead of smooth type.
items.text: Bold white words with two offset copies behind, tinted red and cyan, chopped into shifting horizontal bands. One version glitches constantly; the other only when hovered. Two lines of heavy white uppercase type on near-black. The top word, GLITCH, is sliced into offset horizontal bands with red and cyan copies peeking out at the edges, while the larger HOVER ME below reads clean and solid. Everything is tightly tracked and weighted. The two offset copies of the text are clipped to changing horizontal strips and leap left and right, so the word appears to tear and flicker. On the hover version the effect stays off until the pointer enters, then it runs until it leaves. main text, red copy, cyan copy, clipped bands

items.name: text-hover-effect
items.title: Text Hover Effect
items.blurb: Giant outlined letters light up in blue around your cursor.
items.use: A single short word such as a logo or name is the hero and you want a small reason to move the mouse.
items.text: An oversized single word drawn as a thin grey outline on black. Moving the pointer over it wipes in a patch of blue and teal along the letter strokes, like a torch on the text. One large word fills the width in a heavy sans, rendered only as a thin grey outline with hollow letters on near-black. A soft blue-to-teal band lights the part of the outlines nearest the pointer. The outline traces itself once after load; after that a coloured glow trails the pointer across the letters, strongest at the cursor and fading with distance, and vanishes when the pointer leaves. outlined word, letter strokes, cursor glow, colour band
phrases: outline text that glows on hover
hollow letters with a colour sweep
animated logo text for a landing page

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.blurb: Two crossing purple ribbons carry looping white text along a wave.
items.use: A hero or divider needs a wide moving band of repeated words to add energy without images.
items.text: Uppercase words and star separators run endlessly along a thick wavy ribbon, with a second pale ribbon crossing it at an angle. The text loops without a seam and slows when hovered. A wide dark band with a vivid blue-violet ribbon and a pale lavender ribbon crossing in opposite diagonals, both following a wave. Bold uppercase white letters with star separators ride the ribbons. The words slide along both ribbons in opposite directions, wrapping with no visible seam. Hovering eases the movement to a stop, and with dragging enabled the strip can be pulled and flung. wave ribbon, crossing ribbon, looping text, star separators

items.name: text-reveal-card
items.title: Text Reveal Card
items.blurb: Sweep the cursor across the card to wipe one sentence over another.
items.use: You want a small surprising reward for moving the cursor over a card of copy.
items.text: A dark card shows a faint sentence that a second, brighter message replaces wherever your pointer has crossed. A thin divider bar rides the cursor edge, and the reveal snaps back when you leave. A wide dark grey card with a thin border holds a small white heading and a grey hint line at the top. Across its lower half a large bold sentence sits dim grey among drifting white specks; up to the pointer the same line appears bright white behind a narrow vertical bar. Sliding the pointer across the card uncovers a bright copy of the sentence from the left, tracking the cursor with no lag, while a thin divider bar tilts and follows. Leaving the card retracts the reveal to nothing and fades the bar out. card, heading, hint line, dim sentence, revealed sentence, divider bar, star specks
phrases: card that wipes away to show a message
before and after sentence comparison card
scrub across to reveal another line

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.blurb: Words in a paragraph light up one by one as you scroll.
items.use: A short statement or intro paragraph should reveal itself gradually as the reader scrolls.
items.text: A bold multi-line sentence that starts as faint grey text and brightens word by word as the reader scrolls through a tall section, leaving a trail of highlighted words. A left-aligned block of bold sans-serif text on black, wrapped over four lines. At any moment some words are solid white while the rest sit at a low grey, so the paragraph looks partly illuminated. Scrolling through the taller section advances a progress value that maps each word from faint to full white in reading order. The text is held in a sticky panel while the scroll continues underneath. revealed word, dimmed word, text block
phrases: text that fades in as you scroll
words brighten as you go down

items.name: text-roll-navigation
items.title: Text Roll Navigation
items.blurb: Six stacked all-caps links roll their letters upward on hover.
items.use: A portfolio or studio site wants a bold text-first menu where the hover motion is the personality.
items.text: A vertical menu of oversized uppercase words stacked tightly. Hovering a word splits it into letters that roll up and away while a fresh copy rises into place, starting from the centre out. Six huge white uppercase words in a narrow centred column on black, tightly leaded so the lines almost touch. There are no borders, icons or dividers, only the words. Hovering a word sends each letter upward out of view while a duplicate rises from below with a small stagger from the middle outward. Leaving lets the word settle back. menu list, uppercase word, rising letter copy

items.name: textoverlay-videomasking
items.title: Text Overlay Video Mask
items.blurb: A looping video plays only inside big italic letters on black.
items.use: A hero or section title should carry motion and atmosphere without a full video block behind it.
items.text: One line of oversized bold italic text works as a cut-out window, so a nature clip moves inside the letterforms while everything around them stays near-black. A wide near-black panel holds a single line of large, heavy italic lettering with an underline stroke. The strokes are not a solid colour: they are filled with blue and green foliage footage, so the word shimmers while the surrounding panel is flat black. The clip inside the letters plays on a loop from the moment the panel loads, brightening and shifting as the camera moves over greenery. Nothing reacts to the pointer; the panel itself never changes shape or size. black panel, masked lettering, underline stroke
phrases: video playing through cut out letters
big text filled with moving footage
landing page title with video fill
letters as windows onto a film

items.name: texture-card
items.title: Texture Card
items.blurb: Dark card edged with stacked border rings and a faint surface texture.
items.use: You want a card edge with depth and no heavy shadow, and need header, body and footer slots.
items.text: A content card built from several inset border rings that give it a soft stacked edge instead of a heavy shadow, with header, body and footer slots. A wide dark card with a rounded edge made of several thin nested rings. White title and grey copy sit in three bands split by hairlines, with a small footer label and link. Static: nothing moves or responds. card shell, border rings, title, description, body copy, separator lines, footer label, footer link
phrases: content card with soft inset edges
dark card for a description and link
tactile card without a drop shadow
simple info card with header and footer
card that works in light and dark mode
panel with a subtle framed edge

items.name: thought-line
items.title: Thought Line
items.blurb: Sparkle, live timer and a tick list of an agent's reasoning steps.
items.use: An AI chat needs to show progress and intermediate reasoning without pushing the answer down the page.
items.text: A small inline status line for an AI assistant's reasoning: a sparkle, a shimmering label, a running timer and an expandable list of steps. When the work ends it folds into one line reading "Thought for 3.9s". A thin line of small white text on black: sparkle icon, "Thinking…", a seconds counter and a chevron, with a left-indented list of grey steps beneath, each marked by a tick or a small pulsing dot. The timer climbs every tenth of a second while the label shimmers and steps drop in one by one. Finished steps become ticks, and when work ends the header swaps to "Thought for" and the list collapses. sparkle icon, status label, elapsed timer, chevron, step list, tick markers
phrases: show what the model is doing

items.name: three-d-carousel
items.title: 3D Carousel
items.blurb: A drum of photos spins sideways in draggable 3D perspective.
items.use: You want an explorable photo gallery that feels physical and can open a single shot on click.
items.text: A rotating cylinder of square photos that you drag sideways to spin; clicking a photo stops the carousel and opens that image large in an overlay. On a near-black stage, a row of square photos stands around an invisible cylinder, tilted by perspective at both edges. Each photo sits on a dark rounded tile with a small gap between tiles. Dragging sideways spins the drum and a spring carries it after release; clicking a photo pauses it and grows the image in an overlay, and clicking the overlay closes it. photo tiles, cylinder row, dark backdrop, photo overlay
phrases: photos arranged in a spinning ring
three dimensional photo reel for a website
click a photo to enlarge it
interactive photo wall you can spin

items.name: thumbnail-slider
items.title: Thumbnail Slider
items.blurb: A large photo above a dimmed strip of thumbnails, one lit.
items.use: A gallery has several photos and users want to jump to one quickly.
items.text: A photo viewer with one large rounded frame on top and a row of small previews beneath. Picking a thumbnail swaps the main picture and lights that thumbnail. A wide rounded photo slide above a row of seven small square thumbnails; the current thumbnail has a light border and the others are dimmed. The loaded main image is a lake scene with rocks and autumn trees. Clicking a thumbnail jumps the large photo to that slide and moves the highlight; the strips stay in sync as they slide. main photo, thumbnail strip, thumbnail, active border, dimmed thumbnail
phrases: click small pictures to change the big one
choose a picture from small previews

items.name: time-machine-stack
items.title: Time Machine Stack
items.blurb: Stack of saved versions, older ones peeking out above the front card.
items.use: A document app should let people flip through version history as a physical-feeling stack.
items.text: A macOS-style stack of document snapshots. The front card shows one version while earlier ones recede above it, and scrolling, dragging or arrow keys walk through history as the leaving card flies past. A dark rounded card with a title and timestamp, four grey placeholder bars and a footer note with a word count. Three narrower panel tops peek above it in a receding line, and Older, date and Newer pills sit below. Scrolling, dragging vertically or pressing arrow keys moves one snapshot at a time: the front card flies outward while the next rises from behind and the visible depth shifts. The buttons step one version and disable at either end. front card, title, timestamp, placeholder bars, footer note, stacked panel edges, older button, newer button
phrases: card stack you flip with the wheel
old revisions peeking behind the current one
drag up to see earlier drafts

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.blurb: Years stack down a vertical line that fills with colour as you scroll.
items.use: A past history such as a changelog, career or roadmap needs dates and media in one readable scroll.
items.text: A changelog or journey laid out as dated entries: a bold year, a paragraph and paired photos, joined by a thin vertical line whose coloured section follows your scroll position. A near-black page opens with a white heading and a short intro, then a column of dated entries. Each entry has a large grey year on the left, a small dot on a thin vertical rule, and text with two rounded photos on the right. Scrolling grows a purple-to-blue segment down the vertical rule in step with how far the list has been read. Year labels stick near the top while their own content scrolls past. heading, intro paragraph, vertical rule, year label, dot marker, entry paragraph, photo pair
phrases: scroll progress line down a list
animated line that fills as you scroll
big year labels next to paragraphs

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.blurb: A small pill counts elapsed time beside start and reset controls.
items.use: You need to show elapsed time next to start, pause and reset controls in a toolbar.
items.text: A dark pill shows a clock icon and a monospaced stopwatch counting in hundredths of a second. Start, Pause and Reset buttons below drive it, and the clock spins while it runs. A compact dark pill with a thin light border holds a small clock glyph and a monospaced time such as 03.46. Under it the demo places three rounded buttons: Start, Pause and Reset. Pressing Start sends the digits counting in hundredths of a second while the clock icon turns. Pause freezes the value and Reset returns it to zero, while the pill itself keeps its shape. pill, clock icon, time readout, start button, pause button, reset button
phrases: count up timer for a page
elapsed time pill with a clock icon
timer to measure how long a task takes
loading timer with a spinning clock

items.name: timezone-planner
items.title: Timezone Planner
items.blurb: Radial day clock with a ring per colleague and a draggable meeting wedge.
items.use: A distributed team needs a call slot that lands inside most people's working day.
items.text: A 24-hour dial where each colleague gets a ring shaded for their working hours. Drag a wedge around the clock to choose a meeting and watch every person's local time and status change. A dark card titled "Find a time" with a Find best time button. On the left, concentric green and grey rings make a day dial with hour marks, a large centre time, a striped meeting wedge and a thin orange now-hand. On the right, rows list cities, offsets and local ranges. Dragging the wedge, or pressing elsewhere on the dial, shifts the meeting in fifteen-minute steps and can stretch it from its edges. Each row rolls to the new local range and flips between Working, Early, Late and Asleep while the footer counts who is inside working hours. best time button, day dial, hour labels, meeting wedge, now hand, centre time, people list, duration stepper
phrases: 24 hour dial with working hours rings
find a time that suits everyone
drag a slice to pick a call time

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.blurb: Two joined strips of icon buttons restyle and realign a paragraph as you pick.
items.use: Formatting or view options where several can apply at once while one alignment stays chosen.
items.text: Two connected rows of icon buttons: bold, italic and underline in one, and left, centre and right alignment in the other. Picking a style or alignment immediately changes the sample text in the card below. A dark card holds one toolbar row of two joined icon-button strips split by a thin divider: bold, italic and underline, then three alignment icons. Chosen buttons sit in a grey fill, and below them a bold heading and a paragraph react to the choices. Clicking a style button adds or removes that mark from the sample heading, while an alignment button moves the whole text block left, centre or right. The frames show italic being turned on and the text swinging from left to centre and then right. toolbar, style strip, alignment strip, icon button, selected button, sample heading, paragraph
phrases: bold italic underline buttons that join
segmented icon buttons for text styling
text align left center right switcher
connected buttons that push one choice
single choice made of icon buttons

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.blurb: Icon buttons that stay lit while pressed, lined up in a formatting bar.
items.use: A small group of independent formatting or view options that a user switches on and off.
items.text: A compact row of icon buttons for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and text alignment. Each button holds a light grey fill while it is on, and clicks flip one without touching the others. A dark rounded card shows a thin toolbar of seven square icon buttons: four text-style icons, a small vertical divider, then three alignment icons. Pressed buttons sit in a light grey fill while the rest are transparent, and a sample paragraph fills the space below. Clicking an icon button flips it between plain and a grey pressed state on its own, so several can be lit at once. The frames show italic, strikethrough and align-centre being switched on in turn while the defaults stay pressed. toolbar, icon button, pressed button, divider, sample heading, sample paragraph
phrases: icons that stay highlighted when clicked
button that stays pressed on second click
rich text toolbar with on off states

items.name: toolbar-expandable
items.title: Toolbar Expandable
items.blurb: Numbered tabs rise open into a small panel of details.
items.use: A dense app header needs several sections as tabs, each with a short panel of details in place.
items.text: A compact horizontal toolbar of numbered tabs with a small badge above it. Choosing a tab grows a card above the bar holding that section's title, description and content; choosing it again or clicking away folds it shut. A small outlined Navigation badge sits above a rounded horizontal toolbar of four tabs. Each tab pairs a little numbered square with a label, and the active tab is tinted. An open tab shows a soft card above the bar with a title, grey description and body text. Clicking a tab opens the card above the bar with that step's copy; clicking the same tab again or anywhere outside closes it. The card animates its height with a short spring, and the tab row scrolls sideways when the tabs overflow. badge, toolbar, tab, step number, active tab, content card, action button
phrases: numbered tabs that open a panel
compact horizontal nav bar with sections
tabs with a card that drops down
expand a tab to see its details

items.name: tooltip-card
items.title: Tooltip Card
items.blurb: Follows the cursor with a dark hint panel that springs open beside it.
items.use: A short hint, definition or preview should appear right at the pointer without shifting the page.
items.text: Attaches a tooltip to any element. Hovering or tapping shows a small dark panel with a title and text near the pointer; it springs open, flips at screen edges and closes on leave. Two small outlined buttons, "Hover me" and "Or hover me", sit on a near-black stage under a line of grey caption text. A hover reveals a dark rounded panel with a bold heading and a few lines of grey text floating next to the cursor, or a single short line in the string variant. Entering a button springs the panel open from zero height close to the pointer, and it follows the cursor while open. Near a viewport edge it jumps to the other side, and it collapses when the pointer leaves or after a touch tap. trigger button, tooltip panel, tooltip heading, tooltip text, caption
phrases: tooltip that flips near screen edge
hover popup with a title and text
tooltip on both mouse and touch

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.blurb: Hovering an icon lifts a small bubble showing its name and shortcut.
items.use: Icon-only controls whose meaning or shortcut is not obvious from the shape alone.
items.text: A four-button formatting bar whose icons reveal a compact bubble with the action name and its keyboard shortcut when hovered or focused. A dark rounded toolbar of four light icon buttons floats on a black stage, with a faint border around the group. Over the hovered button sits a small rounded dark bubble holding a white label and a grey shortcut in the same line. Hovering an icon opens the bubble just above it and the bubble jumps to whichever button the pointer enters. It fades and scales away on leave, and frame one shows the bar with no bubble. toolbar, icon button, tooltip bubble, label, shortcut hint
phrases: bubble that explains an icon on hover

items.name: topo-background
items.title: Topo Background
items.blurb: Faint contour lines drift and gather into rings under the cursor.
items.use: A hero or section needs a quiet, technical backdrop that rewards pointer movement without fighting the copy.
items.text: A full-bleed map of thin topographic contour lines with small elevation numbers, slowly drifting across a dark stage. Moving the pointer raises a hill of tighter rings, and a click sends ripples outward through the terrain. A near-black stage covered edge to edge with thin pale contour lines that loop into hills and hollows at uneven spacing. Tiny elevation numbers ride along some lines, and a centred white headline with a grey subline sits over the middle of the map. The lines drift on their own, slowly. Hovering raises a hill that slides after the pointer while the rings crowd around it, and clicking sends a fading ripple train outward. The top and bottom edges fade into the page. contour lines, elevation labels, headline, subline
phrases: terrain lines that follow the mouse

items.name: topography
items.title: Topography
items.blurb: Endless glowing contour lines ripple across a dark 3D terrain.
items.use: A dark hero or app background needs depth and motion without competing with foreground text.
items.text: A full-screen field of thin blue contour lines laid over rolling procedural hills, seen in perspective as the camera drifts. Moving the pointer lifts and lights the lines near the cursor, and a click sends rings outward. A black stage covered edge to edge with fine blue-white contour rings that bunch over rounded hills and fan across flat valleys. Brightness fades with distance, so far ridges dissolve into the dark. The camera glides forward slowly while the landscape shifts and re-forms, contour lines redrawing as peaks rise. The pointer lifts and brightens nearby lines, and clicking pushes a ring across the ground. contour lines, terrain hills, distance fade, glow

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.blurb: Page dims, one card lights up and a small popover explains it.
items.use: A new user must be shown a few key parts of a screen in order without a separate help page.
items.text: A guided product tour: the page is masked so a single element stays bright while a popover card beside it explains each step, with Previous, Next and a step count. A dimmed dashboard with a welcome heading and three feature cards. One card sits in a bright cut-out while the rest of the page goes near black, and a small dark popover with a title, paragraph, counter and two buttons points at it. Starting the tour lays a mask over the page with a hole around the current target and places a popover beside it, arrow aimed at the element. Next and Previous move the hole and card from step to step, the counter updates, and on the last step the button reads Finish. page mask, spotlight cut-out, popover card, title, description, step counter, next button, close button
phrases: highlight one element and explain it

items.name: tracing-beam
items.title: Tracing Beam
items.blurb: A glowing gradient slides down a thin rail beside a scrolling article.
items.use: A long article or changelog wants a quiet progress cue running alongside the text.
items.text: A long-form reading column of photo posts wrapped by a thin left-hand rule. As the page scrolls, a cyan-to-violet glow and a small dot travel down the rule to mark progress. A narrow dark reading column of stacked posts, each with a small solid badge, a bold white heading, a wide rounded mountain photo and a paragraph of grey text. Down the far left runs a fine vertical rule with a zig-zag kink near the top and a small dot marker. Scrolling sends a short cyan-to-violet gradient sliding down the left rule and drags a dot along with it, both eased through a stiff spring so they lag slightly. The top marker flips from green to white once scrolling begins. tracing rule, scroll marker, post badge, heading, mountain photo, body text
phrases: line that follows you down an article
scroll progress beam beside blog posts
article with a glowing left rail
gradient line that moves with scrolling
vertical scroll indicator on a post

items.name: transaction-list
items.title: Transaction List
items.blurb: Compact payments that unfold one row into a full receipt.
items.use: A finance app wants a compact payment history that opens into full receipt details on demand.
