items.text: A short list of recent payments. Tapping a row morphs the whole card into a receipt for that purchase, carrying its icon, name and amount across before closing back to the list. A dark rounded card headed "Transaction" with four rows, each a small rounded icon, a merchant name over a category and an amount on the right. Expanded it becomes a receipt: icon and close button on top, merchant and amount, then dashed rules over id, date, time and card details. Clicking a row grows the card into the receipt on a spring while the icon, name, category and amount slide to new positions. The close button collapses it back to the list, and the card's height animates to fit whichever view is shown. card, heading, transaction row, merchant icon, merchant name, amount, receipt details, close button
phrases: tap a row to see the receipt
card that morphs into transaction details
shared element expansion from a list row
receipt view with card last digits

items.name: transcription
items.title: Transcription
items.blurb: Read-along transcript where the spoken word is boxed as playback runs.
items.use: A podcast or interview page should let people read along and click any word to replay it.
items.text: A podcast transcript tied to a running clock. The word being spoken is highlighted, words already spoken dim, and clicking any word jumps the playback to that moment. A dark card with a round play button, an episode title and byline, a timecode and a hairline progress bar. Below, a paragraph of small grey words wraps over four lines, with the current word set in a grey box and past words dimmer than upcoming ones. The clock walks a highlight through the words, dimming those already spoken and paling those still ahead. Clicking a word seeks there, and the bar and timecode follow the same clock until the end. play button, episode title, byline, timecode, progress bar, transcript words, active word
phrases: transcript that highlights the spoken word
click a word to jump the audio
words light up as they play

items.name: transfer-funds-card
items.title: Transfer Funds Card
items.blurb: Money transfer sheet with an amount, two account rows and a fee summary.
items.use: A banking app needs one self-contained step for moving money between a person's own accounts.
items.text: A compact transfer form: an amount, From and To account rows with dropdown chevrons, a three-line summary of arrival, fee and total, and one confirm button. Rows and the button respond to hover. A dark rounded card with a title, a close cross and a short description. Three grey pill rows hold the amount and two account numbers with paired chevrons, a bordered summary lists arrival, fee and total, and a white pill button sits at the bottom. Hovering an account row wobbles its chevrons and deepens the row's shade; the close cross turns and the confirm button springs slightly larger, shrinking on press. Otherwise the card is a still form with values already filled in. card, title, close button, amount field, from account row, to account row, summary rows, confirm button
phrases: amount with from and to accounts
send money between my own accounts

items.name: tree-code-viewer
items.title: Tree Code Viewer
items.blurb: File tree on the left, highlighted source on the right, copy up top.
items.use: Documentation should show a component together with the several files it is built from.
items.text: A two-pane source browser: a collapsible file tree beside a syntax-highlighted code pane. Clicking a file swaps the code, folders expand, and a corner button copies the raw text. A bordered two-column frame. The left column lists folders and files with small icons and guide lines, one row shaded for the selection; the right column shows monospace code with coloured keywords and a small copy button in its corner. Clicking a folder row expands or collapses it, while clicking a file row moves the selection and fades in that file's code. The copy button writes the raw source to the clipboard and swaps to a double tick for a moment. file tree, folder rows, file rows, selection highlight, code pane, copy button
phrases: docs code pane with copy button
show a component and its dependencies
click a file to see its source

items.name: tree
items.title: File Tree
items.blurb: Folders open and files highlight inside a narrow project sidebar.
items.use: You need to browse a shallow hierarchy of folders and files with selection and expand.
items.text: A file tree in a small bordered card, with chevrons on folders and file icons on the leaves. Rows highlight on selection, and folders expand in place to reveal their contents. A compact card on black holds a vertical list of folders and files, each a single line with a small grey icon, one-step indentation per level and a chevron on folders. The selected row is a grey rounded bar and expanded folders push their children below them. Clicking a row selects it with a grey fill; clicking a folder's chevron flips the arrow and opens or closes its children, shifting the rows underneath. The clip opens public, moves the selection between files and collapses components again. tree panel, folder row, file row, chevron, folder icon, file icon, selected row
phrases: click a folder to open it
highlight a file in a sidebar

items.name: truck-loader
items.title: Truck Loader
items.blurb: A little red delivery truck bounces along a road while street lamps roll past.
items.use: A delivery, shipping or checkout screen needs a friendly loading graphic that says the order is on its way.
items.text: A flat side-view delivery truck idles on a thin road line, dipping on its suspension while dashed markings and lamp posts slide behind it. It loops forever as a loading indicator. A pale grey box trailer with a red cab, dark wheels and a small yellow headlight sits on a thin horizontal road line. Grey lamp posts slide across a near-black stage behind it. The truck body dips and rises on its suspension while the road dashes and lamp posts travel right to left on a loop. Motion runs continuously and never settles. box trailer, red cab, wheels, road line, street lamp
phrases: delivery truck driving across the screen
animated van with scrolling street lamps
little red truck moving on a road

items.name: tweet-card
items.title: Tweet Card
items.blurb: A dark card lays out one social post with avatar, handle and photo.
items.use: A page wants social proof from a real public post shown without an iframe.
items.text: A social-post card showing a single post: the author's picture and name with a verified tick, the handle, the message text and any attached photo, linking out to the original. A rounded dark card with a thin border, topped by a small round avatar, the name "Kelly King" beside a blue check and the handle beneath. Two lines of white text sit above a large red-and-blue abstract image. Static: nothing moves or responds. The author name, handle and bird icon are links that open the profile or post in a new tab. avatar, name, verified tick, handle, bird icon, post text, attached photo
phrases: single social post embedded on page
status update card for social proof
one post with photo and handle
customer quote styled as a post
card showing an author and their post
share a post on your site

items.name: tweet-grid
items.title: Tweet Grid
items.blurb: Three-column wall of tweet cards in a staggered masonry layout.
items.use: You want a dense wall of short social-style quotes with author photos and engagement counts.
items.text: A responsive masonry grid of tweet-style cards, each with author, handle, body, date and reply, repost and like counts. Six dark rounded tweet cards sit in three staggered columns, each with a round avatar, bold name, grey handle, small X mark, a few lines of text, a date and a row of emoji counts. Static: nothing moves or responds beyond a faint border shift on hover. tweet card, avatar, name, handle, x logo, body text, date, counts
phrases: wall of tweets in three columns
customer love wall for a landing page

items.name: typewriter-effect
items.title: Typewriter Effect
items.blurb: A bold headline types itself out letter by letter behind a blue caret.
items.use: A short headline or slogan that should feel typed in as the page loads.
items.text: A small grey eyebrow line above a large bold headline that fills in one character at a time when it enters view. A thin blue cursor bar blinks after the text and the last word is blue. A black stage with a small grey sentence above a large bold white headline. The headline types out left to right with a thin blue vertical caret after it, and the final word is blue and wraps onto a second line. When it scrolls into view the characters pop in one after another with a stagger, revealing each word. The blue caret blinks continuously and the last word stays blue once printed. eyebrow line, headline word, character, blue cursor
phrases: text reveal when scrolled into view

items.name: typewriter-loader
items.title: Typewriter Loader
items.blurb: A blue typewriter taps its keys as a sheet of paper inches up from the roller.
items.use: A writing, copywriting or document tool wants a themed loader that suggests text is being produced.
items.text: A flat blue typewriter illustration bounces gently while a lined sheet of paper feeds upward out of its carriage, then drops back in. It repeats as an indeterminate writing or loading indicator. A chunky blue typewriter seen head on, with two rows of white key dashes, a broad rounded body and a dark blue roller across the top. Cream lined paper rises from the roller between two gold end knobs. The paper slides up out of the carriage and sinks back, the white keys dip one after another, and the whole machine bounces slightly. The three second cycle repeats without stopping. typewriter body, white keys, carriage roller, paper sheet, gold knobs

items.name: typing-animation
items.title: Typing Animation
items.blurb: Words type out letter by letter behind a blinking bar.
items.use: A hero or heading should cycle through a few short phrases with a typewriter feel.
items.text: A line of bold text that types itself out one character at a time with a small blinking cursor, pauses, deletes, and moves on to the next phrase in a loop. Large, heavy white letters sit on a black field, ending in a thin vertical bar cursor. A half-typed line leaves a lot of empty space to its right, and the text starts from the left. Characters appear one after another at a steady pace with the cursor blinking at the end, then the line is erased the same way and the next phrase begins. It replays forever. typed text, cursor bar, dark background
phrases: text typing itself on a page

items.name: ui-layouts-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.blurb: A rounded photo slider with side arrows, a counter and dash dots.
items.use: A page needs to show a handful of photos one at a time with simple controls.
items.text: A horizontal image carousel with translucent round arrow buttons, a current-slide counter and dash-style dots. Slides glide sideways and wrap around at the ends. A wide rounded photo slide, a white hillside town, with translucent circular arrow buttons at mid-left and mid-right. Below it a small mono counter reads 1 / 4 on the left and four short dash dots sit at the right. Clicking an arrow or dot slides the photo horizontally to the next frame with a short ease; the counter and the dark active dash update, and arrows dim at the ends. Arrow keys also page it. photo slide, prev arrow, next arrow, counter, dot indicators
phrases: pictures that slide left and right

items.name: ui-layouts-color-picker
items.title: Hex Color Picker
items.blurb: A colour swatch opens a panel with a shade square, hue bar and hex field.
items.use: A settings form needs users to choose a brand or accent colour and see its exact hex value.
items.text: A labelled colour field that shows the current colour as a small swatch. Clicking it opens a popover with a saturation square, a rainbow hue slider, a hex input and a copy button. A small row pairs the word Color with a rounded rectangular swatch in the chosen colour. The open panel is a dark card holding a large gradient square, a thin rainbow hue bar, and a hex text field beside a copy button. Clicking the swatch opens the panel; dragging the rings in the square and on the hue bar recolours the swatch live, and the hex field can be typed into. The copy button writes the hex to the clipboard, and clicking outside closes the panel. label, colour swatch, popover panel, shade square, hue bar, hex field, copy button
phrases: pick a color from a square

items.name: ui-layouts-spotlight
items.title: Spotlight Effect
items.blurb: A soft white glow follows the pointer across a stack of cards.
items.use: A feature grid needs a subtle focal cue tied to where the pointer is.
items.text: Three dark feature cards that light up with a radial glow wherever the cursor moves. The light falls off gently and nothing on the cards is interactive. Three stacked dark cards with rounded corners and faint borders, each holding a small bold title and two lines of grey body text. A soft white radial glow sits on one card wherever the cursor is. Moving the pointer lights a soft radial patch that tracks it across the cards, brightening the area under the cursor and fading to nothing toward the edges. Nothing is clickable. card, title, body text, spotlight glow
phrases: glow follows the mouse across cards
dark cards with a moving glow
soft light that follows my mouse

items.name: ui-layouts-tabs
items.title: Animated Wobbly Tabs
items.blurb: A pale chip slides between three labels in a dark rounded bar.
items.use: A few small panels of copy should switch in place without leaving the page.
items.text: A compact tab bar of grey labels on a rounded track, where a raised chip marks the active tab and the paragraph beneath swaps to match, sliding in from the side you moved. A small dark rounded bar holds three short grey labels, the active one wrapped in a paler chip with a faint outline. Below the bar a block of small grey body text runs across the stage. Clicking a label sends the pale chip onto it while two offset copies trail a beat behind, so the chip settles with a small wobble. The paragraph below fades away and the new text slides in from the direction of travel. tab bar, tab label, active chip, content paragraph
phrases: tabs that slide with a spring
rounded tab bar for switching text
wobbly indicator under the chosen tab
ios style segmented tabs on dark
pill switcher with a moving highlight
tab menu with animated background chip

items.name: underline-animation
items.title: Underline Animation
items.blurb: Hovering a link grows, sweeps or floods an underline beneath it.
items.use: Portfolio or footer link lists need a restrained hover flourish that stays typographic and never shifts layout.
items.text: A set of link hover effects: one line swells from the centre, others sweep in and out, and another rises into a solid block that flips the text colour. Meant for typographic link lists. A short link list on black: a grey CONTACT label sits beside six blue uppercase links stacked in two groups, each link underlined by a thin blue line close beneath the text. Hovering a link plays one of four underline motions: a line grows from the centre, slides in then back out, or expands upward into a filled block that darkens the text. Each effect settles back when the pointer leaves. link text, underline, contact label, link list
phrases: link with line that grows on hover
blue links on a dark page

items.name: undo-button
items.title: Undo Button
items.blurb: Turns a plain action into a countdown you can still take back.
items.use: A destructive or hard-to-reverse action needs a short take-back window without opening a full dialog.
items.text: A pill action button that opens a short undo window when pressed. It widens into a past-tense label with an Undo action, a ticking number and a command-key hint while its outline slowly drains, then commits. A small rounded pill with a thin outline, a leading line icon and a label, sitting in a row beside a second matching pill. In the pending state it stretches to fit a grey past-tense word, a divider, an Undo arrow, a large countdown digit and a small key hint. Pressing swaps the label to past tense and starts a countdown as the border empties clockwise from the top. Hovering pauses the clock, pressing again or the shortcut cancels, and when time runs out a tick replaces the label. pill button, icon, label, undo arrow, countdown digit, key hint, outline
phrases: archive button that can be undone
cmd z to undo an action
button that turns into undo prompt

items.name: undo-pill
items.title: Undo Pill
items.blurb: A white undo bar slides up with a draining ring and a seconds count.
items.use: A destructive action needs a short, forgiving window to reverse it without opening a dialog.
items.text: After a row is deleted, a compact undo bar appears near the bottom edge with a countdown ring, a message and an Undo button. It fades when time runs out or bounces away after a restore. A small white rounded pill on a dark inbox: a tiny circular ring holding a digit at the left, a short label, a dot and an underlined Undo word. Above it the inbox card is dark grey with rounded rows and small trash icons. The pill springs up from below when a message is deleted and drains its ring while the digit counts down. Hovering or focusing pauses the count; pressing Undo makes it bounce out, and running out of time fades it away. countdown ring, seconds digit, message label, separator dot, undo button
phrases: undo bar after deleting an email
ring timer that pauses on hover

items.name: unlock-face-id
items.title: Unlock Face ID
items.blurb: A face outline draws itself, scans, then a green tick unblurs the page behind.
items.use: Sensitive content, recovery codes or account settings need a quick simulated biometric check before showing.
items.text: A Face ID style glyph with corner brackets draws in, a blue band sweeps over it, and on success a green tick replaces the face while the content below sharpens from a blur. On a dark rounded card, four white corner brackets surround a minimal line face, with a short status line beneath and a blurred block of text underneath. On success a bold green tick replaces the face. Clicking the glyph draws the brackets, then the face, and a blue band sweeps up and down across it. When the scan completes the face swaps for a green tick and the blurred content sharpens. corner brackets, face glyph, scan band, status text, green tick, blurred content
phrases: face id scan to unlock content
scan line over a face icon

items.name: uptime-card
items.title: Uptime Card
items.blurb: Rows of green day bars swell under the pointer and open a day's incidents.
items.use: A product page or dashboard should show recent reliability and let people inspect specific bad days.
items.text: A status-page card listing services, each with ninety days of coloured uptime bars and a percentage. Hovering swells the bars around the cursor and names the day, and clicking pins that day to slide open its incident timeline. A rounded dark card with a small title and a green tick line reading all systems operational. Below, four labelled rows of thin vertical bars, mostly green with a few amber and red ones, each row ending in an uptime percentage. Moving across the bars widens the days under the pointer and dims the rest while the line above names the date and any incident. Clicking pins that day and slides open a log of each incident update; Escape or the close button clears it. title, status line, date summary, service label, uptime bars, percentage, incident log, close button

items.name: variable-font-and-cursor
items.title: Variable Font and Cursor
items.blurb: Moving the cursor changes the word's weight and slant.
items.use: A portfolio or agency headline wants an interactive typographic moment that rewards moving the pointer.
items.text: A single word whose thickness and slant follow the mouse across its container, with faint crosshair guides and a live x and y readout tracking the pointer. An orange lowercase word sits centred on a black full-bleed stage. Faint grey crosshair lines and a tiny orange dot follow the pointer, with a small monospaced x and y readout at the lower left. As the pointer moves, the word's weight and slant interpolate between set limits, sliding from hairline to heavy and upright to italic. The crosshair lines and coordinates travel with the cursor. word, crosshair lines, pointer dot, coordinate readout
phrases: text that changes weight with mouse
word gets bolder as you move

items.name: vertical-thumbnail-slider
items.title: Vertical Thumbnail Slider
items.blurb: Tiny photo strip on the left drags a big picture up and down.
items.use: A handful of images must share a compact block and still show one large preview at a time.
items.text: A photo gallery where a tall column of small previews sits to the left of one large image. Clicking or dragging through the column moves the main photo, which scrolls vertically instead of sideways. A wide photo fills most of a black stage. Down the left edge runs a thin column of seven small landscape thumbnails with rounded corners, separated by narrow gaps. The active thumbnail sits inside a light rounded outline that marks it out from the rest. The thumbnail column and the large frame move together on a vertical axis: dragging the strip or the photo scrolls to the next image, and the outgoing picture slides away top or bottom. The outline hops to whichever thumbnail is current. main photo, thumbnail column, thumbnail image, selection outline
phrases: vertical image carousel with side thumbnails
thumbnail strip next to large photo
click small preview to change picture
photo gallery scrolling up and down
gallery where thumbnails sit on the left
picture switcher with one big frame

items.name: video-ambient
items.title: Video Ambient
items.blurb: A video whose colours spill past its edges as a glowing halo.
items.use: A hero or showcase wants a video to feel like a lit screen rather than a flat rectangle.
items.text: A rounded video player samples its own frames into a soft halo that bleeds past its borders, with a small toggle that switches the ambient glow off to compare. A rounded rectangular video of a green mossy stone floating on blue water, with a blue to teal glow spreading well past its edges. A small dark pill beneath reads Ambient glow: On. The video plays on a loop and its dominant colours are resampled several times a second, so the halo shifts with the footage. The small button below toggles the glow on and off. video player, ambient halo, glow toggle button
phrases: video with glow around the edges
colours bleed out of the video

items.name: video-blur-vignette
items.title: Video Blur Vignette
items.blurb: A looping forest clip plays inside a frame with softly blurred edges.
items.use: You want looping footage to blend into a dark page instead of sitting in a hard-edged box.
items.text: An autoplaying, muted forest video fills a rounded frame whose edges blur and fade into the page. The centre stays sharp, and the footage zooms slightly when hovered. A wide rounded rectangle showing sunlit tall trees, a mossy trunk at the left and green ferns below, spanning nearly the full width on a black page. The outer band of the footage is soft and slightly dimmed, so the frame melts into the background. The muted forest clip loops on its own from the moment it loads. Hovering zooms the footage in a little; otherwise the only change is the drifting sunlight and foliage as the video plays. video frame, video image, blurred edge band, rounded corner
phrases: soft frame around a playing clip
rounded video that fades at borders
looping background clip with soft border
video card with zoom on hover
framed motion footage for a hero

items.name: video-gallery
items.title: Video Gallery
items.blurb: Browse a filmmaker's project grid, filter it, and open any clip in a player.
items.use: A filmmaker, studio or videographer needs a full portfolio section that leads from browsing to playback.
items.text: A dark portfolio section lists video projects as image cards with category tags, search and filters. Hovering reveals a title and play action; clicking opens a modal player with details and specs. A black page opens with a large white Featured Videos heading, a search button and five filter pills above a grid of video thumbnails carrying small uppercase tags. Cards are dark and rounded with white type. Filter pills and search narrow the grid with an animated reflow, and cards lift and zoom on hover to reveal a dark gradient, title and View Project button. Clicking a card opens a full-screen player with arrows, share and fullscreen controls. heading, search button, filter pills, video cards, category tag, hover overlay, lightbox player
phrases: open video in a lightbox with details
cinematic project gallery for a studio

items.name: video-text
items.title: Video Text
items.blurb: A huge word cut out of a live underwater video.
items.use: One short word should carry a video texture and dominate a hero without a separate image block.
items.text: Renders a short word as a mask over a looping video, so the footage appears only inside the letterforms while the space between them stays empty. The single word OCEAN in very heavy, wide capitals spans a band across a black stage. The letters are not painted but act as windows onto moving teal water, with coral and light patches drifting inside the thick strokes. The clip loops behind the word and shows only through the letters, so colour and texture inside each stroke keep changing while the gaps and the background stay black. The word scales with the viewport and stays centred. word, video fill, letter shapes
phrases: text cut out of a moving clip
ocean footage masked by a word

items.name: vortex
items.title: Vortex
items.blurb: Streams of glowing blue and pink particles curl across black.
items.use: A dramatic dark section wants a living particle field behind its message or product shot.
items.text: A canvas backdrop of hundreds of short particle streaks that drift on a noise field, leaving glowing tails. The streaks gather in a loose band and keep swirling without end. A black field threaded with hundreds of short glowing streaks in blue, violet and magenta. The streaks cluster in the middle band and curl into loose arcs and loops, bright at their centres and fading at the tips. The particles drift and curl continuously along a noise flow, then respawn near the middle so the swirling band never empties. There is no pointer response; the motion runs from load. particle streaks, dark field, glow bloom, swirl band
phrases: canvas particle flow for a hero

items.name: waitlist
items.title: Waitlist
items.blurb: Collect early-access emails under a drifting pink spotlight and particle field.
items.use: A product or feature is not live yet and you need to collect early-access emails on a single page.
items.text: A centred early-access page with a badge, large gradient headline, three stat tiles, an email field and a pink Join button. Submitting swaps the form for a thank-you pill, with avatars and a joined count below. A dark full-width page lit by soft pink diagonal spotlights and drifting white dots. A pale badge sits above a big Join the Waitlist headline, then three bordered stat tiles, an email field and a pink button, with a small avatar row below. Content fades up on load while the spotlights drift and particles react to the pointer. Submitting the email briefly shows Joining then replaces the field and button with a glowing thank-you pill. early access badge, headline, stat tiles, email field, join button, avatar row, joined count
phrases: email capture page for a launch
dark landing page with pink glow

items.name: wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.blurb: Thin bars rise into a wake as you drag the volume across them.
items.use: An audio, brightness or any 0-100 control wants a more tactile readout than a plain track and knob.
items.text: A horizontal volume control drawn as a row of slim vertical bars. Bars up to the value glow white, and dragging faster lifts the bars around the handle into a short wave that settles when you stop. A dark rounded card holds a small title and subtitle above a single row of about thirty evenly spaced rounded bars. Filled bars are pale grey and the rest sit dim, with a percentage at the right. Clicking or dragging anywhere on the bar row sets the level, and the lit bars follow the pointer. Moving quickly lifts neighbouring bars into a peaked wake that flattens as the drag slows. bar row, lit bars, wake, percentage label, title

items.name: wallet-card
items.title: Wallet Card
items.blurb: A purple bank card stacked over others, with balance and member avatars.
items.use: A banking or fintech screen wants to show several payment cards as a tactile stack with balances.
items.text: A stack of payment cards fans back in 3D while the front card shows its holder, masked number, expiry and balance. A button hides the balance and an avatar row lists members. A glossy purple gradient card with a gold chip, contactless glyph and VISA mark, showing a dollar balance, masked digits and holder details. Thin coloured edges of two cards peek from beneath, with overlapping avatars and a small Hide balance pill below. Moving the pointer across the card slides a soft white sheen toward it. Clicking a stacked edge or using arrow keys brings another card forward, and Hide balance blurs the digits. card surface, chip, balance, masked number, holder details, member avatars, hide balance button
phrases: virtual card list for a banking app
card with moving shine on hover

items.name: warp-background
items.title: Warp Background
items.blurb: Coloured beams shoot through a receding grid tunnel.
items.use: A card or panel should feel like it is travelling forward, such as a launch or sci-fi theme.
items.text: A card background drawn as a 3D perspective grid tunnel, with coloured light beams racing from the edges toward the centre on looping timers. A dark tunnel of nested rectangular grid outlines receding to a vanishing point, crossed by angled coloured light streaks in green, purple, blue and orange. A small panel of text sits in the middle. Beams shoot from the outer edges toward the centre on repeating loops, each with its own random hue, delay and speed, while the grid tunnel itself stays still. grid tunnel, grid lines, coloured beams, centre panel

items.name: warp-text
items.title: Warp Text
items.blurb: Big white headline bends and splits into colour under the cursor.
items.use: A short, large hero headline should react to the pointer with a physical lens rather than a hover colour.
items.text: A heavy single-line headline rendered as a WebGL texture. A lens follows the pointer, bending letters and separating their edges into faint blue and orange fringes; clicks send ripples through the text. One wide line of very bold white text on near black, tightly kerned and centred vertically. Near the pointer the strokes lean, stretch and pick up a thin rainbow edge. The lens drifts slowly on its own and snaps toward the pointer when it enters, warping the letters closest to it. Each click pushes an expanding ripple ring through the text. headline, lens, chromatic fringe, ripple

items.name: watersplash-clippath
items.title: Water Splash Clip Path
items.blurb: Two photos shaped like splashing paint on a black stage.
items.use: A creative page needs two images with a bold ink-splash crop instead of plain rectangles.
items.text: A pair of photos each clipped to an inky water-splash silhouette: a blue city skyline on the left and a yellow-toned landscape with a building on the right, both on black. Two images sit side by side on black, each cut to a ragged ink-splash outline with round droplets flung out around it. Left is a cool blue cityscape of glass towers; right is a warm yellow and olive view of a building and field. Pointing at either splash scales the picture up inside the fixed cut-out, cropping it tighter while the splash silhouette holds its shape. splash silhouette, city photo, landscape photo, ink droplets, black stage

items.name: watersplash-imagemasking
items.title: Water Splash Image Mask
items.blurb: Mountain landscape seen through a water-splash cut-out with droplets.
items.use: A campaign or article wants a single hero image with an unusual liquid-shaped crop.
items.text: A single photo of snow-capped mountains and clouds masked into an irregular splash shape, with scattered round droplets floating around it on black. One wide landscape photo of pale mountains under a cloudy sky fills a large, irregular splash-shaped mask with soft, rounded edges. Several circular droplets of the same image float nearby at different sizes, all on a black stage. Static: nothing moves or responds. splash mask, mountain photo, image droplets, black stage

items.name: waveform-scrub
items.title: Waveform Scrub
items.blurb: An audio waveform with a draggable pin that fills bars as it plays.
items.use: A short recording such as a voice memo or clip needs visible progress and easy scrubbing in a small card.
items.text: A compact audio card with a play button, file name and remaining time above a bar waveform. A white pin can be dragged to scrub, and the bars behind it darken as the track plays. A dark rounded card holds a small play icon, the file name and a seconds count. Below sits a pale inner panel of thin grey vertical bars with a white pin on a long stem marking the position. Pressing play advances the pin and darkens the bars it passes while the seconds count down. Dragging the pin pauses playback and scrubs to that point; at the end the button becomes a replay icon. play button, file name, time remaining, waveform bars, playhead pin
phrases: scrub through a recording by hand
drag the pin to seek audio
waveform that fills as it plays

items.name: wavy-background
items.title: Wavy Background
items.blurb: Soft blurred ribbons of blue, teal and pink drift across a black backdrop.
items.use: A hero or section backdrop that needs gentle motion with content layered over it.
items.text: A full-screen dark backdrop crossed by five thick, heavily blurred waves that weave over each other in blue, teal, purple and pink. The ribbons drift and reshape continuously with no pointer input. A black stage with five soft, blurred ribbons in blue, teal, purple and pink stretching horizontally across the upper middle. They weave over and under each other like thick brush strokes, leaving most of the screen plain black. The ribbons drift and undulate continuously, slowly changing their curves and never settling. Nothing responds to the pointer, and the motion runs as long as the page is open. black background, blue wave, teal wave, purple wave, pink wave

items.name: web-analytics-dashboard
items.title: Web Analytics Dashboard
items.blurb: A web analytics board with traffic charts, live visitors and top-page tables.
items.use: A product or marketing site needs a ready-made overview of traffic, sources and page performance.
items.text: A responsive dashboard grid with a twelve-month visitor area chart, a live visitor count split by device, ranked tables for pages, countries and referrers, share bars, and Core Web Vitals. Laid out as a four column grid of bordered cards: a wide area chart with a large total, a live visitors card with three device share bars, then tables for top pages, countries and referrers, small share-bar cards, and a three-up Core Web Vitals row. Mostly static: hovering chart points raises a tooltip, the live visitor dot pulses continuously, and View All links sit over faded table edges. Figures never update on their own. visitors area chart, live visitors card, device share bars, top pages table, top countries table, referrers table, web vitals row
phrases: analytics overview page for a website

items.name: web-threads
items.title: Web Threads
items.blurb: Glowing violet threads weave to a bright knot on a dark stage.
items.use: A product or AI landing hero needs a dark, glowing network backdrop that responds to the pointer.
items.text: A full-bleed WebGL backdrop of thin luminous threads that cross, curve and gather at a glowing pinch point. The nearest thread brightens under the cursor, and clicks send a pulse of light along the web. Six long lavender-white lines sweep across black, dipping and rising in loose waves and meeting at a small intensely bright point in the middle. A short headline sits at the top. The threads drift and their crossing point glides slowly across the stage. Hovering near a thread brightens it, and clicking sends a ripple of light travelling outward along the strands. glowing threads, pinch knot, headline, pulse
phrases: click makes light travel along lines

items.name: webcam-pixel-grid
items.title: Webcam Pixel Grid
items.blurb: A webcam feed becomes a dark grid where motion lifts tiles into 3D blocks.
items.use: An interactive hero or demo should let visitors see their own movement turn into a grid of blocks.
items.text: Samples a live camera into a coarse grid of square cells. Any cell that sees movement rises into a little 3D block and settles back, so a rough silhouette lifts out of the grid as you move. A dark rounded panel filled with a fine grid of square cells. Part of the grid rises into pale grey 3D blocks that cast a shadow, forming a rough blob against the black, with a small white caption at the bottom left. The camera feed is sampled into the grid each frame, and cells whose pixels change lift into raised blocks, then settle back once motion stops. The blocks cast side faces and shadows, so the silhouette shifts as the subject moves. cell grid, raised blocks, block shadows, caption
phrases: blocks pop up as you move

items.name: weight-widget
items.title: Weight Widget
items.blurb: Swipe a curved row of numbers until one springs under the pointer.
items.use: A single numeric health value needs a tactile picker that feels like a physical dial rather than a slider.
items.text: A pocket-sized dial shows a weight value on a curved scale; dragging left or right slides neighbouring numbers past a fixed pointer and springs to the next whole number. A dark rounded square card labelled Weight holds one large white number centred in an arc of smaller faded numbers, with short tick marks curving beneath and a small white pointer triangle at the bottom. Dragging sideways moves the number row along its curve, dimming and shrinking numbers with distance, then releases it to spring to the next whole value. The selected number stays sharp under the fixed pointer. weight label, number dial, neighbour numbers, tick marks, pointer
phrases: swipe wheel to pick a number

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.blurb: Three tiny drums of numbers spin under a highlight bar to set a time.
items.use: A settings form needs to set a time quickly on touch, with the familiar iOS drum feel.
items.text: An iOS-style time picker with three vertical drums for hour, minute and AM/PM. Rows curve away in perspective above and below a grey selection band; drag or flick a drum and it coasts then snaps to a value. A rounded dark card holds three narrow columns of numbers under a pill-shaped grey band that marks the chosen hour, minute and AM/PM. Numbers shrink and fade toward the top and bottom edges. Each column turns like a drum as you drag it, with the rows above and below curving away. A flick keeps it coasting before it settles on a row, and keyboard arrows step it by one. selection band, hour drum, minute drum, period drum, fade edges
phrases: spin the drum to set time

items.name: wispr-flow-text-animation
items.title: Wispr Flow Text Animation
items.blurb: A paragraph streams endlessly along a looping curve you can reshape.
items.use: A launch or landing screen wants a wall of speech-like copy drifting on a curve that can be art-directed live.
items.text: A block of spoken-style text marches continuously along a bezier curve across a dark screen. Edit path reveals draggable anchors and handles that bend the curve live while the text keeps flowing. A black full-bleed field with a small grey paragraph wrapped along a thin winding line: a long sweep from the upper left, a tight loop near the centre, then a run to the lower right. A tiny pill at the top centre reads Edit path. The paragraph scrolls steadily along the curve in an endless loop. Pressing Edit path shows a blue dashed outline, anchor dots and hollow control handles; dragging them reshapes the curve while the text follows, and Done editing returns to the plain view. curved text path, flowing paragraph, edit button, path anchors, control handles, guide lines
phrases: text flowing along a curved line
voice transcript flowing across the screen
drag points to bend the text path

items.name: wizard-expandable
items.title: Wizard Expandable
items.blurb: A numbered step rail that opens a form panel beneath the active step.
items.use: An account or checkout setup has several short steps and should stay on one page without losing context.
items.text: A horizontal wizard rail of numbered steps; clicking one expands a panel under it with that step's fields, description and Back or Next buttons. The last step turns the action into Finish. A dark page shows a small SIGN UP badge above a row of five numbered tabs joined by a rail, with the active tab raised. Beneath sits a dark panel card holding a step title, grey description, labelled input fields and two buttons. Selecting a tab opens its panel with an animated height change and moves the highlight. Back, Next and Finish move between steps while the panel content fades, and clicking outside collapses it. sign up badge, step rail, step tabs, step panel, form fields, back and next buttons
phrases: multi step signup form with tabs
wizard that expands under each step
numbered steps with a form panel
onboarding flow with back and next
sign up process broken into steps

items.name: wobble-card
items.title: Wobble Card
items.blurb: Blue gradient card leans toward the cursor as its text drifts the other way.
items.use: A feature or promo card should feel physical and respond to the cursor without a full 3D scene.
items.text: A rounded content card with an indigo gradient and faint grain. The whole card follows the pointer a little, and the text inside slides opposite and scales slightly for depth. A rounded card filled with an indigo-to-violet gradient that glows lighter at the top, holding a bold white heading and two lines of pale body copy left-aligned. A soft radial highlight and faint grain cover the surface. Moving the pointer over the card nudges it toward the cursor while the inner text shifts the opposite way and grows a touch. It settles back to centre when the pointer leaves. card surface, gradient wash, heading, body copy, noise grain
phrases: card that tilts toward the mouse
card that shifts under the cursor
depth effect on a content tile
hero tile that leans while you move

items.name: work-experience
items.title: Work Experience List
items.blurb: Past jobs as white cards strung down a thin dotted timeline.
items.use: A portfolio or résumé page needs a vertical timeline of jobs with logos and skill tags.
items.text: A vertical career timeline of three white cards, each with a company logo, role, period, location, a one-line summary and small skill pills, joined by a faint line with small badge nodes. A nearly black page holding three white rounded cards in a centred stack. Each card starts with a round logo, a bold company name and a small external-link arrow, a grey role, a pin with a city, then a short paragraph and four pale rounded skill chips. A faint vertical line links small knot-shaped icons down the left. On load the cards slide in from the left in sequence and their skill chips pop in one by one. Hovering a card lifts it a few pixels and hovering a chip darkens it slightly. heading, company logo, company name, role, location, description, skill chip, timeline node
phrases: career path with dates and roles
cv list with location and skills

items.name: world-map
items.title: World Map
items.blurb: Blue arcs link cities across a dotted globe as it loads.
items.use: You need to show a distributed team, offices or shipping routes and want it to feel global and alive.
items.text: A dotted map of the world with glowing location dots and curved blue routes drawn between cities, each line animating into place while every dot pulses. A wide map of the continents built from tiny pale-blue dots on near-black. Faint blue curves lift between paired dots, each of which glows with a soft pulsing ring. On load the routes draw from city to city one after another while every endpoint emits a slow pulsing halo. After that nothing moves and the map does not react to the pointer. heading, subtext, dotted map, location dot, pulsing ring, curved route
phrases: dotted map of the globe with routes
office locations shown on a map
remote team spread across the world

items.name: youtube-video-player
items.title: YouTube Video Player
items.blurb: Cover image with a play button opens the clip large.
items.use: You have a YouTube clip and want a poster card that opens it large, in-page, without leaving the layout.
items.text: A rounded 16:9 video card showing a poster, a centred play button and the title. Pressing play swaps in an autoplaying YouTube embed, and the corner expand button blows it up over a dimmed page. A rounded 16:9 card filled with the Big Buck Bunny cover, a large circular play button with a dark triangle in the middle, the title just below it, and a small round expand icon at the top right. Once playing it becomes the YouTube embed with its own header and controls. Clicking play replaces the poster with an autoplaying YouTube iframe. The expand button grows the card into a centred overlay over a blurred dark backdrop and its icon flips to minimise; Escape closes the overlay. video frame, thumbnail, play button, title, expand button, embed player, backdrop
phrases: video card with a play button
youtube embed that opens in a lightbox
expand video to full screen overlay
watch a youtube clip in a modal
movie thumbnail with centered play icon
